- [ ] **Step 2: 실패하는 테스트 작성 — 기기 코드 흐름 (가짜 시계)**

폴링 루프는 `Task.Delay(interval, time, ct)`로 기다리므로, 테스트는 `FakeTimeProvider.Advance(1초)`와 짧은 실제 양보(`Task.Delay(1)`)를 번갈아 하며 시계를 민다(`DriveAsync`). 폴링 시각은 처리기 안에서 `GetUtcNow()`로 기록한다. 간격 검증은 하한(지연이 시작된 시각 이후)이 결정적이고, 상한은 루프가 다음 지연을 등록하기 전에 시계가 한두 칸 더 갈 수 있어 4초 여유를 둔다.

`tests/AITokenUsage.Core.Tests/Providers/Copilot/GitHubDeviceFlowTests.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Providers.Copilot;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Fakes;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Time.Testing;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Providers.Copilot;

public sealed class GitHubDeviceFlowTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Start = new(2026, 10, 28, 3, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private readonly FakeTimeProvider _time = new(Start);
    private readonly StubHttpHandler _http = new();
    private readonly List<DateTimeOffset> _pollTimes = [];
    private readonly List<string> _pollBodies = [];

    [Fact]
    public async Task Start_posts_form_with_client_and_scope_and_parses_the_code()
    {
        string? body = null, accept = null, contentType = null, userAgent = null;
        _http.When(r => r.Method == HttpMethod.Post && r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri == GitHubDeviceFlow.DeviceCodeUrl, r =>
        {
            body = r.Content!.ReadAsStringAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            accept = r.Headers.Accept.ToString();
            contentType = r.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType;
            userAgent = r.Headers.UserAgent.ToString();
            return Reply(HttpStatusCode.OK, Fixture.Read("copilot/device-code.json"));
        });

        var code = await CreateFlow().StartAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.Equal("test-device-code", code.DeviceCode);
        Assert.Equal("WDJB-MJHT", code.UserCode);
        Assert.Equal(new Uri("https://github.com/login/device"), code.VerificationUri);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(900), code.ExpiresIn);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), code.Interval);
        Assert.Equal("client_id=Iv1.b507a08c87ecfe98&scope=read%3Auser", body);
        Assert.Contains("application/json", accept);
        Assert.Equal("application/x-www-form-urlencoded", contentType);
        Assert.Equal(GitHubApi.UserAgent, userAgent);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("test-device-code", code.ToString());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Start_reports_disabled_device_flow_from_a_200_body()
    {
        _http.When(r => r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri == GitHubDeviceFlow.DeviceCodeUrl,
            _ => Reply(HttpStatusCode.OK, Fixture.Read("copilot/device-code-disabled.json")));

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DeviceFlowException>(() => CreateFlow().StartAsync(CancellationToken.None));

        Assert.Equal(DeviceFlowError.Disabled, ex.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Start_network_failure_is_Network()
    {
        _http.When(r => r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri == GitHubDeviceFlow.DeviceCodeUrl,
            _ => throw new HttpRequestException("no route to host"));

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DeviceFlowException>(() => CreateFlow().StartAsync(CancellationToken.None));

        Assert.Equal(DeviceFlowError.Network, ex.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Pending_then_slow_down_then_success_returns_the_token()
    {
        GivenPollReplies("copilot/token-pending.json", "copilot/token-slow-down.json", "copilot/token-success.json");

        var token = await DriveAsync(CreateFlow().WaitForTokenAsync(Code(), CancellationToken.None));

        Assert.Equal("ghu_test_device_token", token);
        Assert.Equal(3, _pollTimes.Count);
        Assert.True(_pollTimes[0] - Start >= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        var gapAfterPending = _pollTimes[1] - _pollTimes[0];
        var gapAfterSlowDown = _pollTimes[2] - _pollTimes[1];
        Assert.InRange(gapAfterPending, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(9));
        Assert.InRange(gapAfterSlowDown, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(14));
        Assert.All(_pollBodies, b =>
        {
            Assert.Contains("client_id=Iv1.b507a08c87ecfe98", b);
            Assert.Contains("device_code=test-device-code", b);
            Assert.Contains("grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Adevice_code", b);
        });
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("copilot/token-expired.json", DeviceFlowError.Expired)]
    [InlineData("copilot/token-denied.json", DeviceFlowError.Denied)]
    [InlineData("copilot/token-incorrect-device-code.json", DeviceFlowError.Unknown)]
    public async Task Terminal_poll_errors_throw(string fixture, DeviceFlowError expected)
    {
        GivenPollReplies("copilot/token-pending.json", fixture);

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DeviceFlowException>(
            () => DriveAsync(CreateFlow().WaitForTokenAsync(Code(), CancellationToken.None)));

        Assert.Equal(expected, ex.Error);
        Assert.Equal(2, _pollTimes.Count);
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ex.UserMessage));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Local_deadline_expires_while_still_pending()
    {
        GivenPollReplies("copilot/token-pending.json");

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DeviceFlowException>(
            () => DriveAsync(CreateFlow().WaitForTokenAsync(Code(expiresSeconds: 12), CancellationToken.None)));

        Assert.Equal(DeviceFlowError.Expired, ex.Error);
        Assert.Equal(2, _pollTimes.Count); // polls at ~5 s and ~10 s, deadline hit before ~15 s
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Three_consecutive_network_failures_throw_Network()
    {
        var attempts = 0;
        _http.When(r => r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri == GitHubDeviceFlow.AccessTokenUrl, _ =>
        {
            attempts++;
            throw new HttpRequestException("connection reset");
        });

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DeviceFlowException>(
            () => DriveAsync(CreateFlow().WaitForTokenAsync(Code(), CancellationToken.None)));

        Assert.Equal(DeviceFlowError.Network, ex.Error);
        Assert.Equal(3, attempts);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Cancellation_stops_polling()
    {
        GivenPollReplies("copilot/token-pending.json");
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var task = CreateFlow().WaitForTokenAsync(Code(), cts.Token);

        for (var i = 0; i < 200 && _pollTimes.Count == 0; i++)
        {
            _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            await Task.Delay(1);
        }

        cts.Cancel();

        await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() => task);
        Assert.Single(_pollTimes);
    }

    private GitHubDeviceFlow CreateFlow() => new(new HttpClient(_http), _time);

    private static DeviceCodeInfo Code(int expiresSeconds = 900, int intervalSeconds = 5) =>
        new("test-device-code", "WDJB-MJHT", new Uri("https://github.com/login/device"),
            TimeSpan.FromSeconds(expiresSeconds), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(intervalSeconds));

    /// <summary>Each poll takes the next fixture; the last one repeats.</summary>
    private void GivenPollReplies(params string[] fixtures)
    {
        var queue = new Queue<string>(fixtures);
        _http.When(r => r.Method == HttpMethod.Post && r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri == GitHubDeviceFlow.AccessTokenUrl, r =>
        {
            _pollTimes.Add(_time.GetUtcNow());
            _pollBodies.Add(r.Content!.ReadAsStringAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult());
            var fixture = queue.Count > 1 ? queue.Dequeue() : queue.Peek();
            return Reply(HttpStatusCode.OK, Fixture.Read(fixture));
        });
    }

    /// <summary>Moves the fake clock one second at a time, yielding so the polling loop can register its next delay.</summary>
    private async Task<T> DriveAsync<T>(Task<T> task)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < 2000 && !task.IsCompleted; i++)
        {
            _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            await Task.Delay(1);
        }

        return await task;
    }

    private static HttpResponseMessage Reply(HttpStatusCode status, string body) =>
        new(status) { Content = new StringContent(body, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json") };
}
```

```csharp
namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Providers.Copilot;

public enum DeviceFlowError { Expired, Denied, Disabled, Network, Unknown }

public sealed class DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError error, Exception? innerException = null)
    : Exception($"GitHub device flow failed: {error}", innerException)
{
    public DeviceFlowError Error { get; } = error;

    /// <summary>Korean text for the settings window.</summary>

        DeviceFlowError.Network => "네트워크 오류 — 잠시 후 다시 시도",
        _ => "GitHub 로그인 중 알 수 없는 오류가 발생했습니다",
```

`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Providers/Copilot/GitHubDeviceFlow.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text.Json;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Providers.Copilot;

/// <summary>
/// GitHub OAuth device flow with the Copilot GitHub App client. Errors arrive in HTTP 200 bodies,
/// so "error" is checked before "access_token". Polling waits with the injected TimeProvider.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GitHubDeviceFlow(HttpClient http, TimeProvider time)
{
    public const string ClientId = "Iv1.b507a08c87ecfe98";
    public const string Scope = "read:user";
    public const string DeviceCodeUrl = "https://github.com/login/device/code";
    public const string AccessTokenUrl = "https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token";
    public const string GrantType = "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code";

    private const int MaxConsecutiveNetworkFailures = 3;
    private static readonly Uri DefaultVerificationUri = new("https://github.com/login/device");
    private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
    private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultExpiresIn = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(900);
    private static readonly TimeSpan SlowDownStep = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);

    public async Task<DeviceCodeInfo> StartAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var root = await PostFormAsync(DeviceCodeUrl,
            new Dictionary<string, string> { ["client_id"] = ClientId, ["scope"] = Scope }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        if (Json.Str(root, "error") is { } error)
        {
            throw new DeviceFlowException(MapError(error));
        }

        var deviceCode = Json.Str(root, "device_code");
        var userCode = Json.Str(root, "user_code");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(deviceCode) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(userCode))
        {
            throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Unknown);
        }

        var verificationUri = Uri.TryCreate(Json.Str(root, "verification_uri"), UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
                              && uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps
            ? uri
            : DefaultVerificationUri;
        var expiresIn = Json.Num(root, "expires_in") is double e && e > 0 ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(e) : DefaultExpiresIn;
        var interval = Json.Num(root, "interval") is double i && i > 0 ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(i) : DefaultInterval;
        return new DeviceCodeInfo(deviceCode, userCode, verificationUri, expiresIn, interval);
    }

    /// <summary>Polls until GitHub returns an access token. Throws DeviceFlowException or OperationCanceledException.</summary>
    public async Task<string> WaitForTokenAsync(DeviceCodeInfo code, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var interval = code.Interval > TimeSpan.Zero ? code.Interval : DefaultInterval;
        var deadline = time.GetUtcNow() + code.ExpiresIn;
        var form = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["client_id"] = ClientId,
            ["device_code"] = code.DeviceCode,
            ["grant_type"] = GrantType,
        };
        var networkFailures = 0;

        while (true)
        {
            await Task.Delay(interval, time, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (time.GetUtcNow() >= deadline)
            {
                throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Expired);
            }

            JsonElement root;
            try
            {
                root = await PostFormAsync(AccessTokenUrl, form, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                networkFailures = 0;
            }
            catch (DeviceFlowException ex) when (ex.Error == DeviceFlowError.Network)
            {
                networkFailures++;
                if (networkFailures >= MaxConsecutiveNetworkFailures)
                {
                    throw;
                }

                continue;
            }

            switch (Json.Str(root, "error"))
            {
                case null:
                    var token = Json.Str(root, "access_token");
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
                    {
                        throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Unknown);
                    }

                    return token;
                case "authorization_pending":
                    break;
                case "slow_down":
                    var serverInterval = Json.Num(root, "interval") is double s && s > 0 ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(s) : TimeSpan.Zero;
                    var increased = interval + SlowDownStep;
                    interval = serverInterval > increased ? serverInterval : increased;
                    break;
                case { } error:
                    throw new DeviceFlowException(MapError(error));
            }
        }
    }

    private static DeviceFlowError MapError(string error) => error switch
    {
        "expired_token" => DeviceFlowError.Expired,
        "access_denied" => DeviceFlowError.Denied,
        "device_flow_disabled" => DeviceFlowError.Disabled,
        _ => DeviceFlowError.Unknown,
    };

    /// <summary>POSTs a form with Accept: application/json and returns the JSON object (cloned).</summary>
    private async Task<JsonElement> PostFormAsync(string url, Dictionary<string, string> form, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, url) { Content = new FormUrlEncodedContent(form) };
        request.Headers.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
        request.Headers.UserAgent.ParseAdd(GitHubApi.UserAgent);

        try
        {
            using var response = await http.SendAsync(request, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if ((int)response.StatusCode >= 500)
            {
                throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Network);
            }

            var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Unknown);
            }

            return doc.RootElement.Clone();
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException ex)
        {
            throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Network, ex);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException ex) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Network, ex);
        }
        catch (JsonException ex)
        {
            throw new DeviceFlowException(DeviceFlowError.Unknown, ex);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Providers;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Providers.Copilot;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Fakes;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Providers;

public sealed class ProviderCatalogTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Creates_all_providers_in_spec_order()
    {
        var providers = Create();

        Assert.Equal(ProviderIds.All.ToArray(), providers.Select(p => p.Id).ToArray());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Copilot_entry_exposes_sign_in_members()
    {
        var copilot = Assert.IsType<CopilotUsageProvider>(Create().Single(p => p.Id == ProviderIds.Copilot));

        Assert.Null(copilot.SignedInLogin);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_provider_offers_its_default_line_keys()
    {
        foreach (var provider in Create())
        {
            var (line1, line2) = ProviderDefaults.DefaultLines(provider.Id);
            var keys = provider.StaticMeterOptions.Select(o => o.Key).ToList();

            Assert.Contains(line1, keys);
            Assert.Contains(line2, keys);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_provider_has_a_name_and_a_minimum_interval()
    {
        foreach (var provider in Create())
        {
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(provider.DisplayName));
            Assert.True(provider.MinInterval >= TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), provider.Id);
            Assert.NotNull(provider.WatchPaths);
        }
    }

    private static IReadOnlyList<IUsageProvider> Create() =>
        ProviderCatalog.CreateAll(TestContexts.Create(new StubHttpHandler(), new FakeTimeProvider()));
}
```

## Phase 4 — 앱

### Task 14: App 셸, 단일 인스턴스, `AppHost` 합성 루트, 트레이 아이콘

앱의 뼈대를 만든다. 단일 인스턴스(Mutex + 이름 있는 이벤트), 전역 예외 로깅, 모든 실제 구현을 묶는 `AppHost`, 공급자 `WatchPaths` 감시, Windows 시작 프로그램 등록, 트레이 아이콘(숫자 원 아이콘 + 툴팁 + 메뉴)이 이 Task의 범위다. 툴팁·아이콘 숫자 문자열 규칙은 순수 로직이므로 Core의 `TrayTextFormatter`로 빼서 TDD로 고정한다.

**미터 선택 규칙은 하나다.** 설정의 1줄·2줄 키로 미터를 고르는 규칙은 Core `AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation.MeterSelector`가 유일한 구현이고, 이 Task가 먼저 만든다. 트레이(`TrayTextFormatter.SelectLine1/SelectLine2`)와 위젯(Task 17 `WidgetPanelBuilder`)은 둘 다 `MeterSelector.Select(view.DisplayMeters, line1Key, line2Key)`만 부른다. 키 비교는 `Ordinal`(대소문자 구분), 키가 비었거나 데이터에 없으면 "다른 줄이 아직 쓰지 않은 첫 미터"로 대체한다. 값이 없을 때의 표시 문자도 `MeterSelector.MissingValue`(`"—"`, em dash) 하나를 트레이·위젯이 같이 쓴다.

**스레딩 규칙 (이 Task가 고정한다)**
- `UsageService.ViewChanged`는 백그라운드에서 온다. `AppHost`가 `Dispatcher.BeginInvoke`로 UI 스레드에 넘긴 뒤 `Rotation.UpdateProviders(EnabledViewsInOrder())` → `AppHost.ViewChanged` 순서로 처리한다.
- 설정 저장과 시작 프로그램 레지스트리 쓰기는 `QueueBackground`(스레드 풀에서 순서대로 실행되는 체인)로 보낸다. UI 스레드는 저장 I/O를 하지 않는다. 시작 시 `SettingsStore.Load()` 1회만 UI 스레드에서 한다(아직 작업 표시줄에 붙기 전이라 입력 큐가 연결되지 않은 시점). 저장에는 UI 스레드에서 만든 `Settings.Clone()` 스냅샷을 넘긴다 — 풀 스레드가 UI가 편집 중인 `Settings` 객체를 직렬화하는 일이 없다.
- `RefreshMinutes`가 직전에 적용한 값과 다르면 `ApplySettings`가 `Usage.RescheduleAll()`을 불러 이미 잡힌 다음 조회 시각을 새 간격으로 다시 잡는다.
- 종료 시 `DisposeAsync`는 마지막 설정 저장(백그라운드 체인)을 기다린 뒤 `FileAppLog.Flush()`로 로그를 디스크에 밀어 넣는다.
- `FileSystemWatcher` 생성·재검사는 `System.Threading.Timer`(스레드 풀)에서 한다.

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;

public class MeterSelectorTests
{
    private static readonly UsageMeter Session = Meter("session", "5h", 14);
    private static readonly UsageMeter Weekly = Meter("weekly", "주", 50);
    private static readonly UsageMeter Fable = Meter("weekly:fable", "주·Fa", 35);

    private static UsageMeter Meter(string key, string shortLabel, double? used) =>
        new(key, shortLabel, "긴 " + key, used, null);

    [Fact]
    public void BothKeysFound_ReturnsThemInLineOrder()
    {
        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([Weekly, Session], "session", "weekly");

        Assert.Same(Session, first);
        Assert.Same(Weekly, second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BothKeysMissing_FallsBackToFirstMeters()
    {
        var monthly = Meter("monthly", "월", 20);

        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([monthly], "5h", "weekly");

        Assert.Same(monthly, first);
        Assert.Null(second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MissingLine2_TakesFirstMeterOtherThanLine1()
    {
        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([Session, Weekly, Fable], "weekly", "weekly:opus");

        Assert.Same(Weekly, first);
        Assert.Same(Session, second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MissingLine1_DoesNotReuseTheLine2Meter()
    {
        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([Session, Weekly], "gone", "session");

        Assert.Same(Weekly, first);
        Assert.Same(Session, second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SameKeyOnBothLines_ShowsTheSameMeterTwice()
    {
        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([Session, Weekly], "weekly", "weekly");

        Assert.Same(Weekly, first);
        Assert.Same(Weekly, second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NoMeters_ReturnsNulls()
    {
        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([], "session", "weekly");

        Assert.Null(first);
        Assert.Null(second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BlankKeys_UseMeterOrder()
    {
        var (first, second) = MeterSelector.Select([Session, Weekly], "", null);

        Assert.Same(Session, first);
        Assert.Same(Weekly, second);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>
/// Picks the two meters a provider shows from the configured line keys.
/// The single selection rule shared by the tray (TrayTextFormatter) and the widget (WidgetPanelBuilder).
/// </summary>
public static class MeterSelector
{
    /// <summary>Placeholder for a line that has no value (em dash), used by the tray and the widget alike.</summary>
    public const string MissingValue = "—";

    /// <summary>
    /// Each line takes the meter with its configured key. A line whose key is blank or missing
    /// takes the first meter (in provider order) that the other line does not already show.
    /// Both lines may show the same meter only when both keys name it.
    /// </summary>
    public static (UsageMeter? First, UsageMeter? Second) Select(IReadOnlyList<UsageMeter> meters, string? line1Key, string? line2Key)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(meters);

        UsageMeter? first = Find(meters, line1Key);
        UsageMeter? second = Find(meters, line2Key);

        first ??= meters.FirstOrDefault(m => !ReferenceEquals(m, second));
        second ??= meters.FirstOrDefault(m => !ReferenceEquals(m, first));

        return (first, second);
    }

    private static UsageMeter? Find(IReadOnlyList<UsageMeter> meters, string? key) =>
        string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)
            ? null
            : meters.FirstOrDefault(m => string.Equals(m.Key, key, StringComparison.Ordinal));
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Util;

/// <summary>Text for the tray icon: the tooltip ("Claude 5h 14% · 주 50%") and the number drawn inside the icon.</summary>
public static class TrayTextFormatter
{
    /// <summary>NotifyIcon.Text limit on .NET (longer strings throw).</summary>
    public const int MaxTooltipLength = 127;
    public const string AppTitle = "AI 사용량";
    public const string NoValue = MeterSelector.MissingValue;
    public const string StaleSuffix = " (이전 값)";
    private const string Separator = " · ";

    /// <summary>Line 1 exactly as the widget shows it (MeterSelector, the shared rule).</summary>
    public static UsageMeter? SelectLine1(ProviderView view, ProviderSettings? lines)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);
        return MeterSelector.Select(view.DisplayMeters, lines?.Line1Key, lines?.Line2Key).First;
    }

    /// <summary>Line 2 exactly as the widget shows it (MeterSelector, the shared rule). Null when there is no other meter.</summary>
    public static UsageMeter? SelectLine2(ProviderView view, ProviderSettings? lines)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);
        return MeterSelector.Select(view.DisplayMeters, lines?.Line1Key, lines?.Line2Key).Second;
    }

    /// <summary>Clamped used percent, or 100 − used in Remaining mode. Null when the meter has no percent.</summary>
    public static double? DisplayPercent(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode)
    {
        double? used = SeverityRules.Clamp(meter.UsedPercent);
        if (used is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return mode == ValueMode.Remaining ? 100 - used.Value : used.Value;
    }

    public static string FormatValue(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(meter.TextOverride))
        {
            return meter.TextOverride;
        }

        double? percent = DisplayPercent(meter, mode);
        return percent is null ? NoValue : Round(percent.Value) + "%";
    }

    public static string IconText(UsageMeter? meter, ValueMode mode)
    {
        if (meter is null)
        {
            return NoValue;
        }

        double? percent = DisplayPercent(meter, mode);
        return percent is null ? NoValue : Round(percent.Value);
    }

    public static string StatusText(ProviderStatus status) => status switch
    {
        ProviderStatus.NotInstalled => "설치 안 됨",
        ProviderStatus.SignedOut => "로그인 필요",
        ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh => "갱신 대기",
        ProviderStatus.Unsupported => "지원 안 됨",
        ProviderStatus.RateLimited => "요청 제한",
        ProviderStatus.Error => "오류",
        _ => "불러오는 중…",
    };

    public static string Tooltip(ProviderView? view, ProviderSettings? lines, ValueMode mode)
    {
        if (view is null)
        {
            return AppTitle;
        }

        string text;
        if (!view.HasAnyData)
        {
            string status = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(view.Current.StatusMessage)
                ? StatusText(view.Current.Status)
                : view.Current.StatusMessage;
            text = view.DisplayName + Separator + status;
        }
        else
        {
            (UsageMeter? line1, UsageMeter? line2) = MeterSelector.Select(view.DisplayMeters, lines?.Line1Key, lines?.Line2Key);
            var parts = new List<string>(2);
            if (line1 is not null)
            {
                parts.Add(Describe(line1, mode));
            }

            // Both keys may name the same meter (the widget then repeats it); the tooltip states it once.
            if (line2 is not null && !ReferenceEquals(line1, line2))
            {
                parts.Add(Describe(line2, mode));
            }

            text = view.DisplayName + " " + string.Join(Separator, parts);
            if (view.IsStale)
            {
                text += StaleSuffix;
            }
        }

        return Truncate(text);
    }

    private static string Describe(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode) =>
        string.IsNullOrEmpty(meter.TextOverride)
            ? $"{meter.ShortLabel} {FormatValue(meter, mode)}".Trim()
            : meter.TextOverride;

    private static string Round(double value) =>
        ((int)Math.Round(value, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static string Truncate(string text) =>
        text.Length <= MaxTooltipLength ? text : string.Concat(text.AsSpan(0, MaxTooltipLength - 1), "…");
}
```

```csharp
namespace AITokenUsage;

/// <summary>Storage locations (spec §3.5).</summary>

{
    public const string AppFolderName = "AITokenUsage";

        Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData), AppFolderName);

    public static string LocalDirectory =>
        Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), AppFolderName);

    public static string SettingsFile => Path.Combine(RoamingDirectory, "settings.json");

    public static string CacheFile => Path.Combine(LocalDirectory, "cache.json");

    public static string LogDirectory => Path.Combine(LocalDirectory, "logs");

}
```

```csharp
using System.Security;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace AITokenUsage;

/// <summary>HKCU\...\Run value "AITokenUsage" = quoted Environment.ProcessPath. Call from a background thread.</summary>
public static class StartupRegistration
{
    public const string RunKeyPath = @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run";
    public const string ValueName = "AITokenUsage";

    public static string? BuildCommand() =>
        Environment.ProcessPath is { Length: > 0 } path ? "\"" + path + "\"" : null;

    public static void Apply(bool enabled, IAppLog log)
    {
        try
        {
            using RegistryKey key = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(RunKeyPath, writable: true);
            object? current = key.GetValue(ValueName);
            if (enabled)
            {
                string? command = BuildCommand();
                if (command is null)
                {
                    log.Warn("startup registration skipped: process path is unknown");
                    return;
                }

                if (!string.Equals(current as string, command, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    key.SetValue(ValueName, command, RegistryValueKind.String);
                    log.Info("startup registration enabled");
                }
            }
            else if (current is not null)
            {
                key.DeleteValue(ValueName, throwOnMissingValue: false);
                log.Info("startup registration removed");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException or SecurityException)
        {
            log.Warn("could not update the startup registration", ex);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace AITokenUsage;

/// <summary>
/// Single instance via a named mutex. A second instance signals the named event (first instance opens settings)
/// and exits. Create and dispose on the UI thread: the mutex is owned by the thread that created it.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SingleInstance : IDisposable
{
    public const string MutexName = @"Local\AITokenUsage.SingleInstance";
    public const string ShowSettingsEventName = @"Local\AITokenUsage.ShowSettings";

    private readonly Mutex _mutex;
    private readonly EventWaitHandle _showSettings;
    private readonly ManualResetEvent _stop = new(false);
    private Thread? _listener;
    private bool _disposed;

    private SingleInstance(Mutex mutex, EventWaitHandle showSettings)
    {
        _mutex = mutex;
        _showSettings = showSettings;
    }

    /// <summary>Returns the owner object for the first instance; for a second instance signals the first and returns null.</summary>
    public static SingleInstance? TryAcquire()
    {
        var mutex = new Mutex(initiallyOwned: true, MutexName, out bool createdNew);

        // Both instances open-or-create the event, so the signal is never lost even if the first
        // instance has not created it yet.
        var showSettings = new EventWaitHandle(false, EventResetMode.AutoReset, ShowSettingsEventName);
        if (createdNew)
        {
            return new SingleInstance(mutex, showSettings);
        }

        showSettings.Set();
        showSettings.Dispose();
        mutex.Dispose();
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>Waits for the signal on a background thread and invokes the callback on the dispatcher.</summary>
    public void StartListening(Dispatcher dispatcher, Action onShowSettings)
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        if (_listener is not null)
        {
            return;
        }

        _listener = new Thread(() => Listen(dispatcher, onShowSettings))
        {
            IsBackground = true,
            Name = "AITokenUsage.SingleInstance",
        };
        _listener.Start();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _stop.Set();
        bool stopped = _listener is null || _listener.Join(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
        if (stopped)
        {
            _showSettings.Dispose();
            _stop.Dispose();
        }

        try
        {
            _mutex.ReleaseMutex();
        }
        catch (ApplicationException)
        {
            // Not owned by this thread; the handle close below releases it anyway.
        }

        _mutex.Dispose();
    }

    private void Listen(Dispatcher dispatcher, Action onShowSettings)
    {
        WaitHandle[] handles = [_stop, _showSettings];
        while (WaitHandle.WaitAny(handles) == 1)
        {
            if (dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
            {
                return;
            }

            dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, onShowSettings);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Providers;

namespace AITokenUsage;

/// <summary>
/// FileSystemWatchers for every provider WatchPath. An existing directory is watched recursively; anything else
/// (file or not-yet-existing path) through its parent directory with a name filter. Paths whose parent does not
/// exist yet are picked up by the 60 s rescan. Debounce, matching and rate-limit checks are UsageService's job.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class ProviderPathWatcher : IDisposable
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan RescanInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);

    private readonly IReadOnlyList<string> _watchPaths;
    private readonly Action<string> _onPathChanged;
    private readonly IAppLog _log;
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<WatchTarget, FileSystemWatcher> _watchers = new();
    private Timer? _timer;
    private int _scanning;
    private bool _disposed;

    public ProviderPathWatcher(IEnumerable<IUsageProvider> providers, Action<string> onPathChanged, IAppLog log)
    {
        _watchPaths = providers
            .SelectMany(p => p.WatchPaths)
            .Where(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToArray();
        _onPathChanged = onPathChanged;
        _log = log;
    }

    /// <summary>Starts the first scan on the thread pool, then rescans every 60 s.</summary>
    public void Start()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed || _timer is not null)
            {
                return;
            }

            _timer = new Timer(_ => Rescan(), null, TimeSpan.Zero, RescanInterval);
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            _disposed = true;
            _timer?.Dispose();
            foreach (FileSystemWatcher watcher in _watchers.Values)
            {
                watcher.Dispose();
            }

            _watchers.Clear();
        }
    }

    private void Rescan()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _scanning, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var desired = new HashSet<WatchTarget>();
            foreach (string path in _watchPaths)
            {
                if (Resolve(path) is WatchTarget target)
                {
                    desired.Add(target);
                }
            }

            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_disposed)
                {
                    return;
                }

                foreach (WatchTarget stale in _watchers.Keys.Where(t => !desired.Contains(t)).ToArray())
                {
                    _watchers[stale].Dispose();
                    _watchers.Remove(stale);
                }

                foreach (WatchTarget target in desired)
                {
                    if (!_watchers.ContainsKey(target) && TryCreate(target) is FileSystemWatcher watcher)
                    {
                        _watchers[target] = watcher;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("path watcher rescan failed", ex);
        }
        finally
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _scanning, 0);
        }
    }

    private static WatchTarget? Resolve(string path)
    {
        string full;
        try
        {
            full = Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(path));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or NotSupportedException or PathTooLongException)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (Directory.Exists(full))
        {
            return new WatchTarget(full, "*", Recursive: true);
        }

        string? parent = Path.GetDirectoryName(full);
        string name = Path.GetFileName(full);
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || !Directory.Exists(parent))
        {
            return null;
        }

        return new WatchTarget(parent, name, Recursive: false);
    }

    private FileSystemWatcher? TryCreate(WatchTarget target)
    {
        FileSystemWatcher? watcher = null;
        try
        {
            watcher = new FileSystemWatcher(target.Folder, target.Filter)
            {
                IncludeSubdirectories = target.Recursive,
                NotifyFilter = NotifyFilters.FileName | NotifyFilters.DirectoryName | NotifyFilters.LastWrite
                    | NotifyFilters.Size | NotifyFilters.CreationTime,
            };
            watcher.Changed += OnFileEvent;
            watcher.Created += OnFileEvent;
            watcher.Deleted += OnFileEvent;
            watcher.Renamed += OnRenamed;
            watcher.Error += OnWatcherError;
            watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = true;
            _log.Info($"watching {target.Folder} (filter {target.Filter}, recursive {target.Recursive})");
            return watcher;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or PlatformNotSupportedException)
        {
            watcher?.Dispose();
            _log.Warn($"cannot watch {target.Folder}", ex);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private void OnFileEvent(object sender, FileSystemEventArgs e) => Notify(e.FullPath);

    private void OnRenamed(object sender, RenamedEventArgs e)
    {
        Notify(e.OldFullPath);
        Notify(e.FullPath);
    }

    private void Notify(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            _onPathChanged(path);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("path change handler failed", ex);
        }
    }

    private void OnWatcherError(object sender, ErrorEventArgs e)
    {
        _log.Warn("file watcher error; it will be recreated", e.GetException());
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (KeyValuePair<WatchTarget, FileSystemWatcher> pair in _watchers.Where(p => ReferenceEquals(p.Value, sender)).ToArray())
            {
                pair.Value.Dispose();
                _watchers.Remove(pair.Key);
            }
        }

        ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(_ => Rescan());
    }

    private readonly record struct WatchTarget(string Folder, string Filter, bool Recursive);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: `AppHost` 작성**

`src/AITokenUsage/AppHost.cs` (Task 15·16이 아래 텍스트를 기준으로 정확히 편집한다 — 공백까지 그대로 쓴다):

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Polling;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Providers;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Rotation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;

namespace AITokenUsage;

/// <summary>
/// Composition root. Owns settings, providers, polling, rotation and the app-level services.
/// Members are meant to be used on the UI thread unless stated otherwise.
/// </summary>
public sealed class AppHost : IAsyncDisposable
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan RotationTickInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250);
    public static readonly TimeSpan PendingWorkTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);

    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly DispatcherTimer _rotationTimer;
    private readonly ProviderPathWatcher _pathWatcher;
    private Task _backgroundChain = Task.CompletedTask;
    private int _refreshMinutes;
    private bool _started;
    private bool _shutdownRequested;
    private int _disposed;

    public AppHost(Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(dispatcher);
        Dispatcher = dispatcher;

        Log = new FileAppLog(AppPaths.LogDirectory);
        Log.Info($"AITokenUsage {typeof(AppHost).Assembly.GetName().Version} starting (pid {Environment.ProcessId})");

        // Startup only: settings are needed synchronously, before anything is attached to the taskbar.
        SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(AppPaths.SettingsFile, Log);
        Settings = SettingsStore.Load();
        _refreshMinutes = Settings.RefreshMinutes;

        _http = HttpClientFactory.Create();
        ProviderContext = new ProviderContext(
            _http,
            TimeProvider.System,
            new RealFileSystem(),
            new RealEnvironment(),
            new RealProcessRunner(),
            new WindowsCredentialStore(),
            new DpapiSecretStore(AppPaths.LocalDirectory),
            Log);
        Providers = ProviderCatalog.CreateAll(ProviderContext);

        Usage = new UsageService(
            Providers,
            () => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Volatile.Read(ref _refreshMinutes)),
            new SnapshotCache(AppPaths.CacheFile, Log),
            TimeProvider.System,
            Log);
        Usage.ViewChanged += OnUsageViewChanged;

        Rotation = new RotationController(TimeProvider.System);
        _rotationTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background, dispatcher) { Interval = RotationTickInterval };
        _rotationTimer.Tick += OnRotationTick;

        _pathWatcher = new ProviderPathWatcher(Providers, Usage.NotifyPathChanged, Log);
    }

    public Dispatcher Dispatcher { get; }

    public AppSettings Settings { get; }

    public SettingsStore SettingsStore { get; }

    public ProviderContext ProviderContext { get; }

    public IReadOnlyList<IUsageProvider> Providers { get; }

    public UsageService Usage { get; }

    public RotationController Rotation { get; }

    public IAppLog Log { get; }

    /// <summary>Raised on the UI thread at the end of ApplySettings.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? SettingsChanged;

    /// <summary>UsageService.ViewChanged marshalled to the UI thread (after Rotation.UpdateProviders).</summary>
    public event EventHandler<ProviderView>? ViewChanged;

    public void Start()
    {
        Dispatcher.VerifyAccess();
        if (_started || Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        _started = true;
        ConfigureRotation();
        Usage.Start();
        _pathWatcher.Start();
        _rotationTimer.Start();
        bool startWithWindows = Settings.StartWithWindows;
        QueueBackground(() => StartupRegistration.Apply(startWithWindows, Log));
        Log.Info("app host started");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Normalize → refresh interval (reschedule when changed) → rotation → save snapshot (background)
    /// → startup registry (background) → SettingsChanged.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplySettings()
    {
        Dispatcher.VerifyAccess();
        Settings.Normalize();

        // Only the UI thread writes _refreshMinutes, so this read is the previously applied value.
        int previousRefreshMinutes = Volatile.Read(ref _refreshMinutes);
        Volatile.Write(ref _refreshMinutes, Settings.RefreshMinutes);
        if (Settings.RefreshMinutes != previousRefreshMinutes)
        {
            Log.Info($"refresh interval changed {previousRefreshMinutes} → {Settings.RefreshMinutes} min; rescheduling");
            Usage.RescheduleAll();
        }

        ConfigureRotation();

        // Serialize a deep copy taken on the UI thread: the pool thread never reads the Settings object the UI edits.
        // Queued saves run in order, so the last ApplySettings' snapshot is what ends up on disk.
        AppSettings snapshot = Settings.Clone();
        QueueBackground(() => SettingsStore.Save(snapshot));
        bool startWithWindows = Settings.StartWithWindows;
        QueueBackground(() => StartupRegistration.Apply(startWithWindows, Log));

        SettingsChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>Settings order ∩ Enabled, as current views.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<ProviderView> EnabledViewsInOrder()
    {
        var result = new List<ProviderView>(Settings.Providers.Count);
        foreach (ProviderSettings provider in Settings.Providers)
        {
            if (provider.Enabled && Usage.GetView(provider.Id) is ProviderView view)
            {
                result.Add(view);
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    public async Task RefreshNowAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await Usage.RefreshNowAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Warn("manual refresh failed", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Opens the settings window. Reached from the second-instance signal and from a tray left click.
    /// Task 14: logs only. Task 19 replaces this body with the real SettingsWindow logic.
    /// </summary>
    public void OpenSettings()
    {
        Dispatcher.VerifyAccess();
        Log.Info("show-settings requested");
    }

    /// <summary>Disposes everything, then calls Application.Current.Shutdown(). Safe to call twice.</summary>
    public void Shutdown()
    {
        Dispatcher.VerifyAccess();
        if (_shutdownRequested)
        {
            return;
        }

        _shutdownRequested = true;
        Log.Info("shutdown requested");
        _ = ShutdownAsync();
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Everything before the first await runs synchronously on the caller (UI) thread.
        _rotationTimer.Stop();
        _rotationTimer.Tick -= OnRotationTick;
        Usage.ViewChanged -= OnUsageViewChanged;
        _pathWatcher.Dispose();

        await Usage.DisposeAsync();

        // The final settings save is the last item on the chain; wait for it (bounded) before flushing the log.
        Task pending = _backgroundChain;
        if (await Task.WhenAny(pending, Task.Delay(PendingWorkTimeout)) != pending)
        {
            Log.Warn("background settings work still pending at shutdown");
        }

        _http.Dispose();
        Log.Info("app host stopped");

        // After the final save: push buffered log lines (including the save result) to disk before the process exits.
        (Log as FileAppLog)?.Flush();
    }

    private async Task ShutdownAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await DisposeAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Error("error while shutting down", ex);
        }
        finally
        {
            Application.Current?.Shutdown();
        }
    }

    private void ConfigureRotation()
    {
        Rotation.Configure(Settings.RotationEnabled, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Settings.RotationSeconds), Settings.SkipUnavailable);
        Rotation.UpdateProviders(EnabledViewsInOrder());
    }

    /// <summary>Runs work on the thread pool, strictly after previously queued work. UI thread only.</summary>
    private void QueueBackground(Action work)
    {
        _backgroundChain = _backgroundChain.ContinueWith(
            _ => RunSafely(work),
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.None,
            TaskScheduler.Default);
    }

    private void RunSafely(Action work)
    {
        try
        {
            work();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Warn("background settings work failed", ex);
        }
    }

    private void OnUsageViewChanged(object? sender, ProviderView view)
    {
        // Raised on a background thread by UsageService.
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1 || Dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
        {
            return;
        }

        Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new Action(() => PublishView(view)));
    }

    private void PublishView(ProviderView view)
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        Rotation.UpdateProviders(EnabledViewsInOrder());
        ViewChanged?.Invoke(this, view);
    }

    private void OnRotationTick(object? sender, EventArgs e) => Rotation.OnTick();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 트레이 아이콘 렌더러와 컨트롤러 작성**

아이콘은 `SystemInformation.SmallIconSize`(최소 16px) 크기의 원에 현재 보이는 AI의 1줄 값을 흰 숫자로 그린다. 원 색은 위젯 바 규칙(브랜드 색 / 경고 `#F5A524` / 위험 `#F04438`)을 따르고, 이전 값이면 반투명, 값이 없으면 회색이다. `Bitmap.GetHicon()`으로 만든 HICON은 `Icon.FromHandle`이 소유하지 않으므로, 새 아이콘으로 교체한 **뒤** 이전 `Icon`을 Dispose하고 이전 HICON을 `DestroyIcon`으로 해제한다. 같은 아이콘 사양이면 다시 그리지 않는다.

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/TrayIconRenderer.cs`:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;
using Drawing = System.Drawing;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Draws the tray icon: a filled circle in the bar color with the line-1 number inside.</summary>
internal static class TrayIconRenderer
{
    public const int NoDataArgb = unchecked((int)0xFF6E6E6E);
    public const int WarningArgb = unchecked((int)0xFFF5A524);
    public const int CriticalArgb = unchecked((int)0xFFF04438);
    private const int StaleAlphaMask = unchecked((int)0x99000000);

    public readonly record struct IconSpec(string Text, int Argb);

    /// <summary>Brand colors from spec §2.1 (Task 17's ProviderGlyphs uses the same values).</summary>
    public static int BrandArgb(string providerId) => providerId switch
    {
        ProviderIds.Claude => unchecked((int)0xFFD97757),
        ProviderIds.Codex => unchecked((int)0xFF10A37F),
        ProviderIds.Gemini => unchecked((int)0xFF4285F4),
        ProviderIds.Copilot => unchecked((int)0xFF8957E5),
        _ => NoDataArgb,
    };

    public static IconSpec CreateSpec(ProviderView? view, UsageMeter? line1, ValueMode mode)
    {
        string text = TrayTextFormatter.IconText(line1, mode);
        if (view is null || line1?.UsedPercent is null)
        {
            return new IconSpec(text, NoDataArgb);
        }

        int argb = SeverityRules.Effective(line1) switch
        {
            Severity.Critical => CriticalArgb,
            Severity.Warning => WarningArgb,
            _ => BrandArgb(view.ProviderId),
        };

        if (view.IsStale)
        {
            argb = (argb & 0x00FFFFFF) | StaleAlphaMask;
        }

        return new IconSpec(text, argb);
    }

    public static Drawing.Bitmap DrawBitmap(IconSpec spec, int size)
    {
        var bitmap = new Drawing.Bitmap(size, size, Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
        using Drawing.Graphics graphics = Drawing.Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
        graphics.Clear(Drawing.Color.Transparent);
        graphics.SmoothingMode = Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
        graphics.TextRenderingHint = Drawing.Text.TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;

        using (var fill = new Drawing.SolidBrush(Drawing.Color.FromArgb(spec.Argb)))
        {
            graphics.FillEllipse(fill, 0.5f, 0.5f, size - 1f, size - 1f);
        }

        float fontPx = size * (spec.Text.Length >= 3 ? 0.40f : 0.56f);
        using var font = new Drawing.Font("Segoe UI", fontPx, Drawing.FontStyle.Bold, Drawing.GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
        using var format = new Drawing.StringFormat
        {
            Alignment = Drawing.StringAlignment.Center,
            LineAlignment = Drawing.StringAlignment.Center,
            FormatFlags = Drawing.StringFormatFlags.NoWrap | Drawing.StringFormatFlags.NoClip,
        };
        using var textBrush = new Drawing.SolidBrush(Drawing.Color.White);
        graphics.DrawString(spec.Text, font, textBrush, new Drawing.RectangleF(0, 0, size, size), format);
        return bitmap;
    }
}
```

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/TrayIconController.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Rotation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;
using Drawing = System.Drawing;
using Forms = System.Windows.Forms;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Tray icon with the current provider's line-1 value, a tooltip and the shared menu. UI thread only.</summary>
public sealed partial class TrayIconController : IDisposable
{
    private readonly AppHost _host;
    private readonly Forms.NotifyIcon _notifyIcon;
    private readonly Forms.ContextMenuStrip _menu;
    private readonly Forms.ToolStripMenuItem _pauseItem;
    private TrayIconRenderer.IconSpec? _lastSpec;
    private int _lastSize;
    private Drawing.Icon? _icon;
    private nint _hicon;
    private bool _disposed;

    public TrayIconController(AppHost host)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(host);
        _host = host;

        var refreshItem = new Forms.ToolStripMenuItem("지금 새로고침", null, (_, _) => { _ = _host.RefreshNowAsync(); });
        _pauseItem = new Forms.ToolStripMenuItem("자동 전환 일시정지", null, (_, _) => TogglePause());
        var exitItem = new Forms.ToolStripMenuItem("종료", null, (_, _) => _host.Shutdown());

        // Task 19 inserts "설정…" at index 0.
        _menu = new Forms.ContextMenuStrip();
        _menu.Items.AddRange(new Forms.ToolStripItem[] { refreshItem, _pauseItem, new Forms.ToolStripSeparator(), exitItem });
        _menu.Opening += OnMenuOpening;

        _notifyIcon = new Forms.NotifyIcon { ContextMenuStrip = _menu, Text = TrayTextFormatter.AppTitle };
        _notifyIcon.MouseClick += OnMouseClick;

        _host.ViewChanged += OnViewChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged += OnSettingsChanged;
        _host.Rotation.CurrentChanged += OnRotationChanged;

        Update();
        _notifyIcon.Visible = _host.Settings.ShowTrayIcon;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _host.ViewChanged -= OnViewChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged -= OnSettingsChanged;
        _host.Rotation.CurrentChanged -= OnRotationChanged;

        _notifyIcon.Visible = false;
        _notifyIcon.Dispose();
        _menu.Dispose();
        _icon?.Dispose();
        if (_hicon != 0)
        {
            DestroyIcon(_hicon);
            _hicon = 0;
        }
    }

    private void OnViewChanged(object? sender, ProviderView view) => Update();

    private void OnRotationChanged(object? sender, RotationChangedEventArgs e) => Update();

    private void OnSettingsChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _notifyIcon.Visible = _host.Settings.ShowTrayIcon;
        Update();
    }

    private void OnMenuOpening(object? sender, System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs e) =>
        _pauseItem.Checked = _host.Rotation.IsUserPaused;

    private void OnMouseClick(object? sender, Forms.MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Button == Forms.MouseButtons.Left)
        {
            _host.OpenSettings();
        }
    }

    private void TogglePause() => _host.Rotation.SetUserPaused(!_host.Rotation.IsUserPaused);

    private ProviderView? CurrentView()
    {
        string? id = _host.Rotation.CurrentId;
        ProviderView? view = id is null ? null : _host.Usage.GetView(id);
        return view ?? _host.EnabledViewsInOrder().FirstOrDefault();
    }

    private void Update()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        ProviderView? view = CurrentView();
        ProviderSettings? lines = view is null
            ? null
            : _host.Settings.Providers.FirstOrDefault(p => string.Equals(p.Id, view.ProviderId, StringComparison.Ordinal));
        ValueMode mode = _host.Settings.ValueMode;

        _notifyIcon.Text = TrayTextFormatter.Tooltip(view, lines, mode);

        UsageMeter? line1 = view is null ? null : TrayTextFormatter.SelectLine1(view, lines);
        TrayIconRenderer.IconSpec spec = TrayIconRenderer.CreateSpec(view, line1, mode);
        int size = Math.Max(16, Forms.SystemInformation.SmallIconSize.Width);
        if (_lastSpec == spec && _lastSize == size)
        {
            return;
        }

        SetIcon(spec, size);
        _lastSpec = spec;
        _lastSize = size;
    }

    private void SetIcon(TrayIconRenderer.IconSpec spec, int size)
    {
        using Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = TrayIconRenderer.DrawBitmap(spec, size);
        nint hicon = bitmap.GetHicon();
        Drawing.Icon icon = Drawing.Icon.FromHandle(hicon);
        _notifyIcon.Icon = icon;

        // Release the previous icon only after the shell has the new one.
        Drawing.Icon? oldIcon = _icon;
        nint oldHicon = _hicon;
        _icon = icon;
        _hicon = hicon;
        oldIcon?.Dispose();
        if (oldHicon != 0)
        {
            DestroyIcon(oldHicon);
        }
    }

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static partial bool DestroyIcon(nint hIcon);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: `App.xaml.cs` 교체**

`src/AITokenUsage/App.xaml.cs` 전체:

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using AITokenUsage.UI;

namespace AITokenUsage;

public partial class App : Application
{
    private SingleInstance? _instance;
    private AppHost? _host;
    private TrayIconController? _tray;

    protected override void OnStartup(StartupEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnStartup(e);

        _instance = SingleInstance.TryAcquire();
        if (_instance is null)
        {
            // Another instance owns the mutex and has been signalled to open its settings window.
            Shutdown(0);
            return;
        }

        AppHost host;
        try
        {
            host = new AppHost(Dispatcher);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            ReportStartupFailure(ex);
            Shutdown(1);
            return;
        }

        _host = host;
        HookGlobalExceptionHandlers(host.Log);
        _instance.StartListening(Dispatcher, host.OpenSettings);
        _tray = new TrayIconController(host);
        host.Start();
    }

    protected override void OnExit(ExitEventArgs e)
    {
        _tray?.Dispose();
        _instance?.Dispose();
        base.OnExit(e);
    }

    private void HookGlobalExceptionHandlers(IAppLog log)
    {
        DispatcherUnhandledException += (_, args) =>
        {
            log.Error("unhandled exception on the UI thread", args.Exception);
            args.Handled = true;
        };
        TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException += (_, args) =>
        {
            log.Warn("unobserved task exception", args.Exception);
            args.SetObserved();
        };
        AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException += (_, args) =>
            log.Error($"fatal unhandled exception (terminating: {args.IsTerminating})", args.ExceptionObject as Exception);
    }

    private static void ReportStartupFailure(Exception ex)
    {
        try
        {
            // FileAppLog writes on a background queue; Dispose flushes so the line lands before the process exits.
            using var log = new FileAppLog(AppPaths.LogDirectory);
            log.Error("startup failed", ex);
        }
        catch (Exception logError) when (logError is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            // Nothing else we can do; the message box below still tells the user.
        }

        MessageBox.Show(
            $"AI 사용량 위젯을 시작하지 못했습니다.\n로그: {AppPaths.LogDirectory}",
            "AI 사용량",
            MessageBoxButton.OK,
            MessageBoxImage.Error);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: `NativeMethods` 작성**

x64 전용(`GetWindowLongPtrW`)이다. 문자열은 `StringMarshalling.Utf16`, `bool` 반환은 `MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)`, 구조체는 모두 blittable(`MONITORINFOEXW.szDevice`는 `fixed ushort`)이라 `LibraryImport` 소스 생성기가 그대로 처리한다.

`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/NativeMethods.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>Win32 interop for taskbar embedding (research win11-taskbar-embedding.md §6). x64 only.</summary>
internal static unsafe partial class NativeMethods
{
    public const int GWL_STYLE = -16;
    public const int GWL_EXSTYLE = -20;

    public const uint WS_POPUP = 0x80000000;
    public const uint WS_CHILD = 0x40000000;
    public const uint WS_CLIPSIBLINGS = 0x04000000;
    public const uint WS_CAPTION = 0x00C00000;
    public const uint WS_SYSMENU = 0x00080000;
    public const uint WS_THICKFRAME = 0x00040000;
    public const uint WS_MINIMIZEBOX = 0x00020000;
    public const uint WS_MAXIMIZEBOX = 0x00010000;

    public const uint WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW = 0x00000080;
    public const uint WS_EX_APPWINDOW = 0x00040000;
    public const uint WS_EX_NOACTIVATE = 0x08000000;

    public const nint HWND_TOP = 0;

    public const uint SWP_NOSIZE = 0x0001;
    public const uint SWP_NOMOVE = 0x0002;
    public const uint SWP_NOZORDER = 0x0004;
    public const uint SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x0010;
    public const uint SWP_FRAMECHANGED = 0x0020;
    public const uint SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x0040;

    public const uint GA_PARENT = 1;
    public const int SW_HIDE = 0;

    public const int WM_SETTINGCHANGE = 0x001A;
    public const int WM_DISPLAYCHANGE = 0x007E;
    public const int WM_DPICHANGED = 0x02E0;
    public const uint SPI_SETWORKAREA = 0x002F;
    public const uint MSGFLT_ALLOW = 1;

    public const uint ABM_GETSTATE = 4;
    public const uint ABM_GETTASKBARPOS = 5;
    public const uint ABS_AUTOHIDE = 1;

    public const int QUNS_BUSY = 2;
    public const int QUNS_RUNNING_D3D_FULL_SCREEN = 3;
    public const int QUNS_PRESENTATION_MODE = 4;
    public const int QUNS_ACCEPTS_NOTIFICATIONS = 5;

    public const uint MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST = 2;
    public const uint MONITORINFOF_PRIMARY = 1;
    public const uint DWMWA_CLOAKED = 14;

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    public struct RECT
    {
        public int Left;
        public int Top;
        public int Right;
        public int Bottom;

        public readonly PixelRect ToPixelRect() => new(Left, Top, Right, Bottom);
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    public struct APPBARDATA
    {
        public uint cbSize;
        public nint hWnd;
        public uint uCallbackMessage;
        public uint uEdge;
        public RECT rc;
        public nint lParam;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    public struct MONITORINFOEXW
    {
        public uint cbSize;
        public RECT rcMonitor;
        public RECT rcWork;
        public uint dwFlags;
        public fixed ushort szDevice[32];
    }

    public readonly record struct MonitorDetails(PixelRect Bounds, PixelRect WorkArea, bool IsPrimary, string DeviceName);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "FindWindowExW", StringMarshalling = StringMarshalling.Utf16)]
    public static partial nint FindWindowEx(nint parent, nint childAfter, string? className, string? windowName);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(nint hwnd, out uint processId);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool GetWindowRect(nint hwnd, out RECT rect);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool IsWindow(nint hwnd);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool IsWindowVisible(nint hwnd);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool IsIconic(nint hwnd);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial uint GetDpiForWindow(nint hwnd);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial uint GetDpiForSystem();

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial nint MonitorFromWindow(nint hwnd, uint flags);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "GetMonitorInfoW")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool GetMonitorInfo(nint monitor, ref MONITORINFOEXW info);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    public static partial nint SetParent(nint child, nint newParent);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial nint GetAncestor(nint hwnd, uint flags);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "GetWindowLongPtrW")]
    public static partial nint GetWindowLongPtr(nint hwnd, int index);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "SetWindowLongPtrW", SetLastError = true)]
    public static partial nint SetWindowLongPtr(nint hwnd, int index, nint value);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool SetWindowPos(nint hwnd, nint insertAfter, int x, int y, int cx, int cy, uint flags);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool ShowWindow(nint hwnd, int command);

    /// <summary>On success the system owns the region; on failure the caller must DeleteObject it.</summary>
    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial int SetWindowRgn(nint hwnd, nint region, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] bool redraw);

    [LibraryImport("gdi32.dll")]
    public static partial nint CreateRectRgn(int left, int top, int right, int bottom);

    [LibraryImport("gdi32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool DeleteObject(nint gdiObject);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "RegisterWindowMessageW", StringMarshalling = StringMarshalling.Utf16)]
    public static partial uint RegisterWindowMessage(string name);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    public static partial bool ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(nint hwnd, uint message, uint action, nint changeFilterStruct);

    /// <summary>Sends a message to the taskbar: call only from background threads.</summary>
    [LibraryImport("shell32.dll")]
    public static partial nuint SHAppBarMessage(uint message, ref APPBARDATA data);

    [LibraryImport("shell32.dll")]
    public static partial int SHQueryUserNotificationState(out int state);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial nint GetForegroundWindow();

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial nint GetDesktopWindow();

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    public static partial nint GetShellWindow();

    [LibraryImport("dwmapi.dll")]
    public static partial int DwmGetWindowAttribute(nint hwnd, uint attribute, out int value, uint size);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "GetClassNameW")]
    private static partial int GetClassNameNative(nint hwnd, char* buffer, int maxCount);

    public static PixelRect? TryGetWindowRect(nint hwnd) =>
        hwnd != 0 && GetWindowRect(hwnd, out RECT rect) ? rect.ToPixelRect() : null;

    public static MonitorDetails? TryGetMonitorDetails(nint monitor)
    {
        if (monitor == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var info = new MONITORINFOEXW { cbSize = (uint)sizeof(MONITORINFOEXW) };
        if (!GetMonitorInfo(monitor, ref info))
        {
            return null;
        }

        string device = new((char*)info.szDevice);
        return new MonitorDetails(
            info.rcMonitor.ToPixelRect(),
            info.rcWork.ToPixelRect(),
            (info.dwFlags & MONITORINFOF_PRIMARY) != 0,
            device);
    }

    public static string GetClassName(nint hwnd)
    {
        char* buffer = stackalloc char[256];
        int length = GetClassNameNative(hwnd, buffer, 256);
        return length > 0 ? new string(buffer, 0, length) : string.Empty;
    }

    public static uint GetStyle(nint hwnd) => unchecked((uint)(long)GetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, GWL_STYLE));

    public static uint GetExStyle(nint hwnd) => unchecked((uint)(long)GetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE));

    public static void SetStyle(nint hwnd, uint style) => SetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, GWL_STYLE, (nint)style);

    public static void SetExStyle(nint hwnd, uint exStyle) => SetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, (nint)exStyle);

    /// <summary>Clips the window to (0,0,width,height); width/height 0 collapses it.</summary>
    public static void SetRectRegion(nint hwnd, int width, int height)
    {
        nint region = CreateRectRgn(0, 0, width, height);
        if (region != 0 && SetWindowRgn(hwnd, region, true) == 0)
        {
            DeleteObject(region);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

public enum TaskbarEdge
{
    Left = 0,
    Top = 1,
    Right = 2,
    Bottom = 3,
}

/// <summary>An explorer-owned taskbar window. Rectangles are physical screen pixels.</summary>
public sealed record TaskbarInfo(
    nint Handle,
    bool IsPrimary,
    PixelRect Bounds,
    uint Dpi,
    string? MonitorDeviceName,
    PixelRect MonitorBounds,
    bool IsWin11,
    TaskbarEdge Edge)
{
    public bool IsHorizontal => Edge is TaskbarEdge.Top or TaskbarEdge.Bottom;
}
```
