`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/TaskbarLocator.cs`:

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Finds explorer-owned Shell_TrayWnd / Shell_SecondaryTrayWnd windows (spec §4.1).
/// FindAll/Find send ABM_GETTASKBARPOS to explorer: call them from a background thread.
/// </summary>
public static class TaskbarLocator
{
    public const string PrimaryClass = "Shell_TrayWnd";
    public const string SecondaryClass = "Shell_SecondaryTrayWnd";
    public const string Win11BridgeClass = "Windows.UI.Composition.DesktopWindowContentBridge";

    /// <summary>Primary taskbar first, then secondary taskbars ordered by their left edge.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<TaskbarInfo> FindAll()
    {
        var result = new List<TaskbarInfo>();
        foreach (nint hwnd in EnumerateExplorerWindows(PrimaryClass))
        {
            if (Describe(hwnd, isPrimary: true) is TaskbarInfo primary)
            {
                result.Add(primary);
                break;
            }
        }

        var secondaries = new List<TaskbarInfo>();
        foreach (nint hwnd in EnumerateExplorerWindows(SecondaryClass))
        {
            if (Describe(hwnd, isPrimary: false) is TaskbarInfo secondary)
            {
                secondaries.Add(secondary);
            }
        }

        result.AddRange(secondaries.OrderBy(t => t.Bounds.Left));
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>The taskbar on the given monitor (e.g. @"\\.\DISPLAY2"); null or unknown device → primary taskbar.</summary>
    public static TaskbarInfo? Find(string? monitorDeviceName)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<TaskbarInfo> all = FindAll();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(monitorDeviceName))
        {
            foreach (TaskbarInfo taskbar in all)
            {
                if (string.Equals(taskbar.MonitorDeviceName, monitorDeviceName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return taskbar;
                }
            }
        }

        return all.FirstOrDefault(t => t.IsPrimary) ?? all.FirstOrDefault();
    }

    /// <summary>All top-level windows of the class owned by explorer.exe (replacement shells reuse the class name).</summary>
    public static IEnumerable<nint> EnumerateExplorerWindows(string className)
    {
        for (nint hwnd = NativeMethods.FindWindowEx(0, 0, className, null);
             hwnd != 0;
             hwnd = NativeMethods.FindWindowEx(0, hwnd, className, null))
        {
            if (IsExplorerWindow(hwnd))
            {
                yield return hwnd;
            }
        }
    }

    public static bool IsExplorerWindow(nint hwnd)
    {
        if (NativeMethods.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, out uint processId) == 0 || processId == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            using Process process = Process.GetProcessById((int)processId);
            return string.Equals(process.ProcessName, "explorer", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException or Win32Exception)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The Windows 11 XAML taskbar hosts a DesktopWindowContentBridge child.</summary>
    public static bool IsWin11Taskbar(nint taskbar) =>
        NativeMethods.FindWindowEx(taskbar, 0, Win11BridgeClass, null) != 0;

    public static string? GetMonitorDeviceName(nint hwnd) =>
        NativeMethods.TryGetMonitorDetails(NativeMethods.MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, NativeMethods.MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST))?.DeviceName;

    /// <summary>Edge from geometry alone: horizontal bars are Top/Bottom, vertical bars Left/Right.</summary>
    public static TaskbarEdge EdgeFromRect(PixelRect bounds, PixelRect monitor)
    {
        if (bounds.Width >= bounds.Height)
        {
            return bounds.Top - monitor.Top <= monitor.Bottom - bounds.Bottom ? TaskbarEdge.Top : TaskbarEdge.Bottom;
        }

        return bounds.Left - monitor.Left <= monitor.Right - bounds.Right ? TaskbarEdge.Left : TaskbarEdge.Right;
    }

    private static TaskbarInfo? Describe(nint hwnd, bool isPrimary)
    {
        if (NativeMethods.TryGetWindowRect(hwnd) is not PixelRect bounds || bounds.IsEmpty)
        {
            return null;
        }

        nint monitor = NativeMethods.MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, NativeMethods.MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
        NativeMethods.MonitorDetails? details = NativeMethods.TryGetMonitorDetails(monitor);
        PixelRect monitorBounds = details?.Bounds ?? bounds;
        TaskbarEdge edge = DetectEdge(hwnd, bounds, monitorBounds, isPrimary);
        return new TaskbarInfo(
            hwnd,
            isPrimary,
            bounds,
            NativeMethods.GetDpiForWindow(hwnd),
            details?.DeviceName,
            monitorBounds,
            IsWin11Taskbar(hwnd),
            edge);
    }

    /// <summary>ABM_GETTASKBARPOS (primary only) cross-checked with the rect aspect; the aspect wins on disagreement.</summary>
    private static TaskbarEdge DetectEdge(nint hwnd, PixelRect bounds, PixelRect monitor, bool isPrimary)
    {
        TaskbarEdge byRect = EdgeFromRect(bounds, monitor);
        if (!isPrimary)
        {
            return byRect;
        }

        var data = new NativeMethods.APPBARDATA
        {
            cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<NativeMethods.APPBARDATA>(),
            hWnd = hwnd,
        };
        if (NativeMethods.SHAppBarMessage(NativeMethods.ABM_GETTASKBARPOS, ref data) == 0 || data.uEdge > 3)
        {
            return byRect;
        }

        var reported = (TaskbarEdge)data.uEdge;
        bool reportedHorizontal = reported is TaskbarEdge.Top or TaskbarEdge.Bottom;
        bool rectHorizontal = bounds.Width >= bounds.Height;
        return reportedHorizontal == rectHorizontal ? reported : byRect;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: `ThemeWatcher` 작성**

레지스트리 읽기는 백그라운드(`System.Threading.Timer` 2초 + `Refresh()` 요청)에서 하고, 값이 바뀌었을 때만 `Dispatcher.BeginInvoke`로 UI 스레드에서 속성을 바꾸고 `Changed`를 올린다. 생성자의 첫 읽기 1회만 UI 스레드에서 한다(작업 표시줄 부착 전).

`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/ThemeWatcher.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Security;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Taskbar (SystemUsesLightTheme) and app (AppsUseLightTheme) light/dark mode (spec §4.6).
/// Updated on WM_SETTINGCHANGE "ImmersiveColorSet" (via Refresh) and by a 2 s registry poll.
/// Properties change and Changed is raised on the UI thread only.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ThemeWatcher : IDisposable
{
    public const string PersonalizeKeyPath = @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize";
    public static readonly TimeSpan PollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    private readonly Dispatcher _dispatcher;
    private readonly IAppLog _log;
    private readonly Timer _timer;
    private int _disposed;

    public ThemeWatcher(Dispatcher dispatcher, IAppLog log)
    {
        _dispatcher = dispatcher;
        _log = log;
        (IsTaskbarLight, IsAppLight) = ReadTheme();
        _timer = new Timer(_ => Poll(), null, PollInterval, PollInterval);
    }

    /// <summary>True when the taskbar is light (SystemUsesLightTheme = 1). Absent or 0 → dark.</summary>
    public bool IsTaskbarLight { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>True when apps use the light theme (AppsUseLightTheme ≠ 0). Absent → light (Windows default).</summary>
    public bool IsAppLight { get; private set; }

    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    /// <summary>Re-reads the registry on a pool thread (call on ImmersiveColorSet).</summary>
    public void Refresh()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 0)
        {
            ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(_ => Poll());
        }
    }

    public static (bool TaskbarLight, bool AppLight) ReadTheme()
    {
        try
        {
            using RegistryKey? key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(PersonalizeKeyPath);
            bool taskbarLight = key?.GetValue("SystemUsesLightTheme") is int system && system != 0;
            bool appLight = key?.GetValue("AppsUseLightTheme") is not int apps || apps != 0;
            return (taskbarLight, appLight);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is SecurityException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            return (false, true);
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        _timer.Dispose();
    }

    private void Poll()
    {
        try
        {
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1 || _dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
            {
                return;
            }

            (bool taskbarLight, bool appLight) = ReadTheme();
            if (taskbarLight == IsTaskbarLight && appLight == IsAppLight)
            {
                return;
            }

            _dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new Action(() => Apply(taskbarLight, appLight)));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("theme poll failed", ex);
        }
    }

    private void Apply(bool taskbarLight, bool appLight)
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1 || (taskbarLight == IsTaskbarLight && appLight == IsAppLight))
        {
            return;
        }

        IsTaskbarLight = taskbarLight;
        IsAppLight = appLight;
        _log.Info($"theme changed: taskbarLight={taskbarLight}, appLight={appLight}");
        Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: `ShellEventWindow` 작성**

메시지 전용 창(`HWND_MESSAGE`)은 브로드캐스트를 받지 못하므로 숨겨진 **최상위** `WS_POPUP` `HwndSource`(크기 0, `WS_VISIBLE` 없음)를 만든다. 훅 대리자는 필드에 붙잡아 GC되지 않게 한다. 관리자 권한으로 실행된 경우를 위해 `TaskbarCreated`를 UIPI 필터에서 허용한다(비관리자에서는 무해). 창 제목 `AITokenUsage.ShellEvents`는 수동 확인 스크립트가 이 창만 골라 메시지를 보내는 데 쓴다.

`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/ShellEventWindow.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Hidden top-level WS_POPUP window that receives shell broadcasts (spec §4.4). Create on the UI thread;
/// events are raised on the UI thread.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ShellEventWindow : IDisposable
{
    public const string WindowName = "AITokenUsage.ShellEvents";

    private readonly IAppLog _log;
    private readonly HwndSource _source;
    private readonly HwndSourceHook _hook;
    private readonly uint _taskbarCreatedMessage;
    private bool _disposed;

    public ShellEventWindow(IAppLog log)
    {
        _log = log;
        _taskbarCreatedMessage = NativeMethods.RegisterWindowMessage("TaskbarCreated");

        var parameters = new HwndSourceParameters(WindowName)
        {
            WindowStyle = unchecked((int)NativeMethods.WS_POPUP),
            ExtendedWindowStyle = (int)NativeMethods.WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW,
            ParentWindow = 0,
            PositionX = 0,
            PositionY = 0,
            Width = 0,
            Height = 0,
        };
        _source = new HwndSource(parameters);
        _hook = WndProc;
        _source.AddHook(_hook);

        if (_taskbarCreatedMessage != 0)
        {
            NativeMethods.ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(_source.Handle, _taskbarCreatedMessage, NativeMethods.MSGFLT_ALLOW, 0);
        }

        _log.Info($"shell event window created (hwnd=0x{(long)_source.Handle:X})");
    }

    public nint Handle => _source.Handle;

    /// <summary>Explorer restarted (or the primary display DPI changed).</summary>
    public event EventHandler? TaskbarCreated;

    /// <summary>WM_DISPLAYCHANGE or WM_DPICHANGED.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? DisplayChanged;

    /// <summary>WM_SETTINGCHANGE with lParam "ImmersiveColorSet" (may arrive several times; handle idempotently).</summary>
    public event EventHandler? ImmersiveColorSetChanged;

    /// <summary>WM_SETTINGCHANGE "TraySettings" or SPI_SETWORKAREA: taskbar alignment/size may have changed.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? TaskbarSettingsChanged;

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _source.RemoveHook(_hook);
        _source.Dispose();
    }

    private nint WndProc(nint hwnd, int msg, nint wParam, nint lParam, ref bool handled)
    {
        if (_taskbarCreatedMessage != 0 && msg == (int)_taskbarCreatedMessage)
        {
            _log.Info("shell: TaskbarCreated");
            Raise(TaskbarCreated);
        }
        else if (msg is NativeMethods.WM_DISPLAYCHANGE or NativeMethods.WM_DPICHANGED)
        {
            _log.Info(msg == NativeMethods.WM_DISPLAYCHANGE ? "shell: display changed (WM_DISPLAYCHANGE)" : "shell: display changed (WM_DPICHANGED)");
            Raise(DisplayChanged);
        }
        else if (msg == NativeMethods.WM_SETTINGCHANGE)
        {
            string? area = lParam != 0 ? Marshal.PtrToStringUni(lParam) : null;
            if (string.Equals(area, "ImmersiveColorSet", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                _log.Info("shell: ImmersiveColorSet");
                Raise(ImmersiveColorSetChanged);
            }
            else if (string.Equals(area, "TraySettings", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                     || unchecked((uint)(long)wParam) == NativeMethods.SPI_SETWORKAREA)
            {
                _log.Info("shell: taskbar settings changed");
                Raise(TaskbarSettingsChanged);
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private void Raise(EventHandler? handler)
    {
        if (_disposed || handler is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            handler(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Error("shell event handler failed", ex);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    private void OnImmersiveColorSetChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => Theme.Refresh();

    /// <summary>Background thread: logs every explorer-owned taskbar (manual verification aid).</summary>
    private void LogTaskbarDiagnostics()
    {
        try
        {
            IReadOnlyList<TaskbarInfo> taskbars = TaskbarLocator.FindAll();
            if (taskbars.Count == 0)
            {
                Log.Warn("diagnostics: no explorer-owned taskbar found");
                return;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < taskbars.Count; i++)
            {
                TaskbarInfo t = taskbars[i];
                Log.Info(
                    $"diagnostics: taskbar[{i}] hwnd=0x{(long)t.Handle:X} primary={t.IsPrimary} " +
                    $"rect=({t.Bounds.Left},{t.Bounds.Top},{t.Bounds.Right},{t.Bounds.Bottom}) dpi={t.Dpi} " +
                    $"monitor={t.MonitorDeviceName ?? "?"} win11={t.IsWin11} edge={t.Edge}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Warn("diagnostics: taskbar enumeration failed", ex);
        }
    }
```

### Task 16: `TaskbarGeometryReader`, `FullscreenWatcher`, `TaskbarHost`, 최소 `WidgetWindow`

위젯 창을 Win11 작업 표시줄의 자식 창으로 붙이고(spec §4.2), 500ms 조정 루프로 배치하며(§4.3), 탐색기 재시작·DPI 변경·모니터 분리 때 새로 만들고(§4.4), 부착에 실패하면 작업 표시줄이 소유하는 overlay 창으로 대체한다(§4.5). 이 Task의 `WidgetWindow`는 "AI 사용량" 글자 하나만 있는 **실제 최소 UI**이며, Task 17이 2줄 미니바로 확장한다.

**동작 요약 (TaskbarHost)**

| 단계 | 처리 |
|---|---|
| 시작·재생성 | 세대 번호를 올리고 기존 창을 닫음 → (지연) → 백그라운드에서 `TaskbarLocator.Find(설정 모니터)` → 없으면 10초 뒤 재시도 → `TaskbarGeometryReader.SetTaskbar` → UIA가 StartButton/앱 버튼을 볼 때까지 1초 간격, 최대 15초 대기 → 기준 DPI 저장 → 부착 |
| 자식 부착 | 창을 작업 표시줄 모니터 위치에 미리 두고 `EnsureHandle` → 스타일 `-POPUP/CAPTION/THICKFRAME/SYSMENU/MIN/MAX +CHILD/CLIPSIBLINGS` → 확장 `+TOOLWINDOW/NOACTIVATE -APPWINDOW`(LAYERED 안 건드림) → 빈 영역 → `SetParent` → `GetAncestor(GA_PARENT)` 확인 → `SWP_FRAMECHANGED` → `Show()` |
| overlay | Win11 작업 표시줄이 아니거나 부착 실패 시. `WindowInteropHelper.Owner = taskbar`를 `Show()` 전에 설정, 화면 좌표로 배치, 전체 화면(`FullscreenWatcher`)·자동 숨김이면 숨김, 10초마다 자식 부착 재시도(성공해야만 overlay 창을 닫으므로 깜박이지 않음) |
| 조정 루프 500ms | 작업 표시줄·위젯 HWND가 죽었으면 1초 뒤 재생성 / 자식 모드에서 작업 표시줄 DPI가 기준과 다르면 숨기고 1초 뒤 재생성 / 부모가 바뀌었으면 `SetParent` 재시도(6회 연속 실패 시 overlay) / 배치 계산 → null이면 숨김 / 계산 결과·실제 `GetWindowRect`가 같으면 아무것도 안 함, 다르면 루트 DIP 크기 → `SetWindowPos(HWND_TOP, NOACTIVATE|SHOWWINDOW)` → `SetWindowRgn` |
| 이벤트 | `TaskbarCreated` → 1초 뒤 재생성. `DisplayChanged` → UIA 갱신 + 즉시 재배치 + 선택된 작업 표시줄이 바뀌었는지 백그라운드 확인. `TaskbarSettingsChanged` → UIA 갱신 + 재배치. 설정의 모니터가 바뀌면 즉시 재생성, 그 외 설정 변경은 재배치. 창 `Closed`(탐색기가 HWND 파괴) → 1초 뒤 재생성 |

- [ ] **Step 1: 실패하는 테스트 작성 — `TaskbarButtonGrouping`**

앱 버튼 사각형 목록에서 "Start 오른쪽에서 시작하는 연속 그룹 하나"만 고르는 규칙은 순수 함수라 Core에서 먼저 고정한다. 수치는 research §0 기준(작업 표시줄 `(0,1032,1920,1080)`, Start `(718..763)`, 버튼 폭 44, 96 DPI)이다.

`tests/AITokenUsage.Core.Tests/Taskbar/TaskbarButtonGroupingTests.cs`:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;
using Xunit;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Taskbar;

public class TaskbarButtonGroupingTests
{
    private const int Gap96 = TaskbarButtonGrouping.MaxGapAt96Dpi;

    private static PixelRect Button(int left, int width = 44) => new(left, 1032, left + width, 1080);

    [Fact]
    public void ContiguousButtons_InAnyOrder_AreUnionedFromStartRight()
    {
        PixelRect[] buttons = [Button(851), Button(763), Button(895), Button(807)];

        Assert.Equal(new PixelRect(763, 1032, 939, 1080), TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(buttons, 763, Gap96));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsolatedOverflowButtonFarRight_IsExcluded()
    {
        PixelRect[] buttons = [Button(763), Button(807), Button(851), Button(1580)];

        Assert.Equal(new PixelRect(763, 1032, 895, 1080), TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(buttons, 763, Gap96));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GapOfMaxGap_Joins_LargerGap_Stops()
    {
        // 763..807, gap 16 → 823..867 joins; gap 17 → 884..928 does not.
        PixelRect[] buttons = [Button(763), Button(823), Button(884)];

        Assert.Equal(new PixelRect(763, 1032, 867, 1080), TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(buttons, 763, Gap96));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ButtonsLeftOfStartRight_AreSkipped()
    {
        PixelRect[] buttons = [Button(700), Button(763), Button(807)];

        Assert.Equal(new PixelRect(763, 1032, 851, 1080), TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(buttons, 763, Gap96));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NullStartRight_StartsFromTheLeftmostButton()
    {
        PixelRect[] buttons = [Button(101), Button(900), Button(57)];

        Assert.Equal(new PixelRect(57, 1032, 145, 1080), TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(buttons, null, Gap96));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NoButtonAtOrAfterStartRight_ReturnsNull()
    {
        Assert.Null(TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous([Button(57), Button(101)], 763, Gap96));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmptyList_ReturnsNull()
    {
        Assert.Null(TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous([], 763, Gap96));
        Assert.Null(TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous([], null, Gap96));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: `TaskbarButtonGrouping` 구현**

`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Taskbar/TaskbarButtonGrouping.cs`:

```csharp
namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Picks the app-button group out of every Taskbar.TaskListButtonAutomationPeer rectangle. A plain union would also
/// swallow buttons that sit apart from the group (e.g. an overflow button far right) and push BeforeTray's left
/// boundary towards the tray.
/// </summary>
public static class TaskbarButtonGrouping
{
    /// <summary>Largest gap between neighbouring buttons of one group at 96 DPI. Callers scale it by dpi / 96.</summary>
    public const int MaxGapAt96Dpi = 16;

    /// <summary>
    /// Sorts by Left, starts at the first button whose Left is at or after <paramref name="startRight"/> (the leftmost
    /// button when null) and unions neighbours while the gap to the next one is at most <paramref name="maxGap"/> px.
    /// Null when there is no starting button.
    /// </summary>
    public static PixelRect? GroupContiguous(IReadOnlyList<PixelRect> buttons, int? startRight, int maxGap)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(buttons);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(maxGap);

        PixelRect[] sorted = buttons.OrderBy(b => b.Left).ThenBy(b => b.Right).ToArray();
        int first = startRight is int start
            ? Array.FindIndex(sorted, b => b.Left >= start)
            : (sorted.Length > 0 ? 0 : -1);
        if (first < 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        PixelRect group = sorted[first];
        for (int i = first + 1; i < sorted.Length; i++)
        {
            PixelRect next = sorted[i];
            if (next.Left - group.Right > maxGap)
            {
                break;
            }

            group = new PixelRect(
                Math.Min(group.Left, next.Left),
                Math.Min(group.Top, next.Top),
                Math.Max(group.Right, next.Right),
                Math.Max(group.Bottom, next.Bottom));
        }

        return group;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: `TaskbarGeometryReader` 작성**

UIA(`System.Windows.Automation`, WPF 공유 프레임워크의 UIAutomationClient)는 **전용 MTA 백그라운드 스레드 하나**에서만 부른다. 3초마다 또는 `RequestRefresh()`가 깨울 때 한 번에 `FindAll(Descendants)`를 `CacheRequest`(AutomationId, ClassName, BoundingRectangle, IsOffscreen, ProcessId)로 읽고 스냅샷을 원자적으로 바꾼다. 루트는 캐시 활성화 **전에** 얻는다(`AutomationElementMode.None` 요소로는 Find를 못 함). 우리 프로세스의 요소(작업 표시줄 자식이 된 위젯)는 건너뛴다. `Taskbar.TaskListButtonAutomationPeer` 사각형은 목록으로 모은 뒤 `TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(buttons, start?.Right, maxGap)`로 Start 오른쪽의 연속 그룹 하나만 `AppButtons`로 쓴다(`maxGap = round(16 × dpi / 96)`, dpi는 `GetDpiForWindow(taskbar)`, 0이면 96). UI 스레드의 `GetGeometry()`는 메시지를 보내지 않는 값싼 호출(`GetWindowRect`, `FindWindowEx`, `GetDpiForWindow`)과 캐시만 쓴다. 숨겨진 `Start` HWND가 UIA StartButton과 2px 넘게 다르면(가운데 그룹이 움직임) HWND 값을 즉시 쓰고 UIA 갱신을 요청한다. 자동 갱신 요청은 1초에 한 번으로 제한한다.

`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/TaskbarGeometryReader.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Security;
using System.Windows.Automation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Taskbar geometry for TaskbarLayoutCalculator (spec §4.3). UI Automation runs only on a dedicated background
/// MTA thread (every 3 s or on request); GetGeometry() combines that cache with cheap HWND rects on the UI thread.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TaskbarGeometryReader : IDisposable
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan RefreshInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);
    public static readonly TimeSpan MinAutoRequestSpacing = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    public const int StartMoveTolerancePx = 2;

    private const string AdvancedKeyPath = @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced";
    private const string TaskListButtonClass = "Taskbar.TaskListButtonAutomationPeer";
    private static readonly TimeSpan FailureLogSpacing = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);

    private readonly IAppLog _log;
    private readonly Thread _thread;
    private readonly AutoResetEvent _wake = new(false);
    private readonly ManualResetEvent _stop = new(false);
    private nint _taskbar;
    private UiaSnapshot? _snapshot;
    private volatile bool _isCentered = true;
    private volatile bool _widgetsEnabled = true;
    private long _lastAutoRequestMs = long.MinValue / 2;
    private long _lastFailureLogMs = long.MinValue / 2;
    private int _disposed;

    public TaskbarGeometryReader(IAppLog log)
    {
        _log = log;
        _thread = new Thread(Run) { IsBackground = true, Name = "AITokenUsage.TaskbarUIA" };
        _thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.MTA);
        _thread.Start();
    }

    /// <summary>True once UIA reported the Start button or app buttons for the current taskbar.</summary>
    public bool IsLayoutReady
    {
        get
        {
            UiaSnapshot? snapshot = Volatile.Read(ref _snapshot);
            return snapshot is not null
                && snapshot.Taskbar == Volatile.Read(ref _taskbar)
                && (snapshot.Start is not null || snapshot.AppButtons is not null);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Switches the target taskbar, drops the old cache and wakes the UIA thread.</summary>
    public void SetTaskbar(nint taskbar)
    {
        Volatile.Write(ref _taskbar, taskbar);
        Volatile.Write(ref _snapshot, null);
        RequestRefresh();
    }

    public void RequestRefresh()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 0)
        {
            _wake.Set();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>UI thread. Never sends messages to explorer; uses the cached UIA snapshot.</summary>
    public TaskbarGeometry? GetGeometry()
    {
        nint taskbar = Volatile.Read(ref _taskbar);
        if (taskbar == 0 || NativeMethods.TryGetWindowRect(taskbar) is not PixelRect bounds || bounds.IsEmpty)
        {
            return null;
        }

        uint dpi = NativeMethods.GetDpiForWindow(taskbar);
        UiaSnapshot? snapshot = Volatile.Read(ref _snapshot);
        if (snapshot is null || snapshot.Taskbar != taskbar || snapshot.TaskbarRect != bounds)
        {
            RequestRefreshThrottled();
            snapshot = null;
        }

        PixelRect? start = snapshot?.Start;
        if (ValidChildRect(taskbar, "Start", bounds) is PixelRect cheapStart)
        {
            if (start is PixelRect uiaStart && Math.Abs(uiaStart.Left - cheapStart.Left) > StartMoveTolerancePx)
            {
                // The centered group moved (apps opened/closed): trust the hidden Start HWND now, refresh UIA soon.
                RequestRefreshThrottled();
                start = cheapStart;
            }

            start ??= cheapStart;
        }

        PixelRect? tray = snapshot?.Tray ?? ValidChildRect(taskbar, "TrayNotifyWnd", bounds);
        PixelRect? widgets = _widgetsEnabled ? snapshot?.Widgets : null;
        return new TaskbarGeometry(
            bounds,
            dpi,
            bounds.Width > bounds.Height,
            _isCentered,
            start,
            widgets,
            snapshot?.AppButtons,
            tray);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        // The UIA thread disposes the wait handles itself when it exits; never block the UI thread on it
        // (it may be inside a UIA call that needs this UI thread).
        _stop.Set();
    }

    private void Run()
    {
        WaitHandle[] handles = [_stop, _wake];
        try
        {
            while (true)
            {
                nint taskbar = Volatile.Read(ref _taskbar);
                if (taskbar != 0)
                {
                    ReadRegistry();
                    UiaSnapshot? snapshot = ReadSnapshot(taskbar);
                    if (snapshot is not null && Volatile.Read(ref _taskbar) == taskbar)
                    {
                        Volatile.Write(ref _snapshot, snapshot);
                    }
                }

                if (WaitHandle.WaitAny(handles, RefreshInterval) == 0)
                {
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _wake.Dispose();
            _stop.Dispose();
        }
    }

    private UiaSnapshot? ReadSnapshot(nint taskbar)
    {
        try
        {
            if (!NativeMethods.IsWindow(taskbar)
                || NativeMethods.TryGetWindowRect(taskbar) is not PixelRect bounds
                || bounds.IsEmpty)
            {
                return null;
            }

            PixelRect? start = null;
            PixelRect? widgets = null;
            PixelRect? tray = null;
            var appButtons = new List<PixelRect>();
            int ownProcessId = Environment.ProcessId;

            var cache = new CacheRequest { AutomationElementMode = AutomationElementMode.None, TreeScope = TreeScope.Element };
            cache.Add(AutomationElement.AutomationIdProperty);
            cache.Add(AutomationElement.ClassNameProperty);
            cache.Add(AutomationElement.BoundingRectangleProperty);
            cache.Add(AutomationElement.IsOffscreenProperty);
            cache.Add(AutomationElement.ProcessIdProperty);

            // The root must be a live element (mode Full) so that FindAll can run on it.
            AutomationElement root = AutomationElement.FromHandle(taskbar);
            AutomationElementCollection elements;
            using (cache.Activate())
            {
                elements = root.FindAll(TreeScope.Descendants, Condition.TrueCondition);
            }

            foreach (AutomationElement element in elements)
            {
                AutomationElement.AutomationElementInformation info = element.Cached;
                if (info.ProcessId == ownProcessId || info.IsOffscreen)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ToPixelRect(info.BoundingRectangle) is not PixelRect rect || !IsValid(rect, bounds))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                switch (info.AutomationId)
                {
                    case "StartButton":
                        start = rect;
                        break;
                    case "WidgetsButton":
                        widgets = rect;
                        break;
                    case "SystemTrayIcon":
                    case "NotifyItemIcon":
                        tray = Union(tray, rect);
                        break;
                    default:
                        if (string.Equals(info.ClassName, TaskListButtonClass, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                        {
                            appButtons.Add(rect);
                        }

                        break;
                }
            }

            // Only the contiguous group right of Start; a far-away button (overflow etc.) must not widen AppButtons.
            uint dpi = NativeMethods.GetDpiForWindow(taskbar);
            int maxGap = (int)Math.Round(TaskbarButtonGrouping.MaxGapAt96Dpi * (dpi == 0 ? 96 : dpi) / 96.0);
            PixelRect? apps = TaskbarButtonGrouping.GroupContiguous(appButtons, start?.Right, maxGap);

            return new UiaSnapshot(taskbar, bounds, start, widgets, apps, tray);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            LogFailure(ex);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private void ReadRegistry()
    {
        try
        {
            using RegistryKey? key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(AdvancedKeyPath);
            _isCentered = key?.GetValue("TaskbarAl") is not int alignment || alignment != 0;
            _widgetsEnabled = key?.GetValue("TaskbarDa") is not int widgets || widgets != 0;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is SecurityException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            LogFailure(ex);
        }
    }

    private void RequestRefreshThrottled()
    {
        long now = Environment.TickCount64;
        if (now - _lastAutoRequestMs < (long)MinAutoRequestSpacing.TotalMilliseconds)
        {
            return;
        }

        _lastAutoRequestMs = now;
        RequestRefresh();
    }

    private void LogFailure(Exception ex)
    {
        long now = Environment.TickCount64;
        if (now - Interlocked.Read(ref _lastFailureLogMs) < (long)FailureLogSpacing.TotalMilliseconds)
        {
            return;
        }

        Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastFailureLogMs, now);
        _log.Warn("taskbar UIA read failed (HWND fallbacks are used)", ex);
    }

    private static PixelRect? ValidChildRect(nint taskbar, string className, PixelRect bounds)
    {
        nint child = NativeMethods.FindWindowEx(taskbar, 0, className, null);
        return NativeMethods.TryGetWindowRect(child) is PixelRect rect && IsValid(rect, bounds) ? rect : null;
    }

    private static bool IsValid(PixelRect rect, PixelRect taskbar) => !rect.IsEmpty && rect.IsInside(taskbar);

    private static PixelRect? ToPixelRect(System.Windows.Rect rect)
    {
        if (rect.IsEmpty || double.IsInfinity(rect.Width) || double.IsInfinity(rect.Height) || rect.Width <= 0 || rect.Height <= 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return new PixelRect(
            (int)Math.Round(rect.Left),
            (int)Math.Round(rect.Top),
            (int)Math.Round(rect.Right),
            (int)Math.Round(rect.Bottom));
    }

    private static PixelRect Union(PixelRect? current, PixelRect add) => current is PixelRect c
        ? new PixelRect(Math.Min(c.Left, add.Left), Math.Min(c.Top, add.Top), Math.Max(c.Right, add.Right), Math.Max(c.Bottom, add.Bottom))
        : add;

    private sealed record UiaSnapshot(
        nint Taskbar,
        PixelRect TaskbarRect,
        PixelRect? Start,
        PixelRect? Widgets,
        PixelRect? AppButtons,
        PixelRect? Tray);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: `FullscreenWatcher` 작성**

overlay 모드에서만 돈다. 2초마다 스레드 풀에서 `SHQueryUserNotificationState`(2·3·4면 전체 화면), TrafficMonitor 방식의 전경 창 검사(같은 모니터를 완전히 덮는지, 바탕 화면·셸·`WorkerW`·`Progman`·작업 표시줄·우리 프로세스·숨김·최소화·cloaked 창 제외), `ABM_GETSTATE & ABS_AUTOHIDE`를 읽는다. `SHAppBarMessage`는 explorer에 메시지를 보내므로 UI 스레드에서 부르지 않는다. 결과가 바뀌면 UI 스레드에서 속성을 바꾸고 `Changed`를 올린다.

`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/FullscreenWatcher.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Overlay-mode helper (spec §4.5): fullscreen detection and taskbar auto-hide state, polled every 2 s on the
/// thread pool. Properties change and Changed is raised on the UI thread.
/// </summary>
public sealed class FullscreenWatcher : IDisposable
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan PollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    private readonly Dispatcher _dispatcher;
    private readonly IAppLog _log;
    private readonly Timer _timer;
    private nint _taskbar;
    private int _polling;
    private int _disposed;

    public FullscreenWatcher(Dispatcher dispatcher, IAppLog log)
    {
        _dispatcher = dispatcher;
        _log = log;
        _timer = new Timer(_ => Poll(), null, Timeout.Infinite, Timeout.Infinite);
    }

    public bool IsFullscreenActive { get; private set; }

    public bool IsTaskbarAutoHide { get; private set; }

    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    /// <summary>UI thread. Starts polling for the monitor of the given taskbar.</summary>
    public void Start(nint taskbar)
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        Volatile.Write(ref _taskbar, taskbar);
        _timer.Change(TimeSpan.Zero, PollInterval);
    }

    /// <summary>UI thread. Stops polling and clears the state.</summary>
    public void Stop()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        _timer.Change(Timeout.Infinite, Timeout.Infinite);
        Volatile.Write(ref _taskbar, 0);
        IsFullscreenActive = false;
        IsTaskbarAutoHide = false;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        _timer.Dispose();
    }

    private void Poll()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _polling, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            nint taskbar = Volatile.Read(ref _taskbar);
            if (taskbar == 0 || Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1 || _dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
            {
                return;
            }

            bool fullscreen = IsNotificationStateBusy() || ForegroundCoversMonitor(taskbar);
            bool autoHide = IsAutoHideEnabled();
            if (fullscreen == IsFullscreenActive && autoHide == IsTaskbarAutoHide)
            {
                return;
            }

            _dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new Action(() => Apply(taskbar, fullscreen, autoHide)));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("fullscreen poll failed", ex);
        }
        finally
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _polling, 0);
        }
    }

    private void Apply(nint taskbar, bool fullscreen, bool autoHide)
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1 || Volatile.Read(ref _taskbar) != taskbar)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (fullscreen == IsFullscreenActive && autoHide == IsTaskbarAutoHide)
        {
            return;
        }

        IsFullscreenActive = fullscreen;
        IsTaskbarAutoHide = autoHide;
        _log.Info($"overlay state: fullscreen={fullscreen}, autoHide={autoHide}");
        Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>Machine-wide QUNS_BUSY / QUNS_RUNNING_D3D_FULL_SCREEN / QUNS_PRESENTATION_MODE.</summary>
    private static bool IsNotificationStateBusy()
    {
        int hr = NativeMethods.SHQueryUserNotificationState(out int state);
        return hr == 0 && state is NativeMethods.QUNS_BUSY or NativeMethods.QUNS_RUNNING_D3D_FULL_SCREEN or NativeMethods.QUNS_PRESENTATION_MODE;
    }

    private static bool IsAutoHideEnabled()
    {
        var data = new NativeMethods.APPBARDATA { cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<NativeMethods.APPBARDATA>() };
        return ((uint)NativeMethods.SHAppBarMessage(NativeMethods.ABM_GETSTATE, ref data) & NativeMethods.ABS_AUTOHIDE) != 0;
    }

    /// <summary>TrafficMonitor-style per-monitor check plus the ManagedShell exclusions that matter on Windows 11.</summary>
    private static bool ForegroundCoversMonitor(nint taskbar)
    {
        nint foreground = NativeMethods.GetForegroundWindow();
        if (foreground == 0 || foreground == NativeMethods.GetDesktopWindow() || foreground == NativeMethods.GetShellWindow())
        {
            return false;
        }

        NativeMethods.GetWindowThreadProcessId(foreground, out uint processId);
        if (processId == (uint)Environment.ProcessId)
        {
            return false;
        }

        string className = NativeMethods.GetClassName(foreground);
        if (className is "WorkerW" or "Progman" or TaskbarLocator.PrimaryClass or TaskbarLocator.SecondaryClass)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!NativeMethods.IsWindowVisible(foreground) || NativeMethods.IsIconic(foreground))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (NativeMethods.DwmGetWindowAttribute(foreground, NativeMethods.DWMWA_CLOAKED, out int cloaked, sizeof(int)) == 0 && cloaked != 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        nint monitor = NativeMethods.MonitorFromWindow(taskbar, NativeMethods.MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
        if (NativeMethods.MonitorFromWindow(foreground, NativeMethods.MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST) != monitor)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (NativeMethods.TryGetMonitorDetails(monitor) is not NativeMethods.MonitorDetails details
            || NativeMethods.TryGetWindowRect(foreground) is not PixelRect rect)
        {
            return false;
        }

        PixelRect screen = details.Bounds;
        return rect.Left <= screen.Left && rect.Top <= screen.Top && rect.Right >= screen.Right && rect.Bottom >= screen.Bottom;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: `TaskbarHost` 작성**

비동기 재생성 흐름은 세대 번호(`_generation`)로 보호한다. 새 요청이 오면 이전 흐름은 다음 `await` 뒤에 스스로 멈춘다. 내용 크기는 WPF가 실제로 렌더링에 쓰는 DPI(`VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi`)로 px→DIP 변환한다 — 작업 표시줄 DPI와 같으면 research §5와 동일한 결과이고, 다르면(부착 직후 WPF가 DPI를 못 따라간 경우) 그래도 HWND를 꽉 채운다. 불일치는 경고 로그로 남긴다.

`src/AITokenUsage/Taskbar/TaskbarHost.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Abstractions;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;
using AITokenUsage.UI;

namespace AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

/// <summary>
/// Hosts the widget inside the Windows 11 taskbar as a WS_CHILD of Shell_TrayWnd / Shell_SecondaryTrayWnd
/// (spec §4.2–4.4), falling back to a taskbar-owned overlay window (§4.5). UI thread only.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TaskbarHost : IDisposable
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan ReconcileInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500);
    public static readonly TimeSpan RecreateDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    public static readonly TimeSpan LayoutWaitTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
    public static readonly TimeSpan LayoutPollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    public static readonly TimeSpan AttachRetryInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
    public const int MaxReparentFailures = 6;
    public const string ForceOverlayVariable = "AITOKENUSAGE_FORCE_OVERLAY";

    private enum HostMode
    {
        None,
        Child,
        Overlay,
    }

    private readonly Func<WidgetWindow> _createWindow;
    private readonly AppHost _host;
    private readonly ShellEventWindow _shell;
    private readonly IAppLog _log;
    private readonly TaskbarGeometryReader _geometry;
    private readonly FullscreenWatcher _fullscreen;
    private readonly DispatcherTimer _reconcileTimer;
    private readonly DispatcherTimer _retryTimer;
    private readonly bool _forceOverlay;

    private WidgetWindow? _window;
    private nint _hwnd;
    private HostMode _mode;
    private TaskbarInfo? _taskbar;
    private string? _requestedDevice;
    private uint _baselineDpi;
    private PixelRect? _lastApplied;
    private bool _shown;
    private bool _positionFailureLogged;
    private int _reparentFailures;
    private int _generation;
    private bool _started;
    private bool _disposed;

    public TaskbarHost(Func<WidgetWindow> createWindow, AppHost host, ShellEventWindow shell)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(createWindow);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(host);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(shell);
        _createWindow = createWindow;
        _host = host;
        _shell = shell;
        _log = host.Log;
        _geometry = new TaskbarGeometryReader(_log);
        _fullscreen = new FullscreenWatcher(host.Dispatcher, _log);
        _reconcileTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background, host.Dispatcher) { Interval = ReconcileInterval };
        _reconcileTimer.Tick += OnReconcileTick;
        _retryTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background, host.Dispatcher) { Interval = AttachRetryInterval };
        _retryTimer.Tick += OnRetryTick;
        _forceOverlay = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(ForceOverlayVariable) == "1";
    }

    /// <summary>True while the widget is a child window of the taskbar.</summary>
    public bool IsEmbedded => _mode == HostMode.Child;

    /// <summary>True while the widget is a taskbar-owned overlay window.</summary>
    public bool IsOverlay => _mode == HostMode.Overlay;

    public WidgetWindow? CurrentWindow => _window;

    /// <summary>Raised on the UI thread after a new widget window has been attached and shown.</summary>
    public event EventHandler<WidgetWindow>? WindowCreated;

    public void Start()
    {
        _host.Dispatcher.VerifyAccess();
        if (_started || _disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _started = true;
        _shell.TaskbarCreated += OnTaskbarCreated;
        _shell.DisplayChanged += OnDisplayChanged;
        _shell.TaskbarSettingsChanged += OnTaskbarSettingsChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged += OnSettingsChanged;
        _fullscreen.Changed += OnFullscreenChanged;
        RequestRecreate("startup", TimeSpan.Zero);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _generation++;
        _shell.TaskbarCreated -= OnTaskbarCreated;
        _shell.DisplayChanged -= OnDisplayChanged;
        _shell.TaskbarSettingsChanged -= OnTaskbarSettingsChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged -= OnSettingsChanged;
        _fullscreen.Changed -= OnFullscreenChanged;
        _reconcileTimer.Tick -= OnReconcileTick;
        _retryTimer.Tick -= OnRetryTick;
        TearDownWindow();
        _geometry.Dispose();
        _fullscreen.Dispose();
    }

    private void RequestRecreate(string reason, TimeSpan delay)
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _log.Info($"taskbar host: (re)creating the widget in {delay.TotalSeconds:0.#} s ({reason})");
        _ = RecreateAsync(++_generation, delay);
    }

    private async Task RecreateAsync(int generation, TimeSpan delay)
    {
        try
        {
            TearDownWindow();
            _taskbar = null;
            if (delay > TimeSpan.Zero)
            {
                await Task.Delay(delay);
            }

            if (generation != _generation || _disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            string? device = _host.Settings.MonitorDeviceName;
            _requestedDevice = device;
            TaskbarInfo? taskbar = await Task.Run(() => TaskbarLocator.Find(device));
            if (generation != _generation || _disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (taskbar is null)
            {
                _log.Warn("taskbar host: no explorer-owned taskbar found");
                RequestRecreate("waiting for the taskbar", AttachRetryInterval);
                return;
            }

            // Boot race (TrafficMonitor #2098/#2194): wait until UIA sees the Start button or app buttons (15 s cap).
            _geometry.SetTaskbar(taskbar.Handle);
            var wait = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            while (!_geometry.IsLayoutReady && wait.Elapsed < LayoutWaitTimeout)
            {
                _geometry.RequestRefresh();
                await Task.Delay(LayoutPollInterval);
                if (generation != _generation || _disposed)
                {
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (!_geometry.IsLayoutReady)
            {
                _log.Warn("taskbar host: UIA did not report the Start button within 15 s; attaching anyway");
            }

            if (!NativeMethods.IsWindow(taskbar.Handle))
            {
                RequestRecreate("taskbar disappeared while waiting", RecreateDelay);
                return;
            }

            _taskbar = taskbar;
            _baselineDpi = NativeMethods.GetDpiForWindow(taskbar.Handle);
            AttachOrFallback(taskbar);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Error("taskbar host: failed to create the widget window", ex);
            if (generation == _generation && !_disposed)
            {
                RequestRecreate("previous attempt failed", AttachRetryInterval);
            }
        }
    }

    private void AttachOrFallback(TaskbarInfo taskbar)
    {
        if (_forceOverlay)
        {
            _log.Info($"taskbar host: overlay forced by {ForceOverlayVariable}=1");
        }
        else if (!taskbar.IsWin11)
        {
            _log.Info("taskbar host: not the Windows 11 XAML taskbar (no DesktopWindowContentBridge); using overlay mode");
        }
        else
        {
            WidgetWindow candidate = CreateWindowFor(taskbar);
            if (TryAttachChild(candidate, taskbar.Handle))
            {
                Adopt(candidate, HostMode.Child, taskbar);
                return;
            }

            CloseQuietly(candidate);
            _log.Warn("taskbar host: child attach failed; using overlay mode and retrying every 10 s");
        }

        StartOverlay(taskbar);
    }

    /// <summary>Pre-positions the (not yet created) window on the taskbar's monitor so WPF picks that monitor's DPI.</summary>
    private WidgetWindow CreateWindowFor(TaskbarInfo taskbar)
    {
        WidgetWindow window = _createWindow();
        double systemScale = Math.Max(1, NativeMethods.GetDpiForSystem()) / 96.0;
        window.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
        window.Left = (taskbar.Bounds.Left + 8) / systemScale;
        window.Top = (taskbar.Bounds.Top + 2) / systemScale;
        return window;
    }

    /// <summary>Spec §4.2 attach sequence. On success the window is shown (collapsed until the first layout).</summary>
    private bool TryAttachChild(WidgetWindow window, nint taskbar)
    {
        nint hwnd = new WindowInteropHelper(window).EnsureHandle();

        uint style = NativeMethods.GetStyle(hwnd);
        style &= ~(NativeMethods.WS_POPUP | NativeMethods.WS_CAPTION | NativeMethods.WS_THICKFRAME
                   | NativeMethods.WS_SYSMENU | NativeMethods.WS_MINIMIZEBOX | NativeMethods.WS_MAXIMIZEBOX);
        style |= NativeMethods.WS_CHILD | NativeMethods.WS_CLIPSIBLINGS;
        NativeMethods.SetStyle(hwnd, style);
        ApplyToolWindowExStyle(hwnd);
        NativeMethods.SetRectRegion(hwnd, 0, 0);

        nint previous = NativeMethods.SetParent(hwnd, taskbar);
        int error = previous == 0 ? Marshal.GetLastPInvokeError() : 0;
        if (NativeMethods.GetAncestor(hwnd, NativeMethods.GA_PARENT) != taskbar)
        {
            _log.Warn($"taskbar host: SetParent did not take effect (error {error})");
            return false;
        }

        NativeMethods.SetWindowPos(hwnd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
            NativeMethods.SWP_NOMOVE | NativeMethods.SWP_NOSIZE | NativeMethods.SWP_NOZORDER
            | NativeMethods.SWP_NOACTIVATE | NativeMethods.SWP_FRAMECHANGED);
        window.Show();
        return true;
    }

    private void StartOverlay(TaskbarInfo taskbar)
    {
        WidgetWindow window = CreateWindowFor(taskbar);

        // Owner BEFORE Show(): WPF passes it to CreateWindowEx, so the window stays above the (topmost) taskbar.
        var helper = new WindowInteropHelper(window) { Owner = taskbar.Handle };
        nint hwnd = helper.EnsureHandle();
        ApplyToolWindowExStyle(hwnd);
        NativeMethods.SetRectRegion(hwnd, 0, 0);
        window.Show();
        Adopt(window, HostMode.Overlay, taskbar);
        if (!_forceOverlay)
        {
            _retryTimer.Start();
        }
    }

    private static void ApplyToolWindowExStyle(nint hwnd)
    {
        // WS_EX_LAYERED is owned by WPF (AllowsTransparency): never touch it.
        uint exStyle = NativeMethods.GetExStyle(hwnd);
        exStyle = (exStyle | NativeMethods.WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | NativeMethods.WS_EX_NOACTIVATE) & ~NativeMethods.WS_EX_APPWINDOW;
        NativeMethods.SetExStyle(hwnd, exStyle);
    }

    private void Adopt(WidgetWindow window, HostMode mode, TaskbarInfo taskbar)
    {
        _window = window;
        _hwnd = new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle;
        _mode = mode;
        _shown = false;
        _lastApplied = null;
        _reparentFailures = 0;
        _positionFailureLogged = false;
        window.Closed += OnWindowClosed;
        window.DpiChanged += OnWindowDpiChanged;

        if (mode == HostMode.Overlay)
        {
            _fullscreen.Start(taskbar.Handle);
        }
        else
        {
            _fullscreen.Stop();
            _retryTimer.Stop();
        }

        double wpfDpi = VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(window).PixelsPerInchX;
        if (Math.Abs(wpfDpi - _baselineDpi) > 0.5)
        {
            _log.Warn($"taskbar host: widget renders at {wpfDpi} DPI but the taskbar is at {_baselineDpi} DPI");
        }

        _log.Info($"taskbar host: widget attached in {mode} mode (hwnd=0x{(long)_hwnd:X}, taskbar=0x{(long)taskbar.Handle:X}, dpi={_baselineDpi}, monitor={taskbar.MonitorDeviceName ?? "?"})");
        Reconcile();
        _reconcileTimer.Start();
        WindowCreated?.Invoke(this, window);
    }

    private void TearDownWindow()
    {
        _reconcileTimer.Stop();
        _retryTimer.Stop();
        _fullscreen.Stop();

        WidgetWindow? window = _window;
        _window = null;
        _hwnd = 0;
        _mode = HostMode.None;
        _shown = false;
        _lastApplied = null;
        _reparentFailures = 0;
        if (window is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        window.Closed -= OnWindowClosed;
        window.DpiChanged -= OnWindowDpiChanged;
        CloseQuietly(window);
    }

    private void CloseQuietly(WidgetWindow window)
    {
        try
        {
            window.Close();
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("taskbar host: closing the widget window failed", ex);
        }
    }

    private void Reconcile()
    {
        if (_disposed || _window is null || _taskbar is null || _hwnd == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        TaskbarInfo taskbar = _taskbar;
        nint tb = taskbar.Handle;
        if (!NativeMethods.IsWindow(tb))
        {
            RequestRecreate("taskbar window no longer exists", RecreateDelay);
            return;
        }

        if (!NativeMethods.IsWindow(_hwnd))
        {
            RequestRecreate("widget window was destroyed", RecreateDelay);
            return;
        }

        if (_mode == HostMode.Child)
        {
            uint dpi = NativeMethods.GetDpiForWindow(tb);
            if (dpi != _baselineDpi)
            {
                NativeMethods.ShowWindow(_hwnd, NativeMethods.SW_HIDE);
                _shown = false;
                RequestRecreate($"taskbar DPI changed {_baselineDpi} -> {dpi}", RecreateDelay);
                return;
            }

            if (!EnsureParent(tb))
            {
                return;
            }
        }

        TaskbarGeometry? geometry = _geometry.GetGeometry();
        if (geometry is null)
        {
            Hide("taskbar geometry unavailable");
            return;
        }

        if (TaskbarLayoutCalculator.Compute(geometry, _host.Settings.Placement) is not PixelRect relative)
        {
            Hide(geometry.IsHorizontal ? "not enough room" : "vertical taskbar");
            return;
        }

        if (ShouldHideOverlay(geometry, taskbar))
        {
            Hide("fullscreen app or auto-hidden taskbar");
            return;
        }

        PixelRect screen = relative.Offset(geometry.Taskbar.Left, geometry.Taskbar.Top);
        PixelRect target = _mode == HostMode.Child ? relative : screen;
        PixelRect? actual = NativeMethods.TryGetWindowRect(_hwnd);
        if (_shown && _lastApplied == target && actual == screen)
        {
            return;
        }

        ApplyLayout(target);
    }

    /// <summary>The shell may reparent hosted windows (Start/Search). Re-attach; give up to overlay after 6 failures.</summary>
    private bool EnsureParent(nint taskbar)
    {
        if (NativeMethods.GetAncestor(_hwnd, NativeMethods.GA_PARENT) == taskbar)
        {
            _reparentFailures = 0;
            return true;
        }

        _reparentFailures++;
        _log.Warn($"taskbar host: widget was reparented; calling SetParent again ({_reparentFailures}/{MaxReparentFailures})");
        NativeMethods.SetParent(_hwnd, taskbar);
        if (NativeMethods.GetAncestor(_hwnd, NativeMethods.GA_PARENT) == taskbar)
        {
            _lastApplied = null;
            return true;
        }

        if (_reparentFailures >= MaxReparentFailures)
        {
            SwitchToOverlay("re-parenting keeps failing");
        }

        return false;
    }

    private bool ShouldHideOverlay(TaskbarGeometry geometry, TaskbarInfo taskbar)
    {
        if (_mode != HostMode.Overlay)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (_fullscreen.IsFullscreenActive)
        {
            return true;
        }

        return _fullscreen.IsTaskbarAutoHide && !geometry.Taskbar.IsInside(taskbar.MonitorBounds);
    }

    private void ApplyLayout(PixelRect target)
    {
        WidgetWindow window = _window!;

        // Size the content in DIPs with the DPI WPF actually renders at; never touch Window.Width/Height after attach.
        double scale = VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(window).DpiScaleX;
        if (scale <= 0)
        {
            scale = Math.Max(1, _baselineDpi) / 96.0;
        }

        window.RootElement.Width = target.Width / scale;
        window.RootElement.Height = target.Height / scale;

        uint flags = NativeMethods.SWP_NOACTIVATE | NativeMethods.SWP_SHOWWINDOW;
        if (_mode == HostMode.Overlay)
        {
            flags |= NativeMethods.SWP_NOZORDER; // an owned window always stays above its owner
        }

        if (!NativeMethods.SetWindowPos(_hwnd, NativeMethods.HWND_TOP, target.Left, target.Top, target.Width, target.Height, flags))
        {
            if (!_positionFailureLogged)
            {
                _positionFailureLogged = true;
                _log.Warn($"taskbar host: SetWindowPos failed (error {Marshal.GetLastPInvokeError()})");
            }

            return;
        }

        NativeMethods.SetRectRegion(_hwnd, target.Width, target.Height);
        if (!_shown)
        {
            _log.Info($"taskbar host: widget shown at ({target.Left},{target.Top},{target.Right},{target.Bottom}) [{_mode}]");
        }

        _shown = true;
        _lastApplied = target;
    }

    private void Hide(string reason)
    {
        if (!_shown)
        {
            return;
        }

        NativeMethods.ShowWindow(_hwnd, NativeMethods.SW_HIDE);
        _shown = false;
        _lastApplied = null;
        _log.Info($"taskbar host: widget hidden ({reason})");
    }

    private void SwitchToOverlay(string reason)
    {
        TaskbarInfo? taskbar = _taskbar;
        if (taskbar is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        _log.Warn($"taskbar host: switching to overlay mode ({reason})");
        TearDownWindow();
        StartOverlay(taskbar);
    }

    /// <summary>Every 10 s in overlay mode: try a fresh child window; the overlay is closed only after success.</summary>
    private void RetryChildAttach()
    {
        if (_disposed || _mode != HostMode.Overlay || _taskbar is null || _forceOverlay)
        {
            _retryTimer.Stop();
            return;
        }

        TaskbarInfo taskbar = _taskbar;
        if (!NativeMethods.IsWindow(taskbar.Handle) || !TaskbarLocator.IsWin11Taskbar(taskbar.Handle))
        {
            return;
        }

        WidgetWindow candidate = CreateWindowFor(taskbar);
        if (!TryAttachChild(candidate, taskbar.Handle))
        {
            CloseQuietly(candidate);
            return;
        }

        _log.Info("taskbar host: child attach succeeded on retry; leaving overlay mode");
        TearDownWindow();
        Adopt(candidate, HostMode.Child, taskbar);
    }

    private async Task VerifyTaskbarSelectionAsync()
    {
        int generation = _generation;
        TaskbarInfo? current = _taskbar;
        if (current is null)
        {
            return; // a (re)creation is already in progress
        }

        string? device = _requestedDevice;
        try
        {
            TaskbarInfo? found = await Task.Run(() => TaskbarLocator.Find(device));
            if (generation != _generation || _disposed || !ReferenceEquals(current, _taskbar))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (found is null || found.Handle != current.Handle)
            {
                RequestRecreate("taskbar selection changed after a display change", RecreateDelay);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("taskbar host: display-change check failed", ex);
        }
    }

    private void ForceLayout()
    {
        _lastApplied = null;
        Reconcile();
    }

    private void OnReconcileTick(object? sender, EventArgs e) => Reconcile();

    private void OnRetryTick(object? sender, EventArgs e) => RetryChildAttach();

    private void OnTaskbarCreated(object? sender, EventArgs e) => RequestRecreate("TaskbarCreated", RecreateDelay);

    private void OnDisplayChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _geometry.RequestRefresh();
        ForceLayout();
        _ = VerifyTaskbarSelectionAsync();
    }

    private void OnTaskbarSettingsChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _geometry.RequestRefresh();
        ForceLayout();
    }

    private void OnSettingsChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (!string.Equals(_host.Settings.MonitorDeviceName, _requestedDevice, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            RequestRecreate("monitor setting changed", TimeSpan.Zero);
            return;
        }

        ForceLayout();
    }

    private void OnFullscreenChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => Reconcile();

    private void OnWindowDpiChanged(object? sender, DpiChangedEventArgs e) => ForceLayout();

    private void OnWindowClosed(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not WidgetWindow window || !ReferenceEquals(window, _window))
        {
            return;
        }

        // Explorer destroyed our HWND (restart) or the owner went away: forget it without closing again.
        window.Closed -= OnWindowClosed;
        window.DpiChanged -= OnWindowDpiChanged;
        _window = null;
        _hwnd = 0;
        _mode = HostMode.None;
        _shown = false;
        _log.Warn("taskbar host: widget window was destroyed externally");
        RequestRecreate("widget window closed", RecreateDelay);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: `AppHost` 편집 — `TaskbarHost` 연결**

`src/AITokenUsage/AppHost.cs`에서 네 군데를 정확히 바꾼다(Task 15 편집이 적용된 상태 기준).

(1) using — 찾을 코드:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage;
```

바꿀 코드:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Taskbar;
using AITokenUsage.UI;

namespace AITokenUsage;
```

(2) 속성 — 찾을 코드:

```csharp
    public ShellEventWindow Shell { get; }
```

바꿀 코드:

```csharp
    public ShellEventWindow Shell { get; }
```

이 파트(Task 17–20)는 Task 14–16이 만든 `AppHost`·`ThemeWatcher`·`ShellEventWindow`·`TaskbarHost`·최소 `WidgetWindow`·`TrayIconController` 위에 화면을 완성한다.

**이 파트가 기대는 Task 14–16의 사실** (공유 계약 + 오케스트레이터가 알려 준 내용만 쓴다)
- `AppHost` 속성: `Settings`, `SettingsStore`, `ProviderContext`, `Providers`, `Usage`, `Rotation`, `Log`, `Theme`(`ThemeWatcher`), `Shell`(`ShellEventWindow`), `Taskbar`(`TaskbarHost?`). 이벤트 `SettingsChanged`, `ViewChanged`(둘 다 UI 스레드). 메서드 `ApplySettings()`, `EnabledViewsInOrder()`, `Start()`, `RefreshNowAsync()`, `Shutdown()`, `OpenSettings()`(Task 14 버전은 로그만 남긴다 — Task 19가 본문을 바꾼다).
- `AppHost`는 `new TaskbarHost(() => new WidgetWindow(), this, Shell)`로 `TaskbarHost`를 만든다. Task 16의 `WidgetWindow`는 매개변수 없는 생성자, XAML 루트 `Border x:Name="Root"`(176×40, `Background="#01000000"`), `public FrameworkElement RootElement => Root`를 가진다. 파일 위치는 `src/AITokenUsage/UI/WidgetWindow.xaml(.cs)`이다.
- Task 14가 Core `AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation.MeterSelector`(`Select(meters, line1Key, line2Key)`, `MissingValue = "—"`)와 그 테스트(`tests/AITokenUsage.Core.Tests/Presentation/MeterSelectorTests.cs`, 7개)를 이미 만들었다. 트레이도 이것으로 줄을 고르므로 위젯은 같은 함수를 부르기만 한다.
- `AppHost.ApplySettings()`는 UI 스레드에서 `Settings.Clone()` 스냅샷을 떠서 백그라운드로 저장하고, `RefreshMinutes`가 바뀌었으면 `Usage.RescheduleAll()`을 부른다. 설정 창은 `Settings`를 직접 고친 뒤 `ApplySettings()`만 부르면 된다.
- `TrayIconController(AppHost host)`가 있고 메뉴는 `지금 새로고침` / `자동 전환 일시정지` / `종료`다. 트레이 왼쪽 클릭과 두 번째 실행 신호는 이미 `AppHost.OpenSettings()`로 온다.
- 이 파트의 old→new 편집(Task 17 Step 8–9, Task 19 Step 9–10)은 같은 시점에 작성된 `60-app-taskbar.md`(Task 14–16)의 코드와 글자 그대로 맞췄다. 합치는 과정에서 그쪽 코드가 바뀌면 편집 대상 줄도 함께 맞춘다.
- `ThemeWatcher`: `bool IsTaskbarLight`, `bool IsAppLight`, `event EventHandler? Changed`. `Changed`가 어느 스레드에서 오는지는 계약에 없으므로 이 파트의 구독자는 모두 UI 스레드로 마샬링한다.
- `RotationController`는 UI 스레드 전용이고 `CurrentChanged`도 UI 스레드에서 올라온다(Task 6). `UsageService`의 초기 뷰는 `Current = WithStatus(id, Ok, now, "불러오는 중…")`(미터 0개)이고, `RateLimited`·`Error`의 `Current.RetryAfter`는 실제 다음 자동 조회까지의 지연이다(Task 5).

**설계 메모**
- 화면에 그릴 문자열·수치를 정하는 규칙(어느 미터를 몇 줄에, 남은 % 계산, 상태 문구, 카드 위치 계산, 드롭다운 항목, 모니터 이름)은 전부 Core의 새 네임스페이스 `AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation`(`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Presentation/`)에 순수 함수로 두고 TDD로 만든다. WPF 쪽은 그 결과를 그리기만 한다.
- 투명 창은 매 프레임 GPU→CPU 복사가 일어나므로 애니메이션은 220ms 전환 하나뿐이다(spec §2.2, 조사 보고서 win11 §5). 상세 카드의 그림자도 정적 `DropShadowEffect` 하나다.
- WPF 앱 프로젝트는 `System.Drawing`/`System.Windows.Forms` 암시적 using을 뺐다(Global Constraints). `System.Windows.Shapes.Path`는 `System.IO.Path`와 겹칠 수 있으므로 코드에서는 `using Path = System.Windows.Shapes.Path;` 별칭을 쓴다. WinForms 타입(`Screen`, `ToolStripMenuItem`, `MouseButtons`)은 항상 전체 이름으로 쓴다.

### Task 17: `ProviderGlyphs`, `ProviderPanel`, `WidgetViewModel`, `WidgetWindow` 완성

2줄 미니바(spec §2.1), 위치 점, 상태별 표시, 220ms 슬라이드 전환(spec §2.2), 클릭/휠/호버 멈춤, 우클릭 메뉴(spec §2.4)를 만든다. 표시 규칙은 Core `Presentation`의 `MeterFormatter`·`WidgetPanelBuilder`로 먼저 TDD 한다. 어느 미터를 몇 줄에 둘지는 Task 14가 만든 `MeterSelector`(트레이와 같은 유일한 규칙)를 그대로 쓰고, 값이 없을 때의 `—`도 `MeterSelector.MissingValue`를 공유한다 — 이 Task에서 선택 규칙을 다시 만들지 않는다.

**표시 규칙 (`WidgetPanelBuilder`)**

| 경우 | 1줄 | 2줄 | 이름 옆 `·` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 미터 있음, 정상 | `MeterSelector.Select`의 `First`: 설정 `Line1Key`의 미터(없으면 2줄이 쓰지 않은 첫 미터) | `MeterSelector.Select`의 `Second`: 설정 `Line2Key`의 미터(없으면 1줄과 다른 첫 미터, 그것도 없으면 2줄 없음 → 1줄이 세로 가운데) | 없음 |
| 이전 값 + `RateLimited`/`Error` | 미터, 불투명도 0.55 | 미터, 불투명도 0.55 | 있음 |
| 이전 값 + `WaitingForCliRefresh`/`SignedOut`/`NotInstalled`/`Unsupported` | 미터, 불투명도 0.55 | 짧은 상태 문구(흐린 색): "갱신 대기" / "로그인 필요" / "설치 안 됨" / "지원 안 됨"·"지원 종료" | 있음 |
| 표시할 미터 없음 | 두 줄 자리에 짧은 상태 문구 하나(흐린 색). `Ok`인데 미터가 없으면 `StatusMessage`("불러오는 중…"), 그것도 없으면 "데이터 없음" | — | 없음 |
| 켜진 AI 없음(`Rotation.CurrentId == null`) | 이름 "AI 사용량", 문구 "우클릭하여 설정" | — | 없음 |

- 값: `TextOverride`가 있으면 그 텍스트 줄(바 없음). 텍스트가 짧은 라벨로 시작하면(Copilot `↻ 11/1`) 라벨 칸을 비우고 텍스트를 줄 전체에 쓴다. 그 밖에는 `UsedPercent`를 0–100으로 클램프해 반올림(`MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero`)한 `14%`. "남은 %" 모드면 `100 − 사용`이고 바도 남은 양을 그린다. 값이 없으면 `—`(em dash, `MeterSelector.MissingValue` — 트레이와 같은 문자).
- 바 색: 등급(`SeverityRules.Effective`) 위험 `#F04438`, 경고 `#F5A524`, 그 밖에는 브랜드 색. 남은 % 모드여도 등급은 사용량 기준이다.
- 점: `Rotation.EligibleIds.Count >= 2`일 때만, 현재는 채운 원(●), 나머지는 테두리 원(○).
- 폭: 왼쪽 열 66 DIP, 오른쪽 열 104 DIP, 그 안의 라벨 칸 24 DIP("주·Fa" 22.9 DIP가 들어가는 최소 폭). 자세한 배분은 Step 6.

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;

/// <summary>Shared builders for presentation tests. Now = 2026-10-28 12:00 in the fixed +09:00 test zone.</summary>
internal static class PresentationSamples
{
    public static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 10, 28, 3, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    public static readonly TimeZoneInfo Kst =
        TimeZoneInfo.CreateCustomTimeZone("Test KST", TimeSpan.FromHours(9), "Test KST", "Test KST");

    public static UsageMeter Meter(
        string key,
        string shortLabel,
        double? used,
        DateTimeOffset? resetsAt = null,
        Severity? severity = null,
        string? text = null,
        string? longLabel = null) =>
        new(key, shortLabel, longLabel ?? "긴 " + key, used, resetsAt, severity, text);

    /// <summary>Ok snapshot with plan "Pro", fetched 3 minutes before <see cref="Now"/>.</summary>
    public static UsageSnapshot Ok(string providerId, params UsageMeter[] meters) =>
        new(providerId, ProviderStatus.Ok, "Pro", meters, Now.AddMinutes(-3));

    /// <summary>Failure/status snapshot fetched 1 minute before <see cref="Now"/> (11:59 local).</summary>
    public static UsageSnapshot Status(string providerId, ProviderStatus status, string? message = null, TimeSpan? retryAfter = null) =>
        UsageSnapshot.WithStatus(providerId, status, Now.AddMinutes(-1), message, retryAfter);

    public static ProviderView View(UsageSnapshot current, UsageSnapshot? lastGood = null, string displayName = "Claude") =>
        new(current.ProviderId, displayName, current, lastGood);
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using static AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation.PresentationSamples;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;

public class MeterFormatterTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(14.0, "14%")]
    [InlineData(14.5, "15%")]
    [InlineData(0.4, "0%")]
    [InlineData(99.6, "100%")]
    [InlineData(130.0, "100%")]
    [InlineData(-5.0, "0%")]
    public void ValueText_UsedMode_RoundsAndClamps(double used, string expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, MeterFormatter.ValueText(Meter("session", "5h", used), ValueMode.Used));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RemainingMode_ShowsHundredMinusUsed_ForTextAndBar()
    {
        var meter = Meter("session", "5h", 14);

        Assert.Equal("86%", MeterFormatter.ValueText(meter, ValueMode.Remaining));
        Assert.Equal(0.86, MeterFormatter.BarFraction(meter, ValueMode.Remaining)!.Value, 6);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BarFraction_UsedMode_IsUsedPercentOverHundred()
    {
        Assert.Equal(0.14, MeterFormatter.BarFraction(Meter("session", "5h", 14), ValueMode.Used)!.Value, 6);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NaNPercent_IsTreatedAsUnknown()
    {
        var meter = Meter("session", "5h", double.NaN);

        Assert.Equal(MeterFormatter.MissingValue, MeterFormatter.ValueText(meter, ValueMode.Used));
        Assert.Null(MeterFormatter.BarFraction(meter, ValueMode.Used));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnknownPercent_ShowsDashAndNoBar()
    {
        var meter = Meter("session", "5h", null);

        Assert.Equal("—", MeterFormatter.ValueText(meter, ValueMode.Remaining));
        Assert.Null(MeterFormatter.BarFraction(meter, ValueMode.Remaining));
        Assert.Null(MeterFormatter.DisplayPercent(meter, ValueMode.Used));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TextOverride_WinsOverPercent_AndHasNoBar()
    {
        var meter = Meter("monthly", "월", 40, text: "12 크레딧 사용");

        Assert.Equal("12 크레딧 사용", MeterFormatter.ValueText(meter, ValueMode.Used));
        Assert.Null(MeterFormatter.BarFraction(meter, ValueMode.Used));
        Assert.Null(MeterFormatter.DisplayPercent(meter, ValueMode.Remaining));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using static AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation.PresentationSamples;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;

public class WidgetPanelBuilderTests
{
    private static readonly UsageMeter Session = Meter("session", "5h", 14);
    private static readonly UsageMeter Weekly = Meter("weekly", "주", 50);

    [Fact]
    public void Build_OkView_TwoMeterRowsAndDots()
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(Ok("claude", Session, Weekly)), "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 3, 1);

        Assert.Equal("claude", model.ProviderId);
        Assert.Equal("Claude", model.DisplayName);
        Assert.False(model.IsStale);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Meter, model.Row1.Kind);
        Assert.Equal("5h", model.Row1.Label);
        Assert.Equal("14%", model.Row1.Value);
        Assert.Equal(0.14, model.Row1.Fraction!.Value, 6);
        Assert.False(model.Row1.Dimmed);
        Assert.NotNull(model.Row2);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Meter, model.Row2.Kind);
        Assert.Equal("주", model.Row2.Label);
        Assert.Equal("50%", model.Row2.Value);
        Assert.True(model.ShowDots);
        Assert.Equal(3, model.DotCount);
        Assert.Equal(1, model.DotIndex);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_SingleEligibleProvider_HidesDots()
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(Ok("claude", Session, Weekly)), "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.False(model.ShowDots);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_RemainingMode_ShowsRemainingPercent()
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(Ok("claude", Session, Weekly)), "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Remaining, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal("86%", model.Row1.Value);
        Assert.Equal(0.86, model.Row1.Fraction!.Value, 6);
        Assert.Equal("50%", model.Row2!.Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_OneMeterOnly_LeavesSecondRowEmpty()
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(Ok("codex", Meter("monthly", "월", 20))), "5h", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal("월", model.Row1.Label);
        Assert.Null(model.Row2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_ConfiguredKeysMissing_FallsBackToFirstMeters()
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(Ok("claude", Session, Weekly)), "gone-1", "gone-2", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal("5h", model.Row1.Label);
        Assert.Equal("주", model.Row2!.Label);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_LoadingView_ShowsServiceMessage()
    {
        var loading = UsageSnapshot.WithStatus("claude", ProviderStatus.Ok, Now, "불러오는 중…");

        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(loading), "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Message, model.Row1.Kind);
        Assert.Equal("불러오는 중…", model.Row1.Value);
        Assert.Null(model.Row2);
        Assert.False(model.IsStale);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.NotInstalled, null, "설치 안 됨")]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.SignedOut, "터미널에서 claude 실행 후 /login", "로그인 필요")]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh, null, "갱신 대기")]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.Unsupported, "개인 계정 지원 종료 (2026-06-18) — Antigravity 사용", "지원 종료")]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.Unsupported, "API 키 로그인 — 플랜 한도 없음", "지원 안 됨")]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.RateLimited, null, "요청 제한")]
    [InlineData(ProviderStatus.Error, "네트워크 오류 — 잠시 후 다시 시도", "오류")]
    public void Build_NoData_ShowsShortStatusInPlaceOfBothLines(ProviderStatus status, string? message, string expected)
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(View(Status("claude", status, message)), "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Message, model.Row1.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(expected, model.Row1.Value);
        Assert.Null(model.Row2);
        Assert.False(model.IsStale);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_StaleRateLimited_DimsBothRowsAndMarksName()
    {
        var view = View(Status("claude", ProviderStatus.RateLimited, null, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10)), Ok("claude", Session, Weekly));

        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(view, "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 2, 0);

        Assert.True(model.IsStale);
        Assert.True(model.Row1.Dimmed);
        Assert.Equal("14%", model.Row1.Value);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Meter, model.Row2!.Kind);
        Assert.True(model.Row2.Dimmed);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_StaleWaitingForCli_KeepsLine1AndReplacesLine2()
    {
        var view = View(Status("claude", ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh), Ok("claude", Session, Weekly));

        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(view, "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.True(model.IsStale);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Meter, model.Row1.Kind);
        Assert.True(model.Row1.Dimmed);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Message, model.Row2!.Kind);
        Assert.Equal("갱신 대기", model.Row2.Value);
        Assert.False(model.Row2.Dimmed);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_StaleSignedOut_ReplacesLine2WithLoginRequired()
    {
        var view = View(Status("claude", ProviderStatus.SignedOut, "터미널에서 claude 실행 후 /login"), Ok("claude", Session, Weekly));

        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(view, "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal("로그인 필요", model.Row2!.Value);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Message, model.Row2.Kind);

    [Fact]
    public void Build_RowsCarryEffectiveSeverity()
    {
        var view = View(Ok("claude", Meter("session", "5h", 92), Meter("weekly", "주", 10, severity: Severity.Warning)));

        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(view, "session", "weekly", ValueMode.Used, 1, 0);

        Assert.Equal(Severity.Critical, model.Row1.Severity);
        Assert.Equal(Severity.Warning, model.Row2!.Severity);

    [Fact]
    public void Build_TextOverrideRows_SpanWhenTextStartsWithLabel()
    {
        var credits = Meter("monthly", "월", null, text: "12 크레딧 사용");
        var reset = Meter("reset", "↻", null, new DateTimeOffset(2026, 11, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero), text: "↻ 11/1");

    [Fact]
    public void Empty_ShowsSetupHint()
    {
        WidgetPanelModel model = WidgetPanelBuilder.Empty();

        Assert.Equal("", model.ProviderId);
        Assert.Equal("AI 사용량", model.DisplayName);
        Assert.Equal(WidgetRowKind.Message, model.Row1.Kind);
        Assert.Equal("우클릭하여 설정", model.Row1.Value);
        Assert.Null(model.Row2);
        Assert.False(model.ShowDots);
    }
```

`MeterSelector`는 Task 14의 것을 그대로 쓴다(이 Task에서 새로 만들거나 고치지 않는다). 아래 `MeterFormatter.MissingValue`는 그 상수를 가리켜, 트레이 `TrayTextFormatter.NoValue`와 위젯이 같은 `—`를 쓴다.

`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Presentation/WidgetPanelModel.cs`:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

public enum WidgetRowKind
{
    /// <summary>Label + 44 DIP bar + value.</summary>
    Meter,

    /// <summary>A text line (TextOverride) such as "↻ 11/1" or "12 크레딧 사용". No bar.</summary>
    Text,

    /// <summary>A muted status line such as "로그인 필요".</summary>
    Message,
}

/// <summary>One line of the widget's right column.</summary>
public sealed record WidgetRow(WidgetRowKind Kind, string Label, double? Fraction, string Value, Severity Severity, bool Dimmed)
{
    public static WidgetRow Message(string text) => new(WidgetRowKind.Message, "", null, text, Severity.Normal, false);
}

/// <summary>Everything one provider panel draws. When Row2 is null, Row1 is centred across both lines.</summary>
public sealed record WidgetPanelModel(
    string ProviderId,
    string DisplayName,
    bool IsStale,
    WidgetRow Row1,
    WidgetRow? Row2,
    int DotCount,
    int DotIndex)
{
    /// <summary>Position dots are shown only when two or more providers rotate (spec §2.1).</summary>
    public bool ShowDots => DotCount >= 2;
}
```
