`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Presentation/MeterFormatter.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>Turns a meter into the number and bar length the widget and the detail card draw.</summary>
public static class MeterFormatter
{
    /// <summary>"—" — the same constant the tray uses (TrayTextFormatter.NoValue).</summary>
    public const string MissingValue = MeterSelector.MissingValue;

    /// <summary>
    /// Used % (or 100 − used in Remaining mode), clamped to 0..100.
    /// Null for text lines (TextOverride) and for unknown or NaN percentages.
    /// </summary>
    public static double? DisplayPercent(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(meter);

        if (meter.TextOverride is not null || SeverityRules.Clamp(meter.UsedPercent) is not double used)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return mode == ValueMode.Remaining ? 100 - used : used;
    }

    /// <summary>0..1 bar length, or null when no bar should be drawn.</summary>
    public static double? BarFraction(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode) =>
        DisplayPercent(meter, mode) is double percent ? percent / 100 : null;

    /// <summary>"14%" (rounded half away from zero), the TextOverride text, or "—".</summary>
    public static string ValueText(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(meter);

        if (meter.TextOverride is { } text)
        {
            return text;
        }

        return DisplayPercent(meter, mode) is double percent
            ? string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{Math.Round(percent, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero):0}%")
            : MissingValue;
    }
}
```

`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Presentation/WidgetPanelBuilder.cs`:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>Builds the widget's two-line model from a provider view (spec §2.1 state table).</summary>
public static class WidgetPanelBuilder
{
    public const string EmptyTitle = "AI 사용량";
    public const string EmptyMessage = "우클릭하여 설정";
    public const string NoDataMessage = "데이터 없음";

    /// <summary>Shown when no provider is enabled: "AI 사용량 · 우클릭하여 설정".</summary>
    public static WidgetPanelModel Empty() =>
        new("", EmptyTitle, false, WidgetRow.Message(EmptyMessage), null, 0, -1);

    public static WidgetPanelModel Build(
        ProviderView view,
        string? line1Key,
        string? line2Key,
        ValueMode mode,
        int dotCount,
        int dotIndex)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);

        (UsageMeter? first, UsageMeter? second) = MeterSelector.Select(view.DisplayMeters, line1Key, line2Key);
        if (first is null)
        {
            return new WidgetPanelModel(
                view.ProviderId, view.DisplayName, false, WidgetRow.Message(ShortStatus(view)), null, dotCount, dotIndex);
        }

        bool stale = view.IsStale;
        WidgetRow row1 = ToRow(first, mode, stale);
        WidgetRow? row2 = second is null ? null : ToRow(second, mode, stale);

        if (stale && ReplacesSecondLine(view.Current.Status))
        {
            row2 = WidgetRow.Message(ShortStatus(view));
        }

        return new WidgetPanelModel(view.ProviderId, view.DisplayName, stale, row1, row2, dotCount, dotIndex);
    }

    /// <summary>Two-to-five character status for the widget (spec §2.1 "상태별 위젯 표시").</summary>
    public static string ShortStatus(ProviderView view)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);

        UsageSnapshot current = view.Current;
        return current.Status switch
        {
            ProviderStatus.NotInstalled => "설치 안 됨",
            ProviderStatus.SignedOut => "로그인 필요",
            ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh => "갱신 대기",
            ProviderStatus.Unsupported =>
                current.StatusMessage?.Contains("지원 종료", StringComparison.Ordinal) == true ? "지원 종료" : "지원 안 됨",
            ProviderStatus.RateLimited => "요청 제한",
            ProviderStatus.Error => "오류",
            _ => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(current.StatusMessage) ? NoDataMessage : current.StatusMessage.Trim(),
        };
    }

    public static WidgetRow ToRow(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode, bool dimmed)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(meter);

        Severity severity = SeverityRules.Effective(meter);
        if (meter.TextOverride is { } text)
        {
            bool labelInText = meter.ShortLabel.Length > 0 && text.StartsWith(meter.ShortLabel, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            return new WidgetRow(WidgetRowKind.Text, labelInText ? "" : meter.ShortLabel, null, text, severity, dimmed);
        }

        return new WidgetRow(
            WidgetRowKind.Meter,
            meter.ShortLabel,
            MeterFormatter.BarFraction(meter, mode),
            MeterFormatter.ValueText(meter, mode),
            severity,
            dimmed);
    }

    private static bool ReplacesSecondLine(ProviderStatus status) => status is
        ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh or
        ProviderStatus.SignedOut or
        ProviderStatus.NotInstalled or
        ProviderStatus.Unsupported;
}
```

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/ProviderGlyphs.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using Path = System.Windows.Shapes.Path;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Simple geometric provider marks (not brand logos) and the spec §2.1 colours.</summary>
public static class ProviderGlyphs
{
    public const double DesignSize = 14;
    public const double StrokeThickness = 1.6;

    public static readonly Color ClaudeColor = Color.FromRgb(0xD9, 0x77, 0x57);
    public static readonly Color CodexColor = Color.FromRgb(0x10, 0xA3, 0x7F);
    public static readonly Color GeminiColor = Color.FromRgb(0x42, 0x85, 0xF4);
    public static readonly Color CopilotColor = Color.FromRgb(0x89, 0x57, 0xE5);
    public static readonly Color NeutralColor = Color.FromRgb(0x8A, 0x8A, 0x8A);
    public static readonly Color WarningColor = Color.FromRgb(0xF5, 0xA5, 0x24);
    public static readonly Color CriticalColor = Color.FromRgb(0xF0, 0x44, 0x38);

    private static readonly Geometry ClaudeGeometry =
        Frozen(Geometry.Parse("M7,0.8 L7,13.2 M0.8,7 L13.2,7 M2.6,2.6 L11.4,11.4 M11.4,2.6 L2.6,11.4"));

    private static readonly Geometry CodexGeometry = Frozen(new GeometryGroup
    {
        Children = new GeometryCollection
        {
            new EllipseGeometry(new Point(7, 7), 5.8, 5.8),
            new EllipseGeometry(new Point(7, 7), 2.4, 2.4),
        },
    });

    private static readonly Geometry GeminiGeometry =
        Frozen(Geometry.Parse("M7,0 C7.5,4.5 9.5,6.5 14,7 C9.5,7.5 7.5,9.5 7,14 C6.5,9.5 4.5,7.5 0,7 C4.5,6.5 6.5,4.5 7,0 Z"));

    private static readonly Geometry CopilotGeometry =
        Frozen(Geometry.Parse("M7,1 L12.2,4 L12.2,10 L7,13 L1.8,10 L1.8,4 Z"));

    private static readonly Geometry NeutralGeometry =
        Frozen(Geometry.Parse("M2.5,12 L2.5,7.5 M7,12 L7,2.5 M11.5,12 L11.5,9"));

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, SolidColorBrush> BrandBrushes = new(StringComparer.Ordinal)
    {
        [ProviderIds.Claude] = FrozenBrush(ClaudeColor),
        [ProviderIds.Codex] = FrozenBrush(CodexColor),
        [ProviderIds.Gemini] = FrozenBrush(GeminiColor),
        [ProviderIds.Copilot] = FrozenBrush(CopilotColor),
    };

    private static readonly SolidColorBrush NeutralBrush = FrozenBrush(NeutralColor);

    public static Color BrandColor(string? providerId) => providerId switch
    {
        ProviderIds.Claude => ClaudeColor,
        ProviderIds.Codex => CodexColor,
        ProviderIds.Gemini => GeminiColor,
        ProviderIds.Copilot => CopilotColor,
        _ => NeutralColor,
    };

    public static SolidColorBrush BrandBrush(string? providerId) =>
        providerId is not null && BrandBrushes.TryGetValue(providerId, out SolidColorBrush? brush) ? brush : NeutralBrush;

    public static Geometry GetGeometry(string? providerId) => providerId switch
    {
        ProviderIds.Claude => ClaudeGeometry,
        ProviderIds.Codex => CodexGeometry,
        ProviderIds.Gemini => GeminiGeometry,
        ProviderIds.Copilot => CopilotGeometry,
        _ => NeutralGeometry,
    };

    /// <summary>Gemini's star is filled; every other mark is a rounded stroke.</summary>
    public static bool IsFilled(string? providerId) => providerId == ProviderIds.Gemini;

    /// <summary>
    /// Points an existing 14×14 Path at the provider's mark in its brand colour.
    /// Unknown or empty ids (the "AI 사용량" empty state) use the neutral mark in <paramref name="neutralBrush"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Apply(Path path, string? providerId, Brush neutralBrush)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(path);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(neutralBrush);

        bool known = providerId is not null && BrandBrushes.ContainsKey(providerId);
        Brush brush = known ? BrandBrush(providerId) : neutralBrush;

        path.Data = GetGeometry(providerId);
        path.Stretch = Stretch.None;

        if (IsFilled(providerId))
        {
            path.Fill = brush;
            path.Stroke = null;
            return;
        }

        path.Fill = null;
        path.Stroke = brush;
        path.StrokeThickness = StrokeThickness;
        path.StrokeStartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round;
        path.StrokeEndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round;
        path.StrokeLineJoin = PenLineJoin.Round;
    }

    /// <summary>A new Path showing the mark at <paramref name="size"/> DIP.</summary>
    public static Path CreateIcon(string? providerId, double size, Brush neutralBrush)
    {
        var path = new Path { Width = DesignSize, Height = DesignSize };
        Apply(path, providerId, neutralBrush);

        if (Math.Abs(size - DesignSize) > 0.01)
        {
            double scale = size / DesignSize;
            path.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(scale, scale);
        }

        return path;
    }

    private static Geometry Frozen(Geometry geometry)
    {
        if (geometry.CanFreeze && !geometry.IsFrozen)
        {
            geometry.Freeze();
        }

        return geometry;
    }

    private static SolidColorBrush FrozenBrush(Color color)
    {
        var brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }
}
```

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/WidgetPalette.cs` — 작업 표시줄이 다크면 흰 글자, 라이트면 검은 글자(spec §2.1). 보조 텍스트 0.65, 바 트랙 0.18. 글자색 설정 "밝게"(`Light`)/"어둡게"(`Dark`)가 테마보다 우선한다(spec §4.6).

```csharp
using System.Windows.Media;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Frozen brushes for text drawn straight on the taskbar (also reused by the detail card).</summary>
public sealed class WidgetPalette
{
    public const double MutedOpacity = 0.65;
    public const double TrackOpacity = 0.18;

    /// <summary>White text, for a dark taskbar.</summary>
    public static readonly WidgetPalette LightText = new(Colors.White);

    /// <summary>Black text, for a light taskbar.</summary>
    public static readonly WidgetPalette DarkText = new(Colors.Black);

    private static readonly SolidColorBrush WarningBrush = FrozenBrush(ProviderGlyphs.WarningColor, 1);
    private static readonly SolidColorBrush CriticalBrush = FrozenBrush(ProviderGlyphs.CriticalColor, 1);

    private WidgetPalette(Color text)
    {
        TextColor = text;
        Text = FrozenBrush(text, 1);
        Muted = FrozenBrush(text, MutedOpacity);
        Track = FrozenBrush(text, TrackOpacity);
    }

    public Color TextColor { get; }

    public SolidColorBrush Text { get; }

    public SolidColorBrush Muted { get; }

    public SolidColorBrush Track { get; }

    /// <summary>"자동" follows the taskbar (SystemUsesLightTheme); "밝게"/"어둡게" override it.</summary>
    public static WidgetPalette Resolve(bool taskbarIsLight, TextColorMode mode) => mode switch
    {
        TextColorMode.Light => LightText,
        TextColorMode.Dark => DarkText,
        _ => taskbarIsLight ? DarkText : LightText,
    };

    /// <summary>Critical/warning colours win over the brand colour.</summary>
    public Brush BarBrush(string? providerId, Severity severity) => severity switch
    {
        Severity.Critical => CriticalBrush,
        Severity.Warning => WarningBrush,
        _ => ProviderGlyphs.BrandBrush(providerId),
    };

    private static SolidColorBrush FrozenBrush(Color color, double opacity)
    {
        var brush = new SolidColorBrush(color) { Opacity = opacity };
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: `ProviderPanel` 작성**

왼쪽 열(폭 66): 아이콘 14 + 이름(12 SemiBold, 최대 42 — "Copilot"이 39.6 DIP) + 이전 값 표시 `·`. 공급자가 없는 빈 상태("AI 사용량", 50.9 DIP)는 아이콘을 숨기고 이름 최대 폭을 62로 넓힌다. 그 아래 위치 점(지름 5, 간격 4). 오른쪽 열(폭 104 DIP = 위젯 176 − 좌우 여백 3×2 − 왼쪽 열 66): 줄마다 라벨 칸(10.5, 흐린 색, **폭 24 DIP** — 가장 긴 라벨 "주·Fa"가 22.9 DIP라 이보다 좁히면 잘린다) + 바(44×4, 둥근 모서리) + 간격 4 + 값(11.5 SemiBold, 최소 32, 오른쪽 정렬). 24 + 44 + 4 + 32 = 104로 오른쪽 열을 정확히 채운다. 이 계획의 라벨 칸 24 DIP / 오른쪽 열 104 DIP가 기준이며 spec §2.1의 라벨 폭 수치는 이 값으로 따로 갱신된다. 패널은 입력을 받지 않는다(`IsHitTestVisible=False`) — 마우스는 위젯 루트(`#01000000`)가 받는다.

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/ProviderPanel.xaml`:

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/ProviderPanel.xaml.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>One provider's two-line mini bar. Draws a <see cref="WidgetPanelModel"/>; holds no state of its own.</summary>
public partial class ProviderPanel : UserControl
{
    public const double StaleOpacity = 0.55;
    public const double BarWidth = 44;

    private const double DotSize = 5;
    private const double DotSpacing = 4;
    private const double ProviderNameMaxWidth = 42;
    private const double EmptyTitleMaxWidth = 62;

    private readonly RowParts _row1;
    private readonly RowParts _row2;

    public ProviderPanel()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        _row1 = new RowParts(Row1, Row1Label, Row1Track, Row1Fill, Row1Value, Row1Text);
        _row2 = new RowParts(Row2, Row2Label, Row2Track, Row2Fill, Row2Value, Row2Text);
        RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
    }

    /// <summary>The slide offset animated by the widget's transition.</summary>
    public TranslateTransform Slide => (TranslateTransform)RenderTransform;

    public void Render(WidgetPanelModel model, WidgetPalette palette)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(model);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(palette);

        bool hasProvider = model.ProviderId.Length > 0;
        ProviderGlyphs.Apply(GlyphPath, model.ProviderId, palette.Text);
        GlyphPath.Visibility = hasProvider ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        NameText.Margin = hasProvider ? new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0) : new Thickness(0);
        NameText.MaxWidth = hasProvider ? ProviderNameMaxWidth : EmptyTitleMaxWidth;
        NameText.Text = model.DisplayName;
        NameText.Foreground = palette.Text;
        StaleMark.Foreground = palette.Text;
        StaleMark.Visibility = model.IsStale ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        RenderDots(model, palette);

        if (model.Row2 is null && model.Row1.Kind == WidgetRowKind.Message)
        {
            Row1.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            Row2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            MessageText.Text = model.Row1.Value;
            MessageText.Foreground = palette.Muted;
            MessageText.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            return;
        }

        MessageText.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        RenderRow(_row1, model.Row1, palette, model.ProviderId);

        if (model.Row2 is null)
        {
            Grid.SetRowSpan(Row1, 2);
            Row2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }
        else
        {
            Grid.SetRowSpan(Row1, 1);
            RenderRow(_row2, model.Row2, palette, model.ProviderId);
        }
    }

    private static void RenderRow(RowParts row, WidgetRow model, WidgetPalette palette, string providerId)
    {
        row.Container.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        row.Container.Opacity = model.Dimmed ? StaleOpacity : 1.0;
        row.Label.Text = model.Label;
        row.Label.Foreground = palette.Muted;

        switch (model.Kind)
        {
            case WidgetRowKind.Meter:
                row.Label.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                row.Track.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                row.Track.Background = palette.Track;
                row.Fill.Background = palette.BarBrush(providerId, model.Severity);
                row.Fill.Width = Math.Round(BarWidth * Math.Clamp(model.Fraction ?? 0, 0, 1));
                row.Value.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                row.Value.Text = model.Value;
                row.Value.Foreground = palette.Text;
                row.Text.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                break;

            case WidgetRowKind.Text:
                bool hasLabel = model.Label.Length > 0;
                row.Label.Visibility = hasLabel ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                row.Track.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                row.Value.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                ShowText(row.Text, model.Value, palette.Text, hasLabel ? 1 : 0);
                break;

            default:
                row.Label.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                row.Track.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                row.Value.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                ShowText(row.Text, model.Value, palette.Muted, 0);
                break;
        }
    }

    private static void ShowText(TextBlock text, string value, Brush brush, int column)
    {
        text.Text = value;
        text.Foreground = brush;
        Grid.SetColumn(text, column);
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(text, 4 - column);
        text.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
    }

    private void RenderDots(WidgetPanelModel model, WidgetPalette palette)
    {
        if (!model.ShowDots)
        {
            DotsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            return;
        }

        while (DotsPanel.Children.Count < model.DotCount)
        {
            DotsPanel.Children.Add(new Ellipse
            {
                Width = DotSize,
                Height = DotSize,
                StrokeThickness = 1,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, DotSpacing, 0),
            });
        }

        while (DotsPanel.Children.Count > model.DotCount)
        {
            DotsPanel.Children.RemoveAt(DotsPanel.Children.Count - 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < DotsPanel.Children.Count; i++)
        {
            var dot = (Ellipse)DotsPanel.Children[i];
            bool current = i == model.DotIndex;
            dot.Fill = current ? palette.Text : Brushes.Transparent;
            dot.Stroke = current ? palette.Text : palette.Muted;
        }

        DotsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
    }

    private sealed record RowParts(Grid Container, TextBlock Label, Border Track, Border Fill, TextBlock Value, TextBlock Text);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: `WidgetViewModel` 작성**

뷰모델은 `AppHost` 이벤트를 모아 "현재 공급자가 바뀜(방향)"과 "같은 공급자 다시 그리기" 두 신호로 바꾼다. 호버 멈춤은 `PauseOnHover`가 켜졌을 때만 `Rotation.SetHoverPaused`를 부르고, 값이 실제로 바뀔 때만 부른다(해제는 타이머를 리셋하므로).

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/WidgetViewModel.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Windows.Threading;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Rotation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Feeds the widget: which provider is shown, its two lines, the dots and the text colours.</summary>
public sealed class WidgetViewModel : IDisposable
{
    private readonly AppHost _host;
    private readonly ThemeWatcher _theme;
    private readonly Dispatcher _dispatcher;
    private bool _pointerOver;
    private bool _hoverPaused;
    private bool _disposed;

    public WidgetViewModel(AppHost host, ThemeWatcher theme)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(host);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(theme);

        _host = host;
        _theme = theme;
        _dispatcher = Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher;
        CurrentModel = BuildModel();
        Palette = ResolvePalette();

        _host.ViewChanged += OnViewChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged += OnSettingsChanged;
        _host.Rotation.CurrentChanged += OnCurrentChanged;
        _theme.Changed += OnThemeChanged;
    }

    public AppHost Host => _host;

    public ThemeWatcher Theme => _theme;

    public WidgetPanelModel CurrentModel { get; private set; }

    public WidgetPalette Palette { get; private set; }

    public bool IsUserPaused => _host.Rotation.IsUserPaused;

    /// <summary>The shown provider changed. Argument: +1 next, −1 previous, 0 list change (redraw without animation).</summary>
    public event EventHandler<int>? ProviderSwitched;

    /// <summary>Same provider, new data, settings, dots or colours: redraw in place.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? Updated;

    public void Next() => _host.Rotation.Next();

    public void Previous() => _host.Rotation.Previous();

    public void SetUserPaused(bool paused) => _host.Rotation.SetUserPaused(paused);

    public void OpenSettings() => _host.OpenSettings();

    public void Exit() => _host.Shutdown();

    public async void RefreshNow()
    {
        try
        {
            await _host.RefreshNowAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _host.Log.Error("Manual refresh from the widget menu failed.", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Pointer over the widget (from Task 18 also over its detail card). Pauses rotation when PauseOnHover is on.</summary>
    public void SetPointerOver(bool over)
    {
        _pointerOver = over;
        ApplyHoverPause();
    }

    public WidgetPanelModel BuildModel()
    {
        RotationController rotation = _host.Rotation;
        string? id = rotation.CurrentId;
        ProviderView? view = id is null ? null : _host.Usage.GetView(id);
        if (view is null)
        {
            return WidgetPanelBuilder.Empty();
        }

        ProviderSettings? settings = _host.Settings.Providers.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == view.ProviderId);
        (string line1, string line2) = settings is null
            ? ProviderDefaults.DefaultLines(view.ProviderId)
            : (settings.Line1Key, settings.Line2Key);

        return WidgetPanelBuilder.Build(
            view, line1, line2, _host.Settings.ValueMode, rotation.EligibleIds.Count, rotation.CurrentIndex);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _host.ViewChanged -= OnViewChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged -= OnSettingsChanged;
        _host.Rotation.CurrentChanged -= OnCurrentChanged;
        _theme.Changed -= OnThemeChanged;

        if (_hoverPaused)
        {
            _hoverPaused = false;
            _host.Rotation.SetHoverPaused(false);
        }
    }

    private WidgetPalette ResolvePalette() => WidgetPalette.Resolve(_theme.IsTaskbarLight, _host.Settings.TextColor);

    private void ApplyHoverPause()
    {
        bool paused = !_disposed && _pointerOver && _host.Settings.PauseOnHover;
        if (paused == _hoverPaused)
        {
            return;
        }

        _hoverPaused = paused;
        _host.Rotation.SetHoverPaused(paused);
    }

    private void OnViewChanged(object? sender, ProviderView view) => RaiseUpdated();

    private void OnSettingsChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        ApplyHoverPause();
        RaiseUpdated();
    }

    private void OnCurrentChanged(object? sender, RotationChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        CurrentModel = BuildModel();
        ProviderSwitched?.Invoke(this, e.Direction);
    }

    private void OnThemeChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (_dispatcher.CheckAccess())
        {
            RaiseUpdated();
        }
        else
        {
            _dispatcher.InvokeAsync(RaiseUpdated);
        }
    }

    private void RaiseUpdated()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        CurrentModel = BuildModel();
        Palette = ResolvePalette();
        Updated?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: `WidgetWindow` 완성 (XAML·코드 전체 교체)**

`<Window>` 시작 태그와 루트 `Border x:Name="Root"`의 속성은 Task 16 파일과 **글자 그대로 같다**(spec §4.2 창 속성 + `SizeToContent="Manual"`, `WindowStartupLocation="Manual"`, 176×40). `TaskbarHost`는 `RootElement.Width/Height`만 DIP로 바꾸므로 그 계약을 유지한다. 바뀌는 것은 `xmlns:ui` 선언과, 임시 "AI 사용량" `TextBlock` 대신 전환용 `ProviderPanel` 두 개를 겹쳐 둔 `Grid`뿐이다.

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/WidgetWindow.xaml`:

```xml
<Window x:Class="AITokenUsage.UI.WidgetWindow"

        xmlns:ui="clr-namespace:AITokenUsage.UI"
        Title="AI 사용량 위젯"
        WindowStyle="None"
        AllowsTransparency="True"
        Background="Transparent"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        ShowActivated="False"
        ResizeMode="NoResize"
        Topmost="False"
        UseLayoutRounding="True"
        SizeToContent="Manual"
        WindowStartupLocation="Manual"
        Width="176"
        Height="40">
    <!-- #01000000: alpha 1 keeps the whole widget hit-testable (alpha 0 pixels pass clicks to the taskbar). -->
    <Border x:Name="Root"
            Background="#01000000"
            Width="176"
            Height="40"
            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
            VerticalAlignment="Top">
        <Grid x:Name="Stage" ClipToBounds="True">
            <ui:ProviderPanel x:Name="PanelA" />
            <ui:ProviderPanel x:Name="PanelB" Visibility="Hidden" Opacity="0" />
        </Grid>

</Window>
```

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/WidgetWindow.xaml.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>
/// The taskbar widget. TaskbarHost owns placement (SetParent/SetWindowPos); this class only draws,
/// animates the 220 ms provider transition and handles click, wheel, hover and the context menu.
/// </summary>
public partial class WidgetWindow : Window
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan TransitionDuration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(220);
    public const double SlideOffset = 8;

    private readonly WidgetViewModel _vm;
    private readonly MenuItem _pauseItem;
    private ProviderPanel _front;
    private ProviderPanel _back;
    private int _transitionId;
    private bool _transitionRunning;

    public WidgetWindow(WidgetViewModel vm)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(vm);

        _vm = vm;
        InitializeComponent();

        _front = PanelA;
        _back = PanelB;
        _pauseItem = new MenuItem { Header = "자동 전환 일시정지", IsCheckable = true };
        Root.ContextMenu = BuildContextMenu();

        Root.MouseLeftButtonUp += OnLeftButtonUp;
        Root.MouseWheel += OnMouseWheel;
        Root.MouseEnter += OnPointerEnter;
        Root.MouseLeave += OnPointerLeave;

        _vm.ProviderSwitched += OnProviderSwitched;
        _vm.Updated += OnUpdated;
        Closed += OnClosed;

        ResetPanels();
        _front.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);
    }

    /// <summary>The DIP-sized content root; TaskbarHost sizes the HWND from it.</summary>
    public FrameworkElement RootElement => Root;

    private ContextMenu BuildContextMenu()
    {
        var settings = new MenuItem { Header = "설정…" };
        settings.Click += (_, _) => _vm.OpenSettings();

        var refresh = new MenuItem { Header = "지금 새로고침" };
        refresh.Click += (_, _) => _vm.RefreshNow();

        _pauseItem.Click += (_, _) => _vm.SetUserPaused(_pauseItem.IsChecked);

        var exit = new MenuItem { Header = "종료" };
        exit.Click += (_, _) => _vm.Exit();

        var menu = new ContextMenu();
        menu.Items.Add(settings);
        menu.Items.Add(refresh);
        menu.Items.Add(_pauseItem);
        menu.Items.Add(new Separator());
        menu.Items.Add(exit);
        menu.Opened += (_, _) => _pauseItem.IsChecked = _vm.IsUserPaused;
        return menu;
    }

    private void OnLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        _vm.Next();
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void OnMouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Delta < 0)
        {
            _vm.Next();
        }
        else if (e.Delta > 0)
        {
            _vm.Previous();
        }

        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void OnPointerEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e) => _vm.SetPointerOver(true);

    private void OnPointerLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e) => _vm.SetPointerOver(false);

    private void OnUpdated(object? sender, EventArgs e) => _front.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);

    private void OnProviderSwitched(object? sender, int direction)
    {
        CompleteTransition();

        if (direction == 0)
        {
            _front.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);
            return;
        }

        ProviderPanel outgoing = _front;
        ProviderPanel incoming = _back;
        incoming.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);
        incoming.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        _front = incoming;
        _back = outgoing;

        // Next: the old panel leaves upward and the new one rises from below. Previous: the reverse.
        double sign = direction > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int id = ++_transitionId;
        _transitionRunning = true;
        var ease = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut };

        Animate(outgoing, 1, 0, 0, -SlideOffset * sign, ease, null);
        Animate(incoming, 0, 1, SlideOffset * sign, 0, ease, (_, _) =>
        {
            if (id == _transitionId)
            {
                CompleteTransition();
            }
        });
    }

    private void CompleteTransition()
    {
        if (!_transitionRunning)
        {
            return;
        }

        _transitionRunning = false;
        _transitionId++;
        StopAnimations(_front);
        StopAnimations(_back);
        ResetPanels();
    }

    private void ResetPanels()
    {
        _front.Opacity = 1;
        _front.Slide.Y = 0;
        _front.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        _back.Opacity = 0;
        _back.Slide.Y = 0;
        _back.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
    }

    private static void StopAnimations(ProviderPanel panel)
    {
        panel.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
        panel.Slide.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, null);
    }

    private static void Animate(
        ProviderPanel panel,
        double fromOpacity,
        double toOpacity,
        double fromY,
        double toY,
        IEasingFunction ease,
        EventHandler? completed)
    {
        var duration = new Duration(TransitionDuration);
        var fade = new DoubleAnimation(fromOpacity, toOpacity, duration) { EasingFunction = ease };
        var slide = new DoubleAnimation(fromY, toY, duration) { EasingFunction = ease };
        if (completed is not null)
        {
            slide.Completed += completed;
        }

        panel.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, fade);
        panel.Slide.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, slide);
    }

    private void OnClosed(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _vm.ProviderSwitched -= OnProviderSwitched;
        _vm.Updated -= OnUpdated;
        _vm.Dispose();
    }
}
```

1) 확인용 도우미를 스크래치 파일로 만든다(저장소에 넣지 않는다). Windows PowerShell 5.1은 DPI 비인식이므로 개발 PC(100%)에서 좌표가 물리 px와 같다.

```powershell
@'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing
if (-not ('AituWidget' -as [type])) {
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class AituWidget
{
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct RECT { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
    private delegate bool EnumProc(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr lParam);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern bool EnumChildWindows(IntPtr parent, EnumProc proc, IntPtr lParam);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern bool EnumWindows(EnumProc proc, IntPtr lParam);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] private static extern IntPtr FindWindow(string className, string title);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr hwnd);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr hwnd, out uint pid);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr hwnd, out RECT rect);

    public static IntPtr Find(uint pid)
    {
        IntPtr found = IntPtr.Zero;
        EnumProc match = (h, l) =>
        {
            uint p;
            GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, out p);
            RECT r;
            if (p == pid && IsWindowVisible(h) && GetWindowRect(h, out r)
                && r.Bottom - r.Top > 0 && r.Bottom - r.Top <= 80 && r.Right - r.Left >= 100)
            {
                found = h;
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        };
        EnumChildWindows(FindWindow("Shell_TrayWnd", null), match, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (found == IntPtr.Zero) { EnumWindows(match, IntPtr.Zero); }
        GC.KeepAlive(match);
        return found;
    }
}
"@
}

function Get-AituWidgetRect {
    $proc = Get-Process -Name AITokenUsage -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1
    $hwnd = [AituWidget]::Find([uint32]$proc.Id)
    if ($hwnd -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { throw 'Widget window not found (hidden or not attached yet).' }
    $rect = New-Object AituWidget+RECT
    [void][AituWidget]::GetWindowRect($hwnd, [ref]$rect)
    return $rect
}

function Save-AituScreenshot([int]$Left, [int]$Top, [int]$Width, [int]$Height, [string]$Name) {
    $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $Width, $Height
    $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
    try { $g.CopyFromScreen($Left, $Top, 0, 0, $bmp.Size) } finally { $g.Dispose() }
    $path = Join-Path $env:TEMP "$Name.png"
    $bmp.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
    $bmp.Dispose()
    return $path
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'aitu-verify.ps1') -Encoding UTF8
```

### Task 18: `DetailFlyout` (호버 상세 카드)

위젯에 마우스를 400ms 올리면 위젯 바로 위에 상세 카드를 띄우고, 위젯과 카드 모두에서 벗어나면 200ms 뒤 닫는다(spec §2.3). 카드 내용·상태 문구·화면 위치 계산은 Core `Presentation`에서 TDD 한다. 상태 문구 규칙(`ProviderStatusText`)은 Task 19 설정 창도 같이 쓴다.

**상태 문구 규칙 (`ProviderStatusText`)**

| 상태 | 설정 창 AI 행 (`ForSettings`) | 상세 카드 상태 줄 (`ForCard`) |
|---|---|---|
| `Ok` + 미터 있음 | `연결됨 · <플랜> · <StatusMessage 또는 "3분 전">` | `3분 전 갱신` (+ ` · <StatusMessage>`) |
| `Ok` + 미터 없음 | `StatusMessage`("불러오는 중…") 또는 "데이터 없음" | 같음 |
| `NotInstalled` | `StatusMessage` 또는 "설치 안 됨" | 설정 창과 같음 |
| `SignedOut` | "로그인 필요 — <메시지>"(메시지가 이미 "로그인 필요"로 시작하면 그대로) | 설정 창과 같음 |
| `WaitingForCliRefresh` | `<CLI 이름>의 로그인 갱신 대기 중`(Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / Copilot) | 공급자 메시지(예: "Claude Code가 로그인을 갱신하면 자동으로 다시 불러옵니다"), 없으면 설정 창 문구 |
| `Unsupported` | `StatusMessage` 또는 "지원 안 됨" | 설정 창과 같음 |
| `RateLimited` | `요청 제한 — HH:mm 이후 재시도`(`FetchedAt + RetryAfter`, 로컬 시각) / `RetryAfter`가 없으면 `요청 제한 — 잠시 후 다시 시도` | 같음 |
| `Error` | `<메시지 또는 "오류"> — HH:mm 이후 재시도`(메시지 끝의 " — 잠시 후 다시 시도"는 시각으로 바꾼다) | 같음 |

`Ok`가 아니고 이전 값이 있으면 카드에 둘째 줄 `마지막 정상 값 · 3분 전`을 붙인다(spec §6 "상세 카드에 이유와 다음 재시도 시각").

**카드 내용 (`DetailCardBuilder`)**: 제목(아이콘·이름·`DisplayPlan`), 한도마다 한 줄(`LongLabel`, 160 DIP 바, 값, 리셋 시각 `FormatRelative` — 텍스트 줄은 바 없이 `TextOverride`와 날짜 `11/1(일)`), `ExtraLine`(정상이면 현재 값, 아니면 이전 값의 것), 상태 줄. 이전 값이면 행과 추가 줄을 불투명도 0.55로 그린다.

**카드 위치 (`FlyoutPlacement`)**: 위젯 HWND의 `GetWindowRect`(화면 물리 px) 위 가운데, 카드 아래쪽과 위젯 위쪽 사이 8 DIP. 카드 창에는 그림자용 투명 여백 12 DIP가 있으므로 "보이는 카드"가 모니터 작업 영역(`rcWork`) 안에 들어오도록 여백만큼 밖으로 나가는 것은 허용해 클램프한다. DIP→px 변환은 카드 창 자신의 `GetDpiForWindow` 값을 쓰고, 다른 DPI 모니터로 옮겨져 `DpiChanged`/`SizeChanged`가 오면 다시 계산한다.

- [ ] **Step 1: 실패하는 테스트 작성**

시계 12:00(KST 고정 시간대), 실패 스냅샷은 11:59에 조회된 것으로 둔다(`PresentationSamples`). `RetryAfter` 21분이면 재시도 시각은 12:20이다.

```csharp
namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;
```

`tests/AITokenUsage.Core.Tests/Presentation/DetailCardBuilderTests.cs` — 2026-10-29는 목요일, 2026-11-01은 일요일이다.

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using static AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation.PresentationSamples;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;

public class DetailCardBuilderTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset CopilotReset = new(2026, 11, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    [Fact]
    public void Build_OkClaude_RowsResetsExtraAndStatus()
    {
        var snapshot = new UsageSnapshot("claude", ProviderStatus.Ok, "Team · Max 5x",
            [
                Meter("session", "5h", 14, Now.AddHours(3).AddMinutes(12), longLabel: "현재 세션 (5시간)"),
                Meter("weekly", "주", 50, Now.AddDays(1).AddHours(8), longLabel: "주간 · 모든 모델"),
                Meter("weekly:fable", "주·Fa", 35, null, Severity.Normal, longLabel: "주간 · Fable"),
            ],
            Now.AddMinutes(-1), ExtraLine: "추가 사용 $12.40 / $50.00");

        DetailCardModel card = DetailCardBuilder.Build(View(snapshot), ValueMode.Used, Now, Kst);

        Assert.Equal("claude", card.ProviderId);
        Assert.Equal("Claude", card.DisplayName);
        Assert.Equal("Team · Max 5x", card.Plan);
        Assert.Equal(3, card.Rows.Count);

        CardRow session = card.Rows[0];
        Assert.Equal("현재 세션 (5시간)", session.Label);
        Assert.Equal("14%", session.Value);
        Assert.Equal(0.14, session.Fraction!.Value, 6);
        Assert.Equal("3시간 12분 후 · 오늘 15:12", session.ResetText);
        Assert.False(session.IsText);
        Assert.False(session.Dimmed);

        Assert.Equal("주간 · 모든 모델", card.Rows[1].Label);
        Assert.Equal("1일 8시간 후 · 10/29(목) 20:00", card.Rows[1].ResetText);
        Assert.Equal("주간 · Fable", card.Rows[2].Label);
        Assert.Equal("", card.Rows[2].ResetText);

        Assert.Equal("추가 사용 $12.40 / $50.00", card.ExtraLine);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "1분 전 갱신" }, card.StatusLines);
        Assert.False(card.IsStale);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_RemainingMode_ShowsRemainingPercent()
    {
        DetailCardModel card = DetailCardBuilder.Build(View(Ok("claude", Meter("session", "5h", 14))), ValueMode.Remaining, Now, Kst);

        Assert.Equal("86%", card.Rows[0].Value);
        Assert.Equal(0.86, card.Rows[0].Fraction!.Value, 6);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_TextMeter_ShowsTextAndDateWithWeekday()
    {
        var snapshot = new UsageSnapshot("copilot", ProviderStatus.Ok, "Pro",
            [
                Meter("monthly", "월", 76.3, CopilotReset, longLabel: "월간 프리미엄 요청"),
                Meter("reset", "↻", null, CopilotReset, text: "↻ 11/1", longLabel: "리셋 날짜"),
            ],
            Now);

        DetailCardModel card = DetailCardBuilder.Build(View(snapshot, displayName: "Copilot"), ValueMode.Used, Now, Kst);

        CardRow monthly = card.Rows[0];
        Assert.Equal("76%", monthly.Value);
        Assert.Equal(Severity.Warning, monthly.Severity);
        Assert.Equal("3일 21시간 후 · 11/1(일) 09:00", monthly.ResetText);

        CardRow reset = card.Rows[1];
        Assert.True(reset.IsText);
        Assert.Null(reset.Fraction);
        Assert.Equal("리셋 날짜", reset.Label);
        Assert.Equal("↻ 11/1", reset.Value);
        Assert.Equal("11/1(일)", reset.ResetText);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_StaleView_DimsRowsAndUsesLastGoodPlanAndExtraLine()
    {
        UsageSnapshot lastGood = Ok("claude", Meter("session", "5h", 14)) with { ExtraLine = "추가 사용 $1.00 / $50.00" };
        var view = View(Status("claude", ProviderStatus.RateLimited, null, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(21)), lastGood);

        DetailCardModel card = DetailCardBuilder.Build(view, ValueMode.Used, Now, Kst);

        Assert.True(card.IsStale);
        Assert.True(Assert.Single(card.Rows).Dimmed);
        Assert.Equal("Pro", card.Plan);
        Assert.Equal("추가 사용 $1.00 / $50.00", card.ExtraLine);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "요청 제한 — 12:20 이후 재시도", "마지막 정상 값 · 3분 전" }, card.StatusLines);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_SignedOutWithoutCache_HasNoRows()
    {
        var view = View(Status("claude", ProviderStatus.SignedOut, "터미널에서 claude 실행 후 /login"));

        DetailCardModel card = DetailCardBuilder.Build(view, ValueMode.Used, Now, Kst);

        Assert.Empty(card.Rows);
        Assert.Null(card.Plan);
        Assert.Null(card.ExtraLine);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "로그인 필요 — 터미널에서 claude 실행 후 /login" }, card.StatusLines);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Build_PastReset_SaysResetSoon()
    {
        DetailCardModel card = DetailCardBuilder.Build(
            View(Ok("claude", Meter("session", "5h", 99, Now.AddMinutes(-2)))), ValueMode.Used, Now, Kst);

        Assert.Equal("곧 리셋", card.Rows[0].ResetText);
        Assert.Equal(Severity.Critical, card.Rows[0].Severity);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Tests.Presentation;

public class FlyoutPlacementTests
{
    private static readonly PixelRect PrimaryWork = new(0, 0, 1920, 1040);

    [Fact]
    public void CentresAboveTheAnchor_WithVisibleCardGapAboveTheWidget()
    {
        var (x, y) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(new PixelRect(100, 1040, 276, 1080), PrimaryWork, 344, 224, 12, 8);

        Assert.Equal(16, x);
        Assert.Equal(820, y);
        Assert.Equal(1040 - 8, y + 224 - 12);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClampsAtTheLeftEdge_AllowingOnlyTheTransparentMargin()
    {
        var (x, y) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(new PixelRect(0, 1040, 176, 1080), PrimaryWork, 344, 224, 12, 8);

        Assert.Equal(-12, x);
        Assert.Equal(820, y);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClampsAtTheRightEdge()
    {
        var (x, _) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(new PixelRect(1744, 1040, 1920, 1080), PrimaryWork, 344, 224, 12, 8);

        Assert.Equal(1920 + 12 - 344, x);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SecondaryMonitorWithNegativeCoordinates()
    {
        var work = new PixelRect(-1920, 0, 0, 1040);

        var (x, y) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(new PixelRect(-1820, 1040, -1644, 1080), work, 344, 224, 12, 8);

        Assert.Equal(-1904, x);
        Assert.Equal(820, y);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AnchorAtTheTopOfTheScreen_KeepsCardInsideWorkArea()
    {
        var work = new PixelRect(0, 40, 1920, 1080);

        var (_, y) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(new PixelRect(100, 0, 276, 40), work, 344, 224, 12, 8);

        Assert.Equal(40 - 12, y);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Scale125_UsesScaledMarginAndGap()
    {
        var work = new PixelRect(0, 0, 2400, 1300);

        var (x, y) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(new PixelRect(100, 1300, 320, 1350), work, 430, 280, 15, 10);

        Assert.Equal(-5, x);
        Assert.Equal(1025, y);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>Korean status sentences for the settings window rows (spec §2.5) and the detail card (spec §2.3).</summary>
public static class ProviderStatusText
{
    public const string Connected = "연결됨";
    public const string NotInstalled = "설치 안 됨";
    public const string SignInRequired = "로그인 필요";
    public const string NotSupported = "지원 안 됨";
    public const string NoData = "데이터 없음";
    public const string RetrySoon = "잠시 후 다시 시도";

    private const string Separator = " · ";
    private const string Dash = " — ";

    /// <summary>The tool whose login the app waits for: "Claude Code", "Codex", "Gemini CLI", "Copilot".</summary>
    public static string CliName(string providerId) => providerId switch
    {
        ProviderIds.Claude => "Claude Code",
        ProviderIds.Codex => "Codex",
        ProviderIds.Gemini => "Gemini CLI",
        ProviderIds.Copilot => "Copilot",
        _ => providerId,
    };

    /// <summary>"요청 제한 — 14:20 이후 재시도" (FetchedAt + RetryAfter in <paramref name="zone"/>) or "요청 제한 — 잠시 후 다시 시도".</summary>
    public static string RateLimited(UsageSnapshot snapshot, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(snapshot);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(zone);

        string? clock = RetryClock(snapshot, zone);
        return clock is null ? $"요청 제한{Dash}{RetrySoon}" : $"요청 제한{Dash}{clock} 이후 재시도";
    }

    /// <summary>One line for the settings window provider row.</summary>
    public static string ForSettings(ProviderView view, DateTimeOffset now, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(zone);

        UsageSnapshot current = view.Current;
        string? message = Clean(current.StatusMessage);

        switch (current.Status)
        {
            case ProviderStatus.Ok when current.Meters.Count > 0:
                string age = new ResetTimeFormatter(zone).FormatAgo(current.FetchedAt, now);
                return Join(Connected, view.DisplayPlan, message ?? age);
            case ProviderStatus.Ok:
                return message ?? NoData;
            case ProviderStatus.NotInstalled:
                return message ?? NotInstalled;
            case ProviderStatus.SignedOut:
                return Prefixed(SignInRequired, message);
            case ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh:
                return $"{CliName(view.ProviderId)}의 로그인 갱신 대기 중";
            case ProviderStatus.Unsupported:
                return message ?? NotSupported;
            case ProviderStatus.RateLimited:
                return RateLimited(current, zone);
            default:
                return ErrorText(current, message, zone);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Status lines under the detail card: the reason, then "마지막 정상 값 · 3분 전" when older values are shown.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ForCard(ProviderView view, DateTimeOffset now, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(zone);

        UsageSnapshot current = view.Current;
        string? message = Clean(current.StatusMessage);
        var formatter = new ResetTimeFormatter(zone);

        if (current.Status == ProviderStatus.Ok)
        {
            if (current.Meters.Count == 0)
            {
                return new[] { message ?? NoData };
            }

            string updated = $"{formatter.FormatAgo(current.FetchedAt, now)} 갱신";
            return new[] { message is null ? updated : updated + Separator + message };
        }

        string reason = current.Status == ProviderStatus.WaitingForCliRefresh && message is not null
            ? message
            : ForSettings(view, now, zone);

        if (view.LastGood is { } lastGood)
        {
            return new[] { reason, $"마지막 정상 값{Separator}{formatter.FormatAgo(lastGood.FetchedAt, now)}" };
        }

        return new[] { reason };
    }

    private static string ErrorText(UsageSnapshot snapshot, string? message, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        string reason = message ?? "오류";
        string? clock = RetryClock(snapshot, zone);
        if (clock is null)
        {
            return reason;
        }

        string retrySoonSuffix = Dash + RetrySoon;
        if (reason.EndsWith(retrySoonSuffix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            reason = reason[..^retrySoonSuffix.Length];
        }

        return $"{reason}{Dash}{clock} 이후 재시도";
    }

    private static string? RetryClock(UsageSnapshot snapshot, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        if (snapshot.RetryAfter is not TimeSpan retry || retry <= TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            return null;
        }

        DateTimeOffset local = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTime(snapshot.FetchedAt + retry, zone);
        return local.ToString("HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private static string Prefixed(string prefix, string? message)
    {
        if (message is null)
        {
            return prefix;
        }

        return message.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal) ? message : prefix + Dash + message;
    }

    private static string Join(params string?[] parts) =>
        string.Join(Separator, parts.Where(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p)));

    private static string? Clean(string? text) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) ? null : text.Trim();
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>One limit row of the detail card. Text rows (IsText) have no bar.</summary>
public sealed record CardRow(
    string Label,
    double? Fraction,
    string Value,
    string ResetText,
    Severity Severity,
    bool IsText,
    bool Dimmed);

/// <summary>Everything the hover card shows for the provider currently on the widget.</summary>
public sealed record DetailCardModel(
    string ProviderId,
    string DisplayName,
    string? Plan,
    IReadOnlyList<CardRow> Rows,
    string? ExtraLine,
    IReadOnlyList<string> StatusLines,
    bool IsStale);
```

`src/AITokenUsage.Core/Presentation/DetailCardBuilder.cs`:

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Settings;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Util;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>Builds the hover card content (spec §2.3).</summary>
public static class DetailCardBuilder
{
    public static DetailCardModel Build(ProviderView view, ValueMode mode, DateTimeOffset now, TimeZoneInfo zone)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(view);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(zone);

        var formatter = new ResetTimeFormatter(zone);
        bool dimmed = view.IsStale;
        CardRow[] rows = view.DisplayMeters.Select(m => ToRow(m, mode, now, formatter, dimmed)).ToArray();

        string? extra = view.Current.Status == ProviderStatus.Ok
            ? view.Current.ExtraLine
            : view.LastGood?.ExtraLine ?? view.Current.ExtraLine;

        return new DetailCardModel(
            view.ProviderId,
            view.DisplayName,
            view.DisplayPlan,
            rows,
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(extra) ? null : extra.Trim(),
            ProviderStatusText.ForCard(view, now, zone),
            view.IsStale);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Percent rows: long label, bar, value and "3시간 12분 후 · 오늘 15:50".
    /// Text rows (TextOverride): the text and the reset date "11/1(일)".
    /// </summary>
    public static CardRow ToRow(UsageMeter meter, ValueMode mode, DateTimeOffset now, ResetTimeFormatter formatter, bool dimmed)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(meter);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(formatter);

        Severity severity = SeverityRules.Effective(meter);

        if (meter.TextOverride is { } text)
        {
            string date = meter.ResetsAt is { } at ? formatter.FormatShortDateWithDay(at) : "";
            return new CardRow(meter.LongLabel, null, text, date, severity, true, dimmed);
        }

        string reset = meter.ResetsAt is { } resetsAt ? formatter.FormatRelative(resetsAt, now) : "";
        return new CardRow(
            meter.LongLabel,
            MeterFormatter.BarFraction(meter, mode),
            MeterFormatter.ValueText(meter, mode),
            reset,
            severity,
            false,
            dimmed);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;

/// <summary>Where the hover card goes, in physical screen pixels.</summary>
public static class FlyoutPlacement
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Top-left of a window of <paramref name="width"/>×<paramref name="height"/> whose visible card is inset by
    /// <paramref name="margin"/> (transparent shadow border). The visible card is centred over <paramref name="anchor"/>
    /// and ends <paramref name="gap"/> above it, then clamped so the visible card stays inside <paramref name="workArea"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static (int X, int Y) Compute(PixelRect anchor, PixelRect workArea, int width, int height, int margin, int gap)
    {
        int x = anchor.Left + (anchor.Width - width) / 2;
        int y = anchor.Top - gap - height + margin;

        int minX = workArea.Left - margin;
        int maxX = Math.Max(minX, workArea.Right + margin - width);
        int minY = workArea.Top - margin;
        int maxY = Math.Max(minY, workArea.Bottom + margin - height);

        return (Math.Clamp(x, minX, maxX), Math.Clamp(y, minY, maxY));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: `UiNative` 작성**

`NativeMethods`(Task 15)와 독립적인 UI 전용 최소 P/Invoke다. 모두 blittable 구조체라 `LibraryImport`로 충분하다(64비트 전용 `GetWindowLongPtrW`/`SetWindowLongPtrW` — spec §1.3 x64).

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/UiNative.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Win32 calls used only by the UI layer (detail card placement and window styles).</summary>
internal static partial class UiNative
{
    internal const int GWL_EXSTYLE = -20;
    internal const int WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW = 0x00000080;
    internal const int WS_EX_NOACTIVATE = 0x08000000;

    internal const uint MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST = 2;

    internal const uint SWP_NOSIZE = 0x0001;
    internal const uint SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x0010;
    internal const uint SWP_NOOWNERZORDER = 0x0200;

    internal static readonly nint HWND_TOPMOST = -1;

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    internal struct RECT
    {
        public int Left;
        public int Top;
        public int Right;
        public int Bottom;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    internal struct MONITORINFO
    {
        public uint cbSize;
        public RECT rcMonitor;
        public RECT rcWork;
        public uint dwFlags;
    }

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    internal static partial bool GetWindowRect(nint hWnd, out RECT rect);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    internal static partial nint MonitorFromRect(ref RECT rect, uint flags);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "GetMonitorInfoW")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    internal static partial bool GetMonitorInfo(nint monitor, ref MONITORINFO info);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    internal static partial uint GetDpiForWindow(nint hWnd);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "GetWindowLongPtrW")]
    internal static partial nint GetWindowLongPtr(nint hWnd, int index);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "SetWindowLongPtrW")]
    internal static partial nint SetWindowLongPtr(nint hWnd, int index, nint value);

    [LibraryImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    internal static partial bool SetWindowPos(nint hWnd, nint insertAfter, int x, int y, int cx, int cy, uint flags);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: `DetailFlyout` 창 작성**

별도 최상위 창: `WS_EX_NOACTIVATE | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW`(`OnSourceInitialized`에서 추가), `Topmost`, 투명 배경 + 둥근 모서리 8 + 정적 그림자. 배경은 앱 테마(`IsAppLight`): 다크 `#2B2B2B`, 라이트 `#F9F9F9`. 그림자는 내용과 분리된 뒤쪽 `Border`에만 걸어 글자가 흐려지지 않게 한다.

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/DetailFlyout.xaml.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Media;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>The hover card: a non-activating topmost tool window drawn above the widget.</summary>
public partial class DetailFlyout : Window
{
    /// <summary>Transparent border around the card that holds the drop shadow (matches the XAML Grid margin).</summary>
    public const double ShadowMargin = 12;
    public const double GapAboveAnchor = 8;
    public const double BarWidth = 160;

    private const double StaleOpacity = 0.55;

    private static readonly SolidColorBrush DarkBackground = Frozen(Color.FromRgb(0x2B, 0x2B, 0x2B));
    private static readonly SolidColorBrush LightBackground = Frozen(Color.FromRgb(0xF9, 0xF9, 0xF9));
    private static readonly SolidColorBrush DarkBorder = Frozen(Color.FromArgb(0x33, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF));
    private static readonly SolidColorBrush LightBorder = Frozen(Color.FromArgb(0x1F, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00));

    private nint _anchor;

    public DetailFlyout()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        SizeChanged += (_, _) => Reposition();
        DpiChanged += (_, _) => Reposition();
    }

    public void Render(DetailCardModel model, bool appIsLight)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(model);

        WidgetPalette palette = appIsLight ? WidgetPalette.DarkText : WidgetPalette.LightText;
        Brush background = appIsLight ? LightBackground : DarkBackground;
        Card.Background = background;
        Card.BorderBrush = appIsLight ? LightBorder : DarkBorder;
        ShadowLayer.Background = background;
        Divider.Background = palette.Track;

        GlyphHost.Content = ProviderGlyphs.CreateIcon(model.ProviderId, 16, palette.Text);
        TitleText.Text = model.DisplayName;
        TitleText.Foreground = palette.Text;
        PlanText.Text = model.Plan ?? "";
        PlanText.Foreground = palette.Muted;
        PlanText.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.Plan) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;

        RowsPanel.Children.Clear();
        foreach (CardRow row in model.Rows)
        {
            RowsPanel.Children.Add(BuildRow(row, palette, model.ProviderId));
        }

        ExtraText.Text = model.ExtraLine ?? "";
        ExtraText.Foreground = palette.Text;
        ExtraText.Opacity = model.IsStale ? StaleOpacity : 1;
        ExtraText.Visibility = model.ExtraLine is null ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;

        Divider.Visibility = model.Rows.Count > 0 || model.ExtraLine is not null ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;

        StatusPanel.Children.Clear();
        foreach (string line in model.StatusLines)
        {
            StatusPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = line,
                FontSize = 11,
                Foreground = palette.Muted,
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                MaxWidth = 360,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 2),
            });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Shows the card above <paramref name="anchor"/> (the widget HWND) without activating it.</summary>
    public void ShowAbove(nint anchor)
    {
        _anchor = anchor;

        if (!IsVisible)
        {
            // Show transparent first so the window never flashes at its default position.
            Opacity = 0;
            Show();
            UpdateLayout();
        }

        Reposition();
        Opacity = 1;
    }

    /// <summary>Re-centres the card above the anchor using the card's own DPI and the anchor monitor's work area.</summary>
    public void Reposition()
    {
        nint self = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
        if (self == 0 || _anchor == 0 || !IsVisible)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!UiNative.GetWindowRect(_anchor, out UiNative.RECT anchor) || !UiNative.GetWindowRect(self, out UiNative.RECT own))
        {
            return;
        }

        nint monitor = UiNative.MonitorFromRect(ref anchor, UiNative.MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST);
        var info = new UiNative.MONITORINFO { cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<UiNative.MONITORINFO>() };
        if (monitor == 0 || !UiNative.GetMonitorInfo(monitor, ref info))
        {
            return;
        }

        uint dpi = UiNative.GetDpiForWindow(self);
        double scale = dpi == 0 ? 1.0 : dpi / 96.0;
        int margin = (int)Math.Round(ShadowMargin * scale);
        int gap = (int)Math.Round(GapAboveAnchor * scale);

        (int x, int y) = FlyoutPlacement.Compute(
            new PixelRect(anchor.Left, anchor.Top, anchor.Right, anchor.Bottom),
            new PixelRect(info.rcWork.Left, info.rcWork.Top, info.rcWork.Right, info.rcWork.Bottom),
            own.Right - own.Left,
            own.Bottom - own.Top,
            margin,
            gap);

        if (x == own.Left && y == own.Top)
        {
            return;
        }

        UiNative.SetWindowPos(self, UiNative.HWND_TOPMOST, x, y, 0, 0,
            UiNative.SWP_NOSIZE | UiNative.SWP_NOACTIVATE | UiNative.SWP_NOOWNERZORDER);
    }

    protected override void OnSourceInitialized(EventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnSourceInitialized(e);

        nint hwnd = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
        nint exStyle = UiNative.GetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, UiNative.GWL_EXSTYLE);
        UiNative.SetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, UiNative.GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle | UiNative.WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | UiNative.WS_EX_NOACTIVATE);
    }

    private static FrameworkElement BuildRow(CardRow row, WidgetPalette palette, string providerId)
    {
        var grid = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10), Opacity = row.Dimmed ? StaleOpacity : 1 };
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(BarWidth) });
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });

        var header = new DockPanel { LastChildFill = true, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4) };
        var value = new TextBlock
        {
            Text = row.Value,
            FontSize = 12,
            FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold,
            Foreground = palette.Text,
            Margin = new Thickness(12, 0, 0, 0),
        };
        DockPanel.SetDock(value, Dock.Right);
        header.Children.Add(value);
        header.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = row.Label,
            FontSize = 12,
            Foreground = palette.Text,
            TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis,
        });
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(header, 2);
        grid.Children.Add(header);

        var reset = new TextBlock
        {
            Text = row.ResetText,
            FontSize = 11,
            Foreground = palette.Muted,
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
        };
        Grid.SetRow(reset, 1);

        if (row.IsText)
        {
            Grid.SetColumnSpan(reset, 2);
        }
        else
        {
            var track = new Border
            {
                Height = 6,
                CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(3),
                Background = palette.Track,
                VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
                Child = new Border
                {
                    Height = 6,
                    CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(3),
                    HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left,
                    Width = Math.Round(BarWidth * Math.Clamp(row.Fraction ?? 0, 0, 1)),
                    Background = palette.BarBrush(providerId, row.Severity),
                },
            };
            Grid.SetRow(track, 1);
            grid.Children.Add(track);

            Grid.SetColumn(reset, 1);
            reset.Margin = new Thickness(12, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        if (row.ResetText.Length > 0)
        {
            grid.Children.Add(reset);
        }

        return grid;
    }

    private static SolidColorBrush Frozen(Color color)
    {
        var brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
        brush.Freeze();
        return brush;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: `DetailFlyoutController` 작성**

호버 타이머 규칙: 위젯에 들어오면 400ms 뒤 연다(그 전에 나가면 취소). 위젯과 카드 모두에서 벗어나면 200ms 뒤 닫는다(그 사이 다시 들어오면 취소). 카드 위에 있는 동안은 열어 둔다. 열려 있는 동안 `ViewChanged`(현재 공급자)·`SettingsChanged`·`Rotation.CurrentChanged`·테마 변경·30초 시계마다 다시 그린다. 우클릭 메뉴가 열려 있는 동안은 열지 않는다. `PointerOverChanged`는 위젯+카드 어느 쪽이든 포인터가 있는지를 알려 위젯의 호버 멈춤이 카드 위에서도 유지되게 한다.

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/DetailFlyoutController.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Models;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Presentation;
using AITokenUsage.Core.Rotation;
using AITokenUsage.Taskbar;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>Hover logic for the detail card: open 400 ms after entering the widget, close 200 ms after leaving widget and card.</summary>
public sealed class DetailFlyoutController : IDisposable
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan OpenDelay = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(400);
    public static readonly TimeSpan CloseDelay = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200);
    public static readonly TimeSpan ClockRefreshInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

    private readonly AppHost _host;
    private readonly ThemeWatcher _theme;
    private readonly Window _anchor;
    private readonly DispatcherTimer _openTimer;
    private readonly DispatcherTimer _closeTimer;
    private readonly DispatcherTimer _clockTimer;
    private DetailFlyout? _flyout;
    private bool _overAnchor;
    private bool _overFlyout;
    private bool _suppressed;
    private bool _disposed;

    public DetailFlyoutController(AppHost host, ThemeWatcher theme, Window anchor)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(host);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(theme);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(anchor);

        _host = host;
        _theme = theme;
        _anchor = anchor;
        _openTimer = CreateTimer(OpenDelay, OnOpenTimer);
        _closeTimer = CreateTimer(CloseDelay, OnCloseTimer);
        _clockTimer = CreateTimer(ClockRefreshInterval, (_, _) => RefreshIfOpen());

        _host.ViewChanged += OnViewChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged += OnSettingsChanged;
        _host.Rotation.CurrentChanged += OnCurrentChanged;
        _theme.Changed += OnThemeChanged;
    }

    public bool IsOpen => _flyout is { IsVisible: true };

    /// <summary>True while the pointer is over the widget or over the open card.</summary>
    public bool IsPointerOver => _overAnchor || _overFlyout;

    public event EventHandler? PointerOverChanged;

    public void AnchorEnter()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _overAnchor = true;
        _closeTimer.Stop();
        if (!IsOpen && !_suppressed)
        {
            Restart(_openTimer);
        }

        PointerOverChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    public void AnchorLeave()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _overAnchor = false;
        _openTimer.Stop();
        if (IsOpen && !_overFlyout)
        {
            Restart(_closeTimer);
        }

        PointerOverChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>While suppressed (context menu open) the card closes and does not open.</summary>
    public void SetSuppressed(bool suppressed)
    {
        _suppressed = suppressed;
        if (suppressed)
        {
            CloseNow();
        }
    }

    public void CloseNow()
    {
        _openTimer.Stop();
        _closeTimer.Stop();
        _clockTimer.Stop();
        _flyout?.Hide();

        if (_overFlyout)
        {
            _overFlyout = false;
            PointerOverChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _host.ViewChanged -= OnViewChanged;
        _host.SettingsChanged -= OnSettingsChanged;
        _host.Rotation.CurrentChanged -= OnCurrentChanged;
        _theme.Changed -= OnThemeChanged;
        _openTimer.Stop();
        _closeTimer.Stop();
        _clockTimer.Stop();
        _flyout?.Close();
        _flyout = null;
    }

    private DispatcherTimer CreateTimer(TimeSpan interval, EventHandler tick)
    {
        var timer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Normal, _anchor.Dispatcher) { Interval = interval };
        timer.Tick += tick;
        return timer;
    }

    private static void Restart(DispatcherTimer timer)
    {
        timer.Stop();
        timer.Start();
    }

    private void OnOpenTimer(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _openTimer.Stop();
        if (!_disposed && _overAnchor && !_suppressed)
        {
            Open();
        }
    }

    private void OnCloseTimer(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _closeTimer.Stop();
        if (!IsPointerOver)
        {
            CloseNow();
        }
    }

    private void Open()
    {
        DetailCardModel? model = BuildModel();
        nint anchorHandle = new WindowInteropHelper(_anchor).Handle;
        if (model is null || anchorHandle == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        DetailFlyout flyout = EnsureFlyout();
        flyout.Render(model, _theme.IsAppLight);
        flyout.ShowAbove(anchorHandle);
        _clockTimer.Start();
    }

    private DetailFlyout EnsureFlyout()
    {
        if (_flyout is not null)
        {
            return _flyout;
        }

        var flyout = new DetailFlyout();
        flyout.MouseEnter += (_, _) =>
        {
            _overFlyout = true;
            _closeTimer.Stop();
            PointerOverChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        };
        flyout.MouseLeave += (_, _) =>
        {
            _overFlyout = false;
            if (!_overAnchor)
            {
                Restart(_closeTimer);
            }

            PointerOverChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        };

        _flyout = flyout;
        return flyout;
    }

    private DetailCardModel? BuildModel()
    {
        string? id = _host.Rotation.CurrentId;
        ProviderView? view = id is null ? null : _host.Usage.GetView(id);
        return view is null
            ? null
            : DetailCardBuilder.Build(view, _host.Settings.ValueMode, _host.ProviderContext.Time.GetUtcNow(), TimeZoneInfo.Local);
    }

    private void RefreshIfOpen()
    {
        if (_disposed || _flyout is null || !IsOpen)
        {
            return;
        }

        DetailCardModel? model = BuildModel();
        if (model is null)
        {
            CloseNow();
            return;
        }

        _flyout.Render(model, _theme.IsAppLight);
    }

    private void OnViewChanged(object? sender, ProviderView view)
    {
        if (view.ProviderId == _host.Rotation.CurrentId)
        {
            RefreshIfOpen();
        }
    }

    private void OnSettingsChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => RefreshIfOpen();

    private void OnCurrentChanged(object? sender, RotationChangedEventArgs e) => RefreshIfOpen();

    private void OnThemeChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (_anchor.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
        {
            RefreshIfOpen();
        }
        else
        {
            _anchor.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(RefreshIfOpen);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: `WidgetWindow.xaml.cs`를 카드 연결 버전으로 전체 교체**

Task 17 버전과의 차이: `DetailFlyoutController`를 만들고, `MouseEnter/Leave`를 컨트롤러로 보내며, 호버 멈춤은 "위젯 또는 카드 위"(`IsPointerOver`)로 판단하고, 우클릭 메뉴가 열려 있는 동안 카드를 막고, 창이 닫힐 때 컨트롤러를 정리한다. XAML은 Task 17 그대로다.

`src/AITokenUsage/UI/WidgetWindow.xaml.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace AITokenUsage.UI;

/// <summary>
/// The taskbar widget. TaskbarHost owns placement (SetParent/SetWindowPos); this class only draws,
/// animates the 220 ms provider transition and handles click, wheel, hover (detail card) and the context menu.
/// </summary>
public partial class WidgetWindow : Window
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan TransitionDuration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(220);
    public const double SlideOffset = 8;

    private readonly WidgetViewModel _vm;
    private readonly DetailFlyoutController _flyout;
    private readonly MenuItem _pauseItem;
    private ProviderPanel _front;
    private ProviderPanel _back;
    private int _transitionId;
    private bool _transitionRunning;

    public WidgetWindow(WidgetViewModel vm)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(vm);

        _vm = vm;
        InitializeComponent();

        _front = PanelA;
        _back = PanelB;
        _flyout = new DetailFlyoutController(vm.Host, vm.Theme, this);
        _flyout.PointerOverChanged += OnFlyoutPointerOverChanged;
        _pauseItem = new MenuItem { Header = "자동 전환 일시정지", IsCheckable = true };
        Root.ContextMenu = BuildContextMenu();

        Root.MouseLeftButtonUp += OnLeftButtonUp;
        Root.MouseWheel += OnMouseWheel;
        Root.MouseEnter += OnPointerEnter;
        Root.MouseLeave += OnPointerLeave;

        _vm.ProviderSwitched += OnProviderSwitched;
        _vm.Updated += OnUpdated;
        Closed += OnClosed;

        ResetPanels();
        _front.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);
    }

    /// <summary>The DIP-sized content root; TaskbarHost sizes the HWND from it.</summary>
    public FrameworkElement RootElement => Root;

    private ContextMenu BuildContextMenu()
    {
        var settings = new MenuItem { Header = "설정…" };
        settings.Click += (_, _) => _vm.OpenSettings();

        var refresh = new MenuItem { Header = "지금 새로고침" };
        refresh.Click += (_, _) => _vm.RefreshNow();

        _pauseItem.Click += (_, _) => _vm.SetUserPaused(_pauseItem.IsChecked);

        var exit = new MenuItem { Header = "종료" };
        exit.Click += (_, _) => _vm.Exit();

        var menu = new ContextMenu();
        menu.Items.Add(settings);
        menu.Items.Add(refresh);
        menu.Items.Add(_pauseItem);
        menu.Items.Add(new Separator());
        menu.Items.Add(exit);
        menu.Opened += (_, _) =>
        {
            _pauseItem.IsChecked = _vm.IsUserPaused;
            _flyout.SetSuppressed(true);
        };
        menu.Closed += (_, _) => _flyout.SetSuppressed(false);
        return menu;
    }

    private void OnLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        _vm.Next();
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void OnMouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Delta < 0)
        {
            _vm.Next();
        }
        else if (e.Delta > 0)
        {
            _vm.Previous();
        }

        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void OnPointerEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e) => _flyout.AnchorEnter();

    private void OnPointerLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e) => _flyout.AnchorLeave();

    private void OnFlyoutPointerOverChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => _vm.SetPointerOver(_flyout.IsPointerOver);

    private void OnUpdated(object? sender, EventArgs e) => _front.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);

    private void OnProviderSwitched(object? sender, int direction)
    {
        CompleteTransition();

        if (direction == 0)
        {
            _front.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);
            return;
        }

        ProviderPanel outgoing = _front;
        ProviderPanel incoming = _back;
        incoming.Render(_vm.CurrentModel, _vm.Palette);
        incoming.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        _front = incoming;
        _back = outgoing;

        // Next: the old panel leaves upward and the new one rises from below. Previous: the reverse.
        double sign = direction > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int id = ++_transitionId;
        _transitionRunning = true;
        var ease = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut };

        Animate(outgoing, 1, 0, 0, -SlideOffset * sign, ease, null);
        Animate(incoming, 0, 1, SlideOffset * sign, 0, ease, (_, _) =>
        {
            if (id == _transitionId)
            {
                CompleteTransition();
            }
        });
    }

    private void CompleteTransition()
    {
        if (!_transitionRunning)
        {
            return;
        }

        _transitionRunning = false;
        _transitionId++;
        StopAnimations(_front);
        StopAnimations(_back);
        ResetPanels();
    }

    private void ResetPanels()
    {
        _front.Opacity = 1;
        _front.Slide.Y = 0;
        _front.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        _back.Opacity = 0;
        _back.Slide.Y = 0;
        _back.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
    }

    private static void StopAnimations(ProviderPanel panel)
    {
        panel.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
        panel.Slide.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, null);
    }

    private static void Animate(
        ProviderPanel panel,
        double fromOpacity,
        double toOpacity,
        double fromY,
        double toY,
        IEasingFunction ease,
        EventHandler? completed)
    {
        var duration = new Duration(TransitionDuration);
        var fade = new DoubleAnimation(fromOpacity, toOpacity, duration) { EasingFunction = ease };
        var slide = new DoubleAnimation(fromY, toY, duration) { EasingFunction = ease };
        if (completed is not null)
        {
            slide.Completed += completed;
        }

        panel.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, fade);
        panel.Slide.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, slide);
    }

    private void OnClosed(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _vm.ProviderSwitched -= OnProviderSwitched;
        _vm.Updated -= OnUpdated;
        _flyout.PointerOverChanged -= OnFlyoutPointerOverChanged;
        _flyout.Dispose();
        _vm.Dispose();
    }
}
```

### Task 19: `SettingsWindow` + 트레이/위젯 메뉴 `설정…` + 두 번째 실행 시 설정 창

spec §2.5의 모든 설정을 한 창에서 바꾸고, 바꾸는 즉시 `host.ApplySettings()`(정규화 → 새로고침 간격이 바뀌었으면 `RescheduleAll` → 전환 → 스냅샷 저장 → 시작 프로그램 반영 → `SettingsChanged`)로 적용한다. 확인/취소 버튼은 없다. 드롭다운 항목과 모니터 이름 규칙은 Core에서 TDD 한다.

**규칙**
- 창: 일반 최상위 창, 480×620 DIP, 크기 조절 불가, 작업 표시줄에 표시, 화면 가운데. 테마는 `ThemeWatcher.IsAppLight`(= `AppsUseLightTheme`)에 따라 WPF Fluent `ThemeMode.Light`/`Dark`를 창 단위로 건다(`Window.ThemeMode`는 .NET 9부터 있는 실험 API라 `WPF0001` 경고를 그 줄에서만 끈다). 내용이 620을 넘으면 세로 스크롤.
- 한 번에 하나만: `SettingsWindow.ShowOrActivate(host, theme)`가 열린 창이 있으면 복원·활성화만 한다. `AppHost.OpenSettings()`는 이것만 부르고, 다른 스레드에서 불려도 UI 스레드로 넘긴다(두 번째 실행 신호 대비).
- AI 행: 켜기 체크, 아이콘·이름, 상태 문구(`ProviderStatusText.ForSettings`, 30초마다·`ViewChanged`마다 갱신), ▲▼(첫 행 ▲·마지막 행 ▼ 비활성), 1줄/2줄 드롭다운. 드롭다운 항목 = `StaticMeterOptions` → 현재 뷰의 동적 미터(`LongLabel`) → 현재 설정 키인데 둘 다에 없으면 "`<키>` (현재 데이터 없음)" (`MeterOptionList`).
- Copilot 행 아래: `GitHubDeviceFlow`로 로그인 — 코드 `ABCD-1234` + [복사] + [브라우저 열기] + [취소], 브라우저는 `Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(uri) { UseShellExecute = true })`로 처음 한 번 연다. 코드가 만료되면(`DeviceFlowError.Expired`) 새 코드를 받아 계속한다(spec §5.4). 성공하면 `CopilotUsageProvider.SignInWithTokenAsync` → `host.RefreshNowAsync()`. 로그인 상태면 `GitHub: <login>` + [로그아웃]. 항상 작은 글씨 "비공식 API를 사용합니다". 창을 닫으면 진행 중인 흐름을 취소한다. 토큰은 UI·로그 어디에도 나타나지 않는다.
- 전환 간격 슬라이더(2–60초, 1초 단위)는 숫자를 즉시 보여 주되 저장은 마지막 움직임 300ms 뒤 한 번 한다(드래그마다 파일을 쓰지 않도록). 창을 닫을 때 대기 중이면 즉시 저장한다.
- 모니터 목록은 `System.Windows.Forms.Screen.AllScreens`로 만들고, 디스플레이 구성이 바뀌면(`SystemEvents.DisplaySettingsChanged`) 다시 만든다. 첫 항목은 "주 모니터"(= `null`), 그 뒤 왼쪽→오른쪽 순서로 "모니터 N (W×H, 왼쪽/오른쪽/위/아래/주)". 저장된 장치가 지금 없으면 "`\\.\DISPLAY3` (연결 안 됨)"으로 남겨 선택을 잃지 않는다.
